name: Bulbasaur
description: Bulbasaur is the Seed Pokémon, a Grass/Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Bulbasaur stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 15lbs 3oz (6.9kg). While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

name: Ivysaur
description: Ivysaur is the Seed Pokémon, a Grass/Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Ivysaur stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 28lbs 11oz (13.0kg). Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.

name: Venusaur
description: Venusaur is the Seed Pokémon, a Grass/Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Venusaur stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 220lbs 7oz (100.0kg). A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.

name: Charmander
description: Charmander is the Lizard Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Charmander stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 18lbs 12oz (8.5kg). From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

name: Charmeleon
description: Charmeleon is the Flame Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Charmeleon stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 41lbs 14oz (19.0kg). If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

name: Charizard
description: Charizard is the Flame Pokémon, a Fire/Flying-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Charizard stands 5'7" (1.7m) tall and weighs 199lbs 8oz (90.5kg). Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

name: Squirtle
description: Squirtle is the Tiny Turtle Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Squirtle stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 19lbs 13oz (9.0kg). When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

name: Wartortle
description: Wartortle is the Turtle Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Wartortle stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 49lbs 10oz (22.5kg). It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.

name: Blastoise
description: Blastoise is the Shellfish Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Blastoise stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 188lbs 8oz (85.5kg). The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punching holes through thick steel.

name: Caterpie
description: Caterpie is the Worm Pokémon, a Bug-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Caterpie stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 6lbs 6oz (2.9kg). Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

name: Metapod
description: Metapod is the Cocoon Pokémon, a Bug-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Metapod stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 21lbs 13oz (9.9kg). Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can’t withstand a harsh attack.

name: Butterfree
description: Butterfree is the Butterfly Pokémon, a Bug/Flying-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Butterfree stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 70lbs 9oz (32.0kg). It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

name: Weedle
description: Weedle is the Hairy Bug Pokémon, a Bug/Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Weedle stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 7lbs 1oz (3.2kg). Beware of the sharp stinger on its head. It hides in grass and bushes where it eats leaves.

name: Kakuna
description: Kakuna is the Cocoon Pokémon, a Bug/Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Kakuna stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 22lbs 1oz (10.0kg). Able to move only slightly. When endangered, it may stick out its stinger and poison its enemy.

name: Beedrill
description: Beedrill is the Poison Bee Pokémon, a Bug/Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Beedrill stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 65lbs 1oz (29.5kg). It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

name: Pidgey
description: Pidgey is the Tiny Bird Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Pidgey stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 3lbs 15oz (1.8kg). Very docile. If attacked, it will often kick up sand to protect itself rather than fight back.

name: Pidgeotto
description: Pidgeotto is the Bird Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Pidgeotto stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 66lbs 2oz (30.0kg). This Pokémon is full of vitality. It constantly flies around its large territory in search of prey.

name: Pidgeot
description: Pidgeot is the Bird Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Pidgeot stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 87lbs 1oz (39.5kg). This Pokémon flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey. Its large talons are feared as wicked weapons.

name: Rattata
description: Rattata is the Mouse Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Rattata stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 7lbs 11oz (3.5kg). Will chew on anything with its fangs. If you see one, you can be certain that 40 more live in the area.

name: Raticate
description: Raticate is the Mouse Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Raticate stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 40lbs 13oz (18.5kg). Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.

name: Spearow
description: Spearow is the Tiny Bird Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Spearow stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 4lbs 7oz (2.0kg). Inept at flying high. However, it can fly around very fast to protect its territory.

name: Fearow
description: Fearow is the Beak Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Fearow stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 83lbs 12oz (38.0kg). A Pokémon that dates back many years. If it senses danger, it flies high and away, instantly.

name: Ekans
description: Ekans is the Snake Pokémon, a Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Ekans stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 15lbs 3oz (6.9kg). The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

name: Arbok
description: Arbok is the Cobra Pokémon, a Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Arbok stands 11'6" (3.5m) tall and weighs 143lbs 5oz (65.0kg). The frightening patterns on its belly have been studied. Six variations have been confirmed.

name: Pikachu
description: Pikachu is the Mouse Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Pikachu stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 13lbs 4oz (6.0kg). Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.

name: Raichu
description: Raichu is the Mouse Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Raichu stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 66lbs 2oz (30.0kg). It can discharge bursts of electricity exceeding 100,000 volts— a single strike with that amount of power would incapacitate one of the Copperajah of my homeland.

name: Sandshrew
description: Sandshrew is the Mouse Pokémon, a Ground-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Sandshrew stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 26lbs 7oz (12.0kg). It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.

name: Sandslash
description: Sandslash is the Mouse Pokémon, a Ground-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Sandslash stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 65lbs 1oz (29.5kg). It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws. Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.

name: Nidoran♀
description: Nidoran-F is the Poison Pin Pokémon, a Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Nidoran-F stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 15lbs 7oz (7.0kg). It uses its hard incisor teeth to crush and eat berries. The tip of a female Nidoran’s horn is a bit more rounded than the tip of a male’s horn.

name: Nidorina
description: Nidorina is the Poison Pin Pokémon, a Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Nidorina stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 44lbs 1oz (20.0kg). If the group is threatened, these Pokémon will band together to assault enemies with a chorus of ultrasonic waves.

name: Nidoqueen
description: Nidoqueen is the Drill Pokémon, a Poison/Ground-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Nidoqueen stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 132lbs 4oz (60.0kg). It pacifies offspring by placing them in the gaps between the spines on its back. The spines will never secrete poison while young are present.

name: Nidoran♂
description: Nidoran-M is the Poison Pin Pokémon, a Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Nidoran-M stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 19lbs 13oz (9.0kg). Small but brave, this Pokémon will hold its ground and even risk its life in battle to protect the female it’s friendly with.

name: Nidorino
description: Nidorino is the Poison Pin Pokémon, a Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Nidorino stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 43lbs (19.5kg). It’s nervous and quick to act aggressively. The potency of its poison increases along with the level of adrenaline present in its body.

name: Nidoking
description: Nidoking is the Drill Pokémon, a Poison/Ground-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Nidoking stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 136lbs 11oz (62.0kg). Nidoking prides itself on its strength. It’s forceful and spirited in battle, making use of its thick tail and diamond-crushing horn.

name: Clefairy
description: Clefairy is the Fairy Pokémon, a Fairy-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Clefairy stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 16lbs 9oz (7.5kg). It can be found in quiet mountain areas on a full moon's night. Its dancing and its tiny, faintly glowing wings confer upon it a lovely fairylike quality.

name: Clefable
description: Clefable is the Fairy Pokémon, a Fairy-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Clefable stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 88lbs 3oz (40.0kg). Legend says that on clear, quiet nights, it listens for the voices of its kin living on the moon. I, too, often think of my homeland, so far away.

name: Vulpix
description: Vulpix is the Fox Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Vulpix stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 21lbs 13oz (9.9kg). In its belly burns a fire, which Vulpix spits out in the form of fireballs. When young, this Pokémon has but one white tail. As the Pokémon matures, this single tail splits into six.

name: Ninetales
description: Ninetales is the Fox Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Ninetales stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 43lbs 14oz (19.9kg). The coat of gleaming golden fur is quite magnificent. This species is said to store sacred power in its nine long tails and to live for a millennium.

name: Jigglypuff
description: Jigglypuff is the Balloon Pokémon, a Normal/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Jigglypuff stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 12lbs 2oz (5.5kg). By freely changing the wavelength of its voice, Jigglypuff sings a mysterious melody sure to make any listener sleepy.

name: Wigglytuff
description: Wigglytuff is the Balloon Pokémon, a Normal/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Wigglytuff stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 26lbs 7oz (12.0kg). It’s proud of its fur, which is fine and delicate. In particular, the curl on its forehead has a texture that’s perfectly heavenly.

name: Zubat
description: Zubat is the Bat Pokémon, a Poison/Flying-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Zubat stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 16lbs 9oz (7.5kg). Makes its home in gloomy caves. Atrophied eyes have left this Pokémon blind, so it scans its surroundings via sound waves that it emits from its mouth as it flies.

name: Golbat
description: Golbat is the Bat Pokémon, a Poison/Flying-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Golbat stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 121lbs 4oz (55.0kg). It sinks its sharp fangs into other creatures and slurps up their blood. A closer look at the fangs reveals that they are hollow and akin to straws.

name: Oddish
description: Oddish is the Weed Pokémon, a Grass/Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Oddish stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 11lbs 14oz (5.4kg). During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

name: Gloom
description: Gloom is the Weed Pokémon, a Grass/Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Gloom stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 18lbs 15oz (8.6kg). What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

name: Vileplume
description: Vileplume is the Flower Pokémon, a Grass/Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Vileplume stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 41lbs (18.6kg). The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

name: Paras
description: Paras is the Mushroom Pokémon, a Bug/Grass-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Paras stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 11lbs 14oz (5.4kg). Sometimes seen at the foot of trees in humid forests. The mushrooms on its back—called tochukaso—are not present on infant specimens and instead emerge as Paras matures.

name: Parasect
description: Parasect is the Mushroom Pokémon, a Bug/Grass-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Parasect stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 65lbs 1oz (29.5kg). Mushroom-lacking specimens of this Pokémon lie unmoving in the forest, lending credence to the hypothesis that the large mushroom is in control of Parasect's actions.

name: Venonat
description: Venonat is the Insect Pokémon, a Bug/Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Venonat stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 66lbs 2oz (30.0kg). Its large eyes act as radar. In a bright place, you can see that they are clusters of many tiny eyes.

name: Venomoth
description: Venomoth is the Poison Moth Pokémon, a Bug/Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Venomoth stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 27lbs 9oz (12.5kg). The powdery scales on its wings are hard to remove from skin. They also contain poison that leaks out on contact.

name: Diglett
description: Diglett is the Mole Pokémon, a Ground-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Diglett stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 1lbs 12oz (0.8kg). It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

name: Dugtrio
description: Dugtrio is the Mole Pokémon, a Ground-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Dugtrio stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 73lbs 7oz (33.3kg). These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it’s like underground.

name: Meowth
description: Meowth is the Scratch Cat Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Meowth stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 9lbs 4oz (4.2kg). It loves to collect shiny things. If it’s in a good mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look at its hoard of treasures.

name: Persian
description: Persian is the Classy Cat Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Persian stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 70lbs 9oz (32.0kg). Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker. The relationship between the two is one of mutual disdain.

name: Psyduck
description: Psyduck is the Duck Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Psyduck stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 43lbs 3oz (19.6kg). Suffers perpetual headaches. If the agony grows too great, Psyduck's latent power erupts, contrary to Psyduck's intent. Ergo, I am exploring ways to ease the pain.

name: Golduck
description: Golduck is the Duck Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Golduck stands 5'7" (1.7m) tall and weighs 168lbs 14oz (76.6kg). Its body is strong, and it has webbing on its hands and feet. Golduck can swim easily through rough seas, clawing its way through the high waves.

name: Mankey
description: Mankey is the Pig Monkey Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Mankey stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 61lbs 12oz (28.0kg). An agile Pokémon that lives in trees. It angers easily and will not hesitate to attack anything.

name: Primeape
description: Primeape is the Pig Monkey Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Primeape stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 70lbs 9oz (32.0kg). It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.

name: Growlithe
description: Growlithe is the Puppy Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Growlithe stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 41lbs 14oz (19.0kg). They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

name: Arcanine
description: Arcanine is the Legendary Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Arcanine stands 6'3" (1.9m) tall and weighs 341lbs 11oz (155.0kg). Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

name: Poliwag
description: Poliwag is the Tadpole Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Poliwag stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 27lbs 5oz (12.4kg). In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon will cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act like a suction cup.

name: Poliwhirl
description: Poliwhirl is the Tadpole Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Poliwhirl stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 44lbs 1oz (20.0kg). This Pokémon’s sweat is a slimy mucus. When captured, Poliwhirl can slither from its enemies’ grasp and escape.

name: Poliwrath
description: Poliwrath is the Tadpole Pokémon, a Water/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Poliwrath stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 119lbs 1oz (54.0kg). Poliwrath is skilled at both swimming and martial arts. It uses its well-trained arms to dish out powerful punches.

name: Abra
description: Abra is the Psi Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Abra stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 43lbs (19.5kg). Spends 18 hours of the day sleeping. Even while asleep, Abra can control its psychic powers—should danger approach, the Pokémon will simply teleport away.

name: Kadabra
description: Kadabra is the Psi Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Kadabra stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 124lbs 9oz (56.5kg). There are rumors that a child with mystical powers became a Kadabra; however, this remains unverified. I suspect that the spoon Kadabra holds enhances its brain waves.

name: Alakazam
description: Alakazam is the Psi Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Alakazam stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 105lbs 13oz (48.0kg). The longer Alakazam lives, the larger and heavier its head becomes. Our tests have shown that the strength of its psychic powers correlates positively to the weight of its head.

name: Machop
description: Machop is the Superpower Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Machop stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 43lbs (19.5kg). Though as small as a child, it has strength enough to easily throw a well-built adult. Striving to become ever stronger, Machop trains by carrying a Graveler on its shoulders.

name: Machoke
description: Machoke is the Superpower Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Machoke stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 155lbs 7oz (70.5kg). A sturdy creature boasting a robust physique and boundless stamina. Loves training above all else and voluntarily assists with tasks such as construction and clearing land.

name: Machamp
description: Machamp is the Superpower Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Machamp stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 286lbs 10oz (130.0kg). In close combat, its four arms afford it offensive and defensive supremacy. In but a blink, this valiant Pokémon can overwhelm its foes with more than 1,000 blows from its fists.

name: Bellsprout
description: Bellsprout is the Flower Pokémon, a Grass/Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Bellsprout stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 8lbs 13oz (4.0kg). Prefers hot and humid places. It ensnares tiny bugs with its vines and devours them.

name: Weepinbell
description: Weepinbell is the Flycatcher Pokémon, a Grass/Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Weepinbell stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 14lbs 2oz (6.4kg). When hungry, it swallows anything that moves. Its hapless prey is dissolved by strong acids.

name: Victreebel
description: Victreebel is the Flycatcher Pokémon, a Grass/Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Victreebel stands 5'7" (1.7m) tall and weighs 34lbs 3oz (15.5kg). Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey. Swallowed whole, the prey is dissolved in a day, bones and all.

name: Tentacool
description: Tentacool is the Jellyfish Pokémon, a Water/Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Tentacool stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 100lbs 5oz (45.5kg). They fire beams from the glassy, magenta orbs that resemble eyes atop their heads, and they drift in shallow seas. During low tide, they can sometimes be found on beaches, desiccated.

name: Tentacruel
description: Tentacruel is the Jellyfish Pokémon, a Water/Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Tentacruel stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 121lbs 4oz (55.0kg). It has 80 tentacles, each with a venomous tip. These tentacles are also extendible, lengthening when Tentacruel attempts to catch prey. Use caution.

name: Geodude
description: Geodude is the Rock Pokémon, a Rock/Ground-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Geodude stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 44lbs 1oz (20.0kg). Makes its home in mountainous regions, using its arms to climb along harsh mountain roads. Can be troublesome—carelessly kicking one will cause it to fly into a rage and chase after you.

name: Graveler
description: Graveler is the Rock Pokémon, a Rock/Ground-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Graveler stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 231lbs 8oz (105.0kg). Dwells in holes dug into sheer walls of stone. It enjoys rolling down slopes as though it were a boulder during a rockfall, so keep an eye upward while traversing mountain roads.

name: Golem
description: Golem is the Megaton Pokémon, a Rock/Ground-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Golem stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 661lbs 6oz (300.0kg). The rocklike shell is shed each year. The cast-off shell then crumbles, reverting to a mass of soil, which can be spread across fields to promote crop growth.

name: Ponyta
description: Ponyta is the Fire Horse Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Ponyta stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 66lbs 2oz (30.0kg). These Pokémon live in herds out in the grassland. Newborn foals lack their fiery manes, which will develop about an hour after birth.

name: Rapidash
description: Rapidash is the Fire Horse Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Rapidash stands 5'7" (1.7m) tall and weighs 209lbs 7oz (95.0kg). Fiery mane aglow, Rapidash darts like an arrow across the land. This prodigiously swift creature can traverse the vast region of Hisui in a day and a half.

name: Slowpoke
description: Slowpoke is the Dopey Pokémon, a Water/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Slowpoke stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 79lbs 6oz (36.0kg). When this Pokémon’s tail is soaked in water, sweetness seeps from it. Slowpoke uses this trait to lure in and fish up other Pokémon.

name: Slowbro
description: Slowbro is the Hermit Crab Pokémon, a Water/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Slowbro stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 173lbs 1oz (78.5kg). Being bitten by a Shellder shocked this Pokémon into standing on two legs. If the Shellder lets go, it seems Slowbro will turn back into a Slowpoke.

name: Magnemite
description: Magnemite is the Magnet Pokémon, a Electric/Steel-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Magnemite stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 13lbs 4oz (6.0kg). A bizarre Pokémon with but a single eye embedded in an iron sphere. I suspect this creature levitates due to the magnetism it emits from its arms, which resemble horseshoe-shaped magnets.

name: Magneton
description: Magneton is the Magnet Pokémon, a Electric/Steel-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Magneton stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 132lbs 4oz (60.0kg). Three Magnemite gathered to evolve into this Pokémon. The source of much vexation on my part, as its powerful magnetism destroys my research equipment.

name: Farfetch'd
description: Farfetch'd is the Wild Duck Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Farfetch'd stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 33lbs 1oz (15.0kg). They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way. Several distinct styles of stalk fighting have been observed.

name: Doduo
description: Doduo is the Twin Bird Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Doduo stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 86lbs 7oz (39.2kg). Its short wings make flying difficult. Instead, this Pokémon runs at high speed on developed legs.

name: Dodrio
description: Dodrio is the Triple Bird Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Dodrio stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 187lbs 13oz (85.2kg). One of Doduo’s two heads splits to form a unique species. It runs close to 40 mph in prairies.

name: Seel
description: Seel is the Sea Lion Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Seel stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 198lbs 7oz (90.0kg). Loves freezing-cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid climate of around 14 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Dewgong
description: Dewgong is the Sea Lion Pokémon, a Water/Ice-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Dewgong stands 5'7" (1.7m) tall and weighs 264lbs 9oz (120.0kg). Its entire body is a snowy white. Unharmed by even intense cold, it swims powerfully in icy waters.

name: Grimer
description: Grimer is the Sludge Pokémon, a Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Grimer stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 66lbs 2oz (30.0kg). Made of congealed sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won’t grow in its path.

name: Muk
description: Muk is the Sludge Pokémon, a Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Muk stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 66lbs 2oz (30.0kg). Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration of its nose, it lost its sense of smell.

name: Shellder
description: Shellder is the Bivalve Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Shellder stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 8lbs 13oz (4.0kg). Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

name: Cloyster
description: Cloyster is the Bivalve Pokémon, a Water/Ice-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Cloyster stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 292lbs 2oz (132.5kg). Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superior strength.

name: Gastly
description: Gastly is the Gas Pokémon, a Ghost/Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Gastly stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 4oz (0.1kg). Gaseous and completely impalpable. Also highly dangerous— inhaling part of its poisonous body will cause one to faint instantly.

name: Haunter
description: Haunter is the Gas Pokémon, a Ghost/Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Haunter stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 4oz (0.1kg). This frightful, malevolent spirit can glide through walls, appearing wherever it likes. According to rumor, victims of a Haunter's lick will wither to death day by day.

name: Gengar
description: Gengar is the Shadow Pokémon, a Ghost/Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Gengar stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 89lbs 5oz (40.5kg). Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!

name: Onix
description: Onix is the Rock Snake Pokémon, a Rock/Ground-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Onix stands 28'10" (8.8m) tall and weighs 463lbs (210.0kg). This chain of immense stones resembles a giant serpent. Tremors shake the earth above as it burrows deep beneath the ground, feeding on boulders as it goes.

name: Drowzee
description: Drowzee is the Hypnosis Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Drowzee stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 71lbs 7oz (32.4kg). If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it had eaten in the past.

name: Hypno
description: Hypno is the Hypnosis Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Hypno stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 166lbs 11oz (75.6kg). Avoid eye contact if you come across one. It will try to put you to sleep by using its pendulum.

name: Krabby
description: Krabby is the River Crab Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Krabby stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 14lbs 5oz (6.5kg). If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

name: Kingler
description: Kingler is the Pincer Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Kingler stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 132lbs 4oz (60.0kg). Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it’s not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.

name: Voltorb
description: Voltorb is the Ball Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Voltorb stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 22lbs 15oz (10.4kg). An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

name: Electrode
description: Electrode is the Ball Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Electrode stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 146lbs 13oz (66.6kg). The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.

name: Exeggcute
description: Exeggcute is the Egg Pokémon, a Grass/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Exeggcute stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 5lbs 8oz (2.5kg). These Pokémon get nervous when they’re not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.

name: Exeggutor
description: Exeggutor is the Coconut Pokémon, a Grass/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Exeggutor stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 264lbs 9oz (120.0kg). When they work together, Exeggutor’s three heads can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.

name: Cubone
description: Cubone is the Lonely Pokémon, a Ground-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Cubone stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 14lbs 5oz (6.5kg). This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased mother. Sometimes Cubone’s dreams make it cry, but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.

name: Marowak
description: Marowak is the Bone Keeper Pokémon, a Ground-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Marowak stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 99lbs 3oz (45.0kg). When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak’s temperament also turned vicious at the same time.

name: Hitmonlee
description: Hitmonlee is the Kicking Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Hitmonlee stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 109lbs 13oz (49.8kg). The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

name: Hitmonchan
description: Hitmonchan is the Punching Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Hitmonchan stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 110lbs 11oz (50.2kg). Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

name: Lickitung
description: Lickitung is the Licking Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Lickitung stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 144lbs 6oz (65.5kg). Wields its long tongue deftly, as though it were an arm. The Pokémon's viscous saliva, once it has been collected and boiled down, yields a strong and highly useful adhesive.

name: Koffing
description: Koffing is the Poison Gas Pokémon, a Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Koffing stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 2lbs 3oz (1.0kg). It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing used to be more plentiful in the Galar region than they are now.

name: Weezing
description: Weezing is the Poison Gas Pokémon, a Poison-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Weezing stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 20lbs 15oz (9.5kg). It can’t suck in air quite as well as a Galarian Weezing, but the toxins it creates are more potent than those of its counterpart.

name: Rhyhorn
description: Rhyhorn is the Spikes Pokémon, a Ground/Rock-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Rhyhorn stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 253lbs 9oz (115.0kg). Ludicrously strong—when it butts heads with a mountain, it is the mountain that shatters. But its short legs struggle with turns, and it is incapable of stopping unless it collides with something.

name: Rhydon
description: Rhydon is the Drill Pokémon, a Ground/Rock-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Rhydon stands 6'3" (1.9m) tall and weighs 264lbs 9oz (120.0kg). Rapidly rotates its horn to bore through bedrock. It swaggers around volcanic regions, protected from the lava's heat by its tough, armorlike hide.

name: Chansey
description: Chansey is the Egg Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Chansey stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 76lbs 4oz (34.6kg). This purehearted Pokémon shares its eggs with the injured.

name: Tangela
description: Tangela is the Vine Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Tangela stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 77lbs 3oz (35.0kg). It is cloaked entirely in blue vines, preventing any glimpse of its true identity. The vines impart a refreshing sensation when chewed—they're useful as a spice.

name: Kangaskhan
description: Kangaskhan is the Parent Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Kangaskhan stands 7'3" (2.2m) tall and weighs 176lbs 6oz (80.0kg). There are records of a lost human child being raised by a childless Kangaskhan.

name: Horsea
description: Horsea is the Dragon Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Horsea stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 17lbs 10oz (8.0kg). They swim with dance-like motions and cause whirlpools to form. Horsea compete to see which of them can generate the biggest whirlpool.

name: Seadra
description: Seadra is the Dragon Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Seadra stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 55lbs 2oz (25.0kg). Seadra’s mouth is slender, but its suction power is strong. In an instant, Seadra can suck in food that’s larger than the opening of its mouth.

name: Goldeen
description: Goldeen is the Goldfish Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Goldeen stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 33lbs 1oz (15.0kg). Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.

name: Seaking
description: Seaking is the Goldfish Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Seaking stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 86lbs (39.0kg). Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.

name: Staryu
description: Staryu is the Star Shape Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Staryu stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 76lbs 1oz (34.5kg). Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn’t bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.

name: Starmie
description: Starmie is the Mysterious Pokémon, a Water/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Starmie stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 176lbs 6oz (80.0kg). Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.

name: Mr. Mime
description: Mr. Mime is the Barrier Pokémon, a Psychic/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Mr. Mime stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 120lbs 2oz (54.5kg). The behavior of this clown-like Pokémon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.

name: Scyther
description: Scyther is the Mantis Pokémon, a Bug/Flying-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Scyther stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 123lbs 7oz (56.0kg). The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.

name: Jynx
description: Jynx is the Human Shape Pokémon, a Ice/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Jynx stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 89lbs 8oz (40.6kg). The Jynx of Galar often have beautiful and delicate voices. Some of these Pokémon have even gathered a fan base.

name: Electabuzz
description: Electabuzz is the Electric Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Electabuzz stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 66lbs 2oz (30.0kg). Feeds on electrical energy. During sudden showers beneath looming thunderclouds, one can observe Electabuzz scaling tall trees, where the Pokémon will then wait for lightning to strike.

name: Magmar
description: Magmar is the Spitfire Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Magmar stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 98lbs 2oz (44.5kg). Legend has it that this Pokémon was born from the crater of a volcano. When wounded, it bathes in lava to heal its body, much as one would soak in a hot spring.

name: Pinsir
description: Pinsir is the Stag Beetle Pokémon, a Bug-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Pinsir stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 121lbs 4oz (55.0kg). This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its prey and then either splits the prey in half or flings it away.

name: Tauros
description: Tauros is the Wild Bull Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Tauros stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 194lbs 14oz (88.4kg). The Tauros of the Galar region are volatile in nature, and they won’t allow people to ride on their backs.

name: Magikarp
description: Magikarp is the Fish Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Magikarp stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 22lbs 1oz (10.0kg). A feeble, pitiful imbecile of a Pokémon that is nonetheless very hardy. Unperturbed by turbid water, it can be found living in all sorts of places.

name: Gyarados
description: Gyarados is the Atrocious Pokémon, a Water/Flying-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Gyarados stands 21'4" (6.5m) tall and weighs 518lbs 1oz (235.0kg). I suspect this Pokémon to be the true identity of a dragon written of in ancient texts, which claimed that it razed an entire village with white-hot beams from its maw.

name: Lapras
description: Lapras is the Transport Pokémon, a Water/Ice-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Lapras stands 8'2" (2.5m) tall and weighs 485lbs (220.0kg). Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

name: Ditto
description: Ditto is the Transform Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Ditto stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 8lbs 13oz (4.0kg). When it encounters another Ditto, it will move faster than normal to duplicate that opponent exactly.

name: Eevee
description: Eevee is the Evolution Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Eevee stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 14lbs 5oz (6.5kg). Harbors the potential to evolve into manifold forms. Within Eevee lies the key to the mysteries of Pokémon evolution—I'm certain of it.

name: Vaporeon
description: Vaporeon is the Bubble Jet Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Vaporeon stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 63lbs 15oz (29.0kg). Tests show that its cells closely resemble water molecules, which perhaps explains its ability to conceal its form while submerged. I believe the origins of mermaid folklore lie with this Pokémon.

name: Jolteon
description: Jolteon is the Lightning Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Jolteon stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 54lbs (24.5kg). Bristles its fur into sharp, needlelike points when enraged. One can hear electricity crackle in its breath when it exhales.

name: Flareon
description: Flareon is the Flame Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Flareon stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 55lbs 2oz (25.0kg). Flames burn within a saclike organ inside this Pokémon. When Flareon inhales, these flames grow in intensity, reaching a mighty 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Porygon
description: Porygon is the Virtual Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Porygon stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 80lbs 7oz (36.5kg). It has no discernible heartbeat and does not seem to draw breath, and yet it appears to function without issue. I cannot even begin to explain this utterly bizarre anomaly.

name: Omanyte
description: Omanyte is the Spiral Pokémon, a Rock/Water-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Omanyte stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 16lbs 9oz (7.5kg). This Pokémon is a member of an ancient, extinct species. Omanyte paddles through water with its 10 tentacles, looking like it’s just drifting along.

name: Omastar
description: Omastar is the Spiral Pokémon, a Rock/Water-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Omastar stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 77lbs 3oz (35.0kg). Omastar’s sharp fangs could crush rock, but the Pokémon can attack only the prey that come within reach of its tentacles.

name: Kabuto
description: Kabuto is the Shellfish Pokémon, a Rock/Water-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Kabuto stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 25lbs 6oz (11.5kg). While some say this species has gone extinct, Kabuto sightings are apparently fairly common in some places.

name: Kabutops
description: Kabutops is the Shellfish Pokémon, a Rock/Water-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Kabutops stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 89lbs 5oz (40.5kg). The cause behind the extinction of this species is unknown. Kabutops were aggressive Pokémon that inhabited warm seas.

name: Aerodactyl
description: Aerodactyl is the Fossil Pokémon, a Rock/Flying-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Aerodactyl stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 130lbs 1oz (59.0kg). Aerodactyl’s sawlike fangs can shred skin to tatters—even the skin of Steel-type Pokémon.

name: Snorlax
description: Snorlax is the Sleeping Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Snorlax stands 6'11" (2.1m) tall and weighs 1014lbs 2oz (460.0kg). This glutton appears in villages without warning and devours the entirety of their rice granaries—such occurrences have long been counted among the gravest of disasters.

name: Articuno
description: Articuno is a Legendary Freeze Pokémon, a Ice/Flying-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Articuno stands 5'7" (1.7m) tall and weighs 122lbs 2oz (55.4kg). This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articuno is said to live in snowy mountains riddled with permafrost.

name: Zapdos
description: Zapdos is a Legendary Electric Pokémon, a Electric/Flying-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Zapdos stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 115lbs 15oz (52.6kg). Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon. It’s said that when Zapdos rubs its feathers together, lightning will fall immediately after.

name: Moltres
description: Moltres is a Legendary Flame Pokémon, a Fire/Flying-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Moltres stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 132lbs 4oz (60.0kg). There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

name: Dratini
description: Dratini is the Dragon Pokémon, a Dragon-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Dratini stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 7lbs 4oz (3.3kg). This Pokémon was long considered to be no more than a myth. The small lump on a Dratini’s forehead is actually a horn that’s still coming in.

name: Dragonair
description: Dragonair is the Dragon Pokémon, a Dragon-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Dragonair stands 13'1" (4.0m) tall and weighs 36lbs 6oz (16.5kg). This Pokémon gathers power in the orbs on its tail and controls the weather. When enshrouded by an aura, Dragonair has a mystical appearance.

name: Dragonite
description: Dragonite is the Dragon Pokémon, a Dragon/Flying-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Dragonite stands 7'3" (2.2m) tall and weighs 463lbs (210.0kg). This Pokémon is known as the Sea Incarnate. Figureheads that resemble Dragonite decorate the bows of many ships.

name: Mewtwo
description: Mewtwo is a Legendary Genetic Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Mewtwo stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 268lbs 15oz (122.0kg). Its DNA is almost the same as Mew’s. However, its size and disposition are vastly different.

name: Mew
description: Mew is a Mythical New Species Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation I. It first appeared in Pokemon Red. Mew stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 8lbs 13oz (4.0kg). When viewed through a microscope, this Pokémon’s short, fine, delicate hair can be seen.

name: Chikorita
description: Chikorita is the Leaf Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Chikorita stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 14lbs 2oz (6.4kg). In battle, Chikorita waves its leaf around to keep the foe at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, becalming the battling Pokémon and creating a cozy, friendly atmosphere all around.

name: Bayleef
description: Bayleef is the Leaf Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Bayleef stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 34lbs 13oz (15.8kg). Bayleef’s neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each tubular leaf is a small shoot of a tree. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.

name: Meganium
description: Meganium is the Herb Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Meganium stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 221lbs 9oz (100.5kg). The fragrance of Meganium’s flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, this Pokémon gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe’s fighting spirit.

name: Cyndaquil
description: Cyndaquil is the Fire Mouse Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Cyndaquil stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 17lbs 7oz (7.9kg). Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.

name: Quilava
description: Quilava is the Volcano Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Quilava stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 41lbs 14oz (19.0kg). This creature's fur is most mysterious—it is wholly impervious to the burning touch of flame. Should Quilava turn its back to you, take heed! Such a posture indicates a forthcoming attack.

name: Typhlosion
description: Typhlosion is the Volcano Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Typhlosion stands 5'7" (1.7m) tall and weighs 175lbs 4oz (79.5kg). Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

name: Totodile
description: Totodile is the Big Jaw Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Totodile stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 20lbs 15oz (9.5kg). Despite the smallness of its body, Totodile’s jaws are very powerful. While the Pokémon may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough power to cause serious injury.

name: Croconaw
description: Croconaw is the Big Jaw Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Croconaw stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 55lbs 2oz (25.0kg). Once Croconaw has clamped its jaws on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like barbed fishhooks, they become impossible to remove when they have sunk in.

name: Feraligatr
description: Feraligatr is the Big Jaw Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Feraligatr stands 7'7" (2.3m) tall and weighs 195lbs 12oz (88.8kg). Feraligatr intimidates its foes by opening its huge mouth. In battle, it will kick the ground hard with its thick and powerful hind legs to charge at the foe at an incredible speed.

name: Sentret
description: Sentret is the Scout Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Sentret stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 13lbs 4oz (6.0kg). When Sentret sleeps, it does so while another stands guard. The sentry wakes the others at the first sign of danger. When this Pokémon becomes separated from its pack, it becomes incapable of sleep due to fear.

name: Furret
description: Furret is the Long Body Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Furret stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 71lbs 10oz (32.5kg). Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can slickly squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, this Pokémon is very nimble and fleet.

name: Hoothoot
description: Hoothoot is the Owl Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Hoothoot stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 46lbs 12oz (21.2kg). It begins to hoot at the same time every day. Some Trainers use them in place of clocks.

name: Noctowl
description: Noctowl is the Owl Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Noctowl stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 89lbs 15oz (40.8kg). When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

name: Ledyba
description: Ledyba is the Five Star Pokémon, a Bug/Flying-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Ledyba stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 23lbs 13oz (10.8kg). These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.

name: Ledian
description: Ledian is the Five Star Pokémon, a Bug/Flying-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Ledian stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 78lbs 8oz (35.6kg). It flies through the night sky, sprinkling sparkly dust. According to some, if that dust sticks to you, good things will happen to you.

name: Spinarak
description: Spinarak is the String Spit Pokémon, a Bug/Poison-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Spinarak stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 18lbs 12oz (8.5kg). Although the poison from its fangs isn’t that strong, it’s potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

name: Ariados
description: Ariados is the Long Leg Pokémon, a Bug/Poison-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Ariados stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 73lbs 14oz (33.5kg). It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

name: Crobat
description: Crobat is the Bat Pokémon, a Poison/Flying-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Crobat stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 165lbs 6oz (75.0kg). Its hind limbs have become another set of wings. Crobat expertly maneuvers its four wings to dart in exquisite fashion through even the most confined caves without losing any speed.

name: Chinchou
description: Chinchou is the Angler Pokémon, a Water/Electric-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Chinchou stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 26lbs 7oz (12.0kg). On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

name: Lanturn
description: Lanturn is the Light Pokémon, a Water/Electric-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Lanturn stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 49lbs 10oz (22.5kg). This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

name: Pichu
description: Pichu is a Baby Tiny Mouse Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Pichu stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 4lbs 7oz (2.0kg). Pichu stores electricity in the sacs on its cheeks but discharges it inadvertently when agitated or excited. Being yet immature, the Pokémon's handling of electricity is rather inept.

name: Cleffa
description: Cleffa is a Baby Star Shape Pokémon, a Fairy-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Cleffa stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 6lbs 10oz (3.0kg). In silhouette, they resemble twinkling starlight. When shooting stars rain from the night sky, Cleffa gather in numbers and dance as though they are indeed incarnations of the stars.

name: Igglybuff
description: Igglybuff is a Baby Balloon Pokémon, a Normal/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Igglybuff stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 2lbs 3oz (1.0kg). Taking advantage of the softness of its body, Igglybuff moves as if bouncing. Its body turns a deep pink when its temperature rises.

name: Togepi
description: Togepi is a Baby Spike Ball Pokémon, a Fairy-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Togepi stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 3lbs 5oz (1.5kg). This ovate creature is frequently mistaken for a moving egg when encountered out in the fields or in the mountains. Its guileless smile soothes the soul.

name: Togetic
description: Togetic is the Happiness Pokémon, a Fairy/Flying-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Togetic stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 7lbs 1oz (3.2kg). No records exist of Togetic being seen in the wilds. Rumors abound that it evolves under the loving care of a trusted human companion, upon whom the Pokémon then bestows great joy.

name: Natu
description: Natu is the Tiny Bird Pokémon, a Psychic/Flying-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Natu stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 4lbs 7oz (2.0kg). Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

name: Xatu
description: Xatu is the Mystic Pokémon, a Psychic/Flying-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Xatu stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 33lbs 1oz (15.0kg). This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.

name: Mareep
description: Mareep is the Wool Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Mareep stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 17lbs 3oz (7.8kg). Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You’ll want to pet it because it’s cute, but if you use your bare hand, you’ll get a painful shock.

name: Flaaffy
description: Flaaffy is the Wool Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Flaaffy stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 29lbs 5oz (13.3kg). It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

name: Ampharos
description: Ampharos is the Light Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Ampharos stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 135lbs 9oz (61.5kg). Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

name: Bellossom
description: Bellossom is the Flower Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Bellossom stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 12lbs 13oz (5.8kg). Bellossom gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

name: Marill
description: Marill is the Aqua Mouse Pokémon, a Water/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Marill stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 18lbs 12oz (8.5kg). Even after Marill swims in a cold sea, its water- repellent fur dries almost as soon as Marill leaves the water. That’s why this Pokémon is never cold.

name: Azumarill
description: Azumarill is the Aqua Rabbit Pokémon, a Water/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Azumarill stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 62lbs 13oz (28.5kg). These Pokémon create air-filled bubbles. When Azurill play in rivers, Azumarill will cover them with these bubbles.

name: Sudowoodo
description: Sudowoodo is the Imitation Pokémon, a Rock-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Sudowoodo stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 83lbs 12oz (38.0kg). Though it pretends to be a tree, it fails to fool even children. To the touch, its body feels more like rock than tree bark. Sudowoodo's extreme aversion to water merits special note.

name: Politoed
description: Politoed is the Frog Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Politoed stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 74lbs 12oz (33.9kg). The cry of a male is louder than that of a female. Male Politoed with deep, menacing voices find more popularity with the opposite gender.

name: Hoppip
description: Hoppip is the Cottonweed Pokémon, a Grass/Flying-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Hoppip stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 1lbs 2oz (0.5kg). This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, Hoppip links its leaves with other Hoppip to prepare against being blown away.

name: Skiploom
description: Skiploom is the Cottonweed Pokémon, a Grass/Flying-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Skiploom stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 2lbs 3oz (1.0kg). Skiploom’s flower blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees Fahrenheit. How much the flower opens depends on the temperature. For that reason, this Pokémon is sometimes used as a thermometer.

name: Jumpluff
description: Jumpluff is the Cottonweed Pokémon, a Grass/Flying-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Jumpluff stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 6lbs 10oz (3.0kg). Jumpluff rides warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. The Pokémon descends to the ground when it encounters cold air while it is floating.

name: Aipom
description: Aipom is the Long Tail Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Aipom stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 25lbs 6oz (11.5kg). This treetop dweller possesses a tail as dexterous as a hand. Ancient writings describe this Pokémon as a one-armed oddity.

name: Sunkern
description: Sunkern is the Seed Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Sunkern stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 3lbs 15oz (1.8kg). Sunkern tries to move as little as it possibly can. It does so because it tries to conserve all the nutrients it has stored in its body for its evolution. It will not eat a thing, subsisting only on morning dew.

name: Sunflora
description: Sunflora is the Sun Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Sunflora stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 18lbs 12oz (8.5kg). Sunflora converts solar energy into nutrition. It moves around actively in the daytime when it is warm. It stops moving as soon as the sun goes down for the night.

name: Yanma
description: Yanma is the Clear Wing Pokémon, a Bug/Flying-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Yanma stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 83lbs 12oz (38.0kg). Its frail wings are so thin that one can see clear through them. However, during flight these wings exhibit the power to churn air with force enough to launch a house skyward.

name: Wooper
description: Wooper is the Water Fish Pokémon, a Water/Ground-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Wooper stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 18lbs 12oz (8.5kg). When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.

name: Quagsire
description: Quagsire is the Water Fish Pokémon, a Water/Ground-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Quagsire stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 165lbs 6oz (75.0kg). Its body is always slimy. It often bangs its head on the river bottom as it swims but seems not to care.

name: Espeon
description: Espeon is the Sun Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Espeon stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 58lbs 7oz (26.5kg). Wields an arcane power with which it can predict the weather and even people's thoughts. When bathed in sunshine, the scarlet orb on its brow glows and builds energy.

name: Umbreon
description: Umbreon is the Moonlight Pokémon, a Dark-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Umbreon stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 59lbs 8oz (27.0kg). It is most active in the wee hours of the night, when moonlight bathes the land. Its large eyes can pierce the darkness and perceive prey with absolute clarity.

name: Murkrow
description: Murkrow is the Darkness Pokémon, a Dark/Flying-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Murkrow stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 4lbs 10oz (2.1kg). Widely shunned as a bearer of ill fortune. Upon crossing paths with this creature, I've been told one must chant ”Workrum, Workrum—bad luck, don't come” as a protective incantation.

name: Slowking
description: Slowking is the Royal Pokémon, a Water/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Slowking stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 175lbs 4oz (79.5kg). Slowking can solve any problem presented to it, but no one can understand a thing Slowking says.

name: Misdreavus
description: Misdreavus is the Screech Pokémon, a Ghost-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Misdreavus stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 2lbs 3oz (1.0kg). It conceals itself in darkness, sending chills up travelers' spines with its childlike weeping. As it observes the frightened travelers with glee, the red orbs upon its chest let off an eerie light.

name: Unown
description: Unown is the Symbol Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Unown stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 11lbs (5.0kg). It is hard to believe these strangely shaped Pokémon are truly living creatures. I've pointed out that the species' many forms resemble writing from other lands; no one will take me seriously.

name: Wobbuffet
description: Wobbuffet is the Patient Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Wobbuffet stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 62lbs 13oz (28.5kg). To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

name: Girafarig
description: Girafarig is the Long Neck Pokémon, a Normal/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Girafarig stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 91lbs 8oz (41.5kg). Girafarig’s rear head contains a tiny brain that is too small for thinking. However, the rear head doesn’t need to sleep, so it can keep watch over its surroundings 24 hours a day.

name: Pineco
description: Pineco is the Bagworm Pokémon, a Bug-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Pineco stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 15lbs 14oz (7.2kg). It sticks tree bark to itself with its saliva, making itself thicker and larger. Elderly Pineco are ridiculously huge.

name: Forretress
description: Forretress is the Bagworm Pokémon, a Bug/Steel-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Forretress stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 277lbs 5oz (125.8kg). In the moment that it gulps down its prey, the inside of its shell is exposed, but to this day, no one has ever seen that sight.

name: Dunsparce
description: Dunsparce is the Land Snake Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Dunsparce stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 30lbs 14oz (14.0kg). The nests Dunsparce live in are mazes of tunnels. They never get lost in their own nests—they can tell where they are by the scent of the dirt.

name: Gligar
description: Gligar is the Fly Scorpion Pokémon, a Ground/Flying-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Gligar stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 142lbs 14oz (64.8kg). Its tail is tipped by a thick, horrible stinger. To bring down prey, it will first obscure their vision by covering their faces with its body, and then it will use the stinger to inject them with venom.

name: Steelix
description: Steelix is the Iron Snake Pokémon, a Steel/Ground-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Steelix stands 30'2" (9.2m) tall and weighs 881lbs 14oz (400.0kg). This Pokémon evolved through use of a strange item. Its body is coated with steel powder and notably hard—not even diamond can leave so much as a scratch.

name: Snubbull
description: Snubbull is the Fairy Pokémon, a Fairy-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Snubbull stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 17lbs 3oz (7.8kg). In contrast to its appearance, it’s quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

name: Granbull
description: Granbull is the Fairy Pokémon, a Fairy-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Granbull stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 107lbs 6oz (48.7kg). Although it’s popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it’s totally incompetent as a watchdog.

name: Qwilfish
description: Qwilfish is the Balloon Pokémon, a Water/Poison-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Qwilfish stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 8lbs 10oz (3.9kg). Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

name: Scizor
description: Scizor is the Pincer Pokémon, a Bug/Steel-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Scizor stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 260lbs 2oz (118.0kg). Evolved by way of a curious item. The shell covering its body has been shown to be stronger than forged steel.

name: Shuckle
description: Shuckle is the Mold Pokémon, a Bug/Rock-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Shuckle stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 45lbs 3oz (20.5kg). The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.

name: Heracross
description: Heracross is the Single Horn Pokémon, a Bug/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Heracross stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 119lbs 1oz (54.0kg). This Pokémon has an unparalleled horn. Heracross itself demonstrates tremendous power—it's capable of throwing several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.

name: Sneasel
description: Sneasel is the Sharp Claw Pokémon, a Dark/Ice-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Sneasel stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 61lbs 12oz (28.0kg). Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.

name: Teddiursa
description: Teddiursa is the Little Bear Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Teddiursa stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 19lbs 6oz (8.8kg). It licks its paws because of the sweet honey that has soaked into them. It is cunning, stealing into the nests of Combee and taking for itself the honey that the Combee have amassed.

name: Ursaring
description: Ursaring is the Hibernator Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Ursaring stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 277lbs 5oz (125.8kg). When the cold season arrives in Hisui, this Pokémon will wander fields and mountains alike in search of its favorite berries. Ursaring's hunger during this time makes it a ferocious danger.

name: Slugma
description: Slugma is the Lava Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Slugma stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 77lbs 3oz (35.0kg). Slugma does not have any blood in its body. Instead, intensely hot magma circulates throughout this Pokémon’s body, carrying essential nutrients and oxygen to its organs.

name: Magcargo
description: Magcargo is the Lava Pokémon, a Fire/Rock-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Magcargo stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 121lbs 4oz (55.0kg). Magcargo’s body temperature is approximately 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. Water is vaporized on contact. If this Pokémon is caught in the rain, the raindrops instantly turn into steam, cloaking the area in a thick fog.

name: Swinub
description: Swinub is the Pig Pokémon, a Ice/Ground-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Swinub stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 14lbs 5oz (6.5kg). Swinub excels at sniffing out mushrooms buried beneath grass or snow. Since ancient times, the people of Hisui have often relied upon this skill.

name: Piloswine
description: Piloswine is the Swine Pokémon, a Ice/Ground-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Piloswine stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 123lbs (55.8kg). The long fur of this Pokémon covers its eyes, ears, and even limbs, allowing Piloswine to resist harshly frigid conditions. The Pokémon's white tusks can be used to defeat its enemies.

name: Corsola
description: Corsola is the Coral Pokémon, a Water/Rock-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Corsola stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 11lbs (5.0kg). These Pokémon live in warm seas. In prehistoric times, many lived in the oceans around the Galar region as well.

name: Remoraid
description: Remoraid is the Jet Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Remoraid stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 26lbs 7oz (12.0kg). Spits water from its mouth with incredible accuracy. It captures Burmy by shooting them down off the branches from which they dangle.

name: Octillery
description: Octillery is the Jet Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Octillery stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 62lbs 13oz (28.5kg). While Octillery still shoots water from its mouth, the drastic anatomical difference between it and Remoraid meant that for a long time, no one believed the former evolved from the latter.

name: Delibird
description: Delibird is the Delivery Pokémon, a Ice/Flying-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Delibird stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 35lbs 4oz (16.0kg). It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it’s always scrounging around for more food.

name: Mantine
description: Mantine is the Kite Pokémon, a Water/Flying-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Mantine stands 6'11" (2.1m) tall and weighs 485lbs (220.0kg). This calm and gentle Pokémon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokémon due to this behavior.

name: Skarmory
description: Skarmory is the Armor Bird Pokémon, a Steel/Flying-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Skarmory stands 5'7" (1.7m) tall and weighs 111lbs 5oz (50.5kg). People fashion swords from Skarmory’s shed feathers, so this Pokémon is a popular element in heraldic designs.

name: Houndour
description: Houndour is the Dark Pokémon, a Dark/Fire-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Houndour stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 23lbs 13oz (10.8kg). They make repeated eerie howls before dawn to call attention to their pack.

name: Houndoom
description: Houndoom is the Dark Pokémon, a Dark/Fire-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Houndoom stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 77lbs 3oz (35.0kg). Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

name: Kingdra
description: Kingdra is the Dragon Pokémon, a Water/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Kingdra stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 335lbs 2oz (152.0kg). Scales shed by this Pokémon have such a splendorous gleam to them that they’ve been given to royalty as gifts.

name: Phanpy
description: Phanpy is the Long Nose Pokémon, a Ground-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Phanpy stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 73lbs 14oz (33.5kg).
