Phanpy uses its long nose to shower itself. When others gather around, they thoroughly douse each other with water. These Pokémon can be seen drying their soaking-wet bodies at the edge of water.

name: Donphan
description: Donphan is the Armor Pokémon, a Ground-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Donphan stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 264lbs 9oz (120.0kg). If Donphan were to tackle with its hard body, even a house could be destroyed. Using its massive strength, the Pokémon helps clear rock and mud slides that block mountain trails.

name: Porygon2
description: Porygon2 is the Virtual Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Porygon2 stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 71lbs 10oz (32.5kg). A bizarre item caused this Pokémon to evolve. While it now exhibits many new gestures and expressions, its biology remains inscrutable.

name: Stantler
description: Stantler is the Big Horn Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Stantler stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 157lbs (71.2kg). Its strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.

name: Smeargle
description: Smeargle is the Painter Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Smeargle stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 127lbs 14oz (58.0kg). It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

name: Tyrogue
description: Tyrogue is a Baby Scuffle Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Tyrogue stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 46lbs 5oz (21.0kg). Even though it is small, it can’t be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

name: Hitmontop
description: Hitmontop is the Handstand Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Hitmontop stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 105lbs 13oz (48.0kg). After doing a handstand to throw off the opponent’s timing, it presents its fancy kick moves.

name: Smoochum
description: Smoochum is a Baby Kiss Pokémon, a Ice/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Smoochum stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 13lbs 4oz (6.0kg). This is a very curious Pokémon. Smoochum decides what it likes and dislikes by touching things with its lips.

name: Elekid
description: Elekid is a Baby Electric Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Elekid stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 51lbs 13oz (23.5kg). They generate electricity by spinning their arms. During a thunderstorm, if one hears the lively voices of children out in the wilderness, what one is actually hearing are the voices of Elekid.

name: Magby
description: Magby is a Baby Live Coal Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Magby stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 47lbs 3oz (21.4kg). This Pokémon lives in volcanic areas. With each breath, sparks spurt from its mouth and nose. When Magby is in good health, its flames gain a yellow tint.

name: Miltank
description: Miltank is the Milk Cow Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Miltank stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 166lbs 7oz (75.5kg). This Pokémon needs to be milked every day, or else it will fall ill. The flavor of Miltank milk changes with the seasons.

name: Blissey
description: Blissey is the Happiness Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Blissey stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 103lbs 3oz (46.8kg). A kindhearted Pokémon that will care for any sick person or Pokémon until their health improves. The eggs it lays are delicious and bring good fortune to those who eat them.

name: Raikou
description: Raikou is a Legendary Thunder Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Raikou stands 6'3" (1.9m) tall and weighs 392lbs 7oz (178.0kg). Raikou embodies the speed of lightning. The roars of this Pokémon send shock waves shuddering through the air and shake the ground as if lightning bolts had come crashing down.

name: Entei
description: Entei is a Legendary Volcano Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Entei stands 6'11" (2.1m) tall and weighs 436lbs 8oz (198.0kg). Entei embodies the passion of magma. This Pokémon is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It sends up massive bursts of fire that utterly consume all that they touch.

name: Suicune
description: Suicune is a Legendary Aurora Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Suicune stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 412lbs 4oz (187.0kg). Suicune embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gracefulness. This Pokémon has the power to purify dirty water.

name: Larvitar
description: Larvitar is the Rock Skin Pokémon, a Rock/Ground-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Larvitar stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 158lbs 12oz (72.0kg). It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

name: Pupitar
description: Pupitar is the Hard Shell Pokémon, a Rock/Ground-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Pupitar stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 335lbs 2oz (152.0kg). It will not stay still, even while it’s a pupa. It already has arms and legs under its solid shell.

name: Tyranitar
description: Tyranitar is the Armor Pokémon, a Rock/Dark-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Tyranitar stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 445lbs 5oz (202.0kg). The quakes caused when it walks make even great mountains crumble and change the surrounding terrain.

name: Lugia
description: Lugia is a Legendary Diving Pokémon, a Psychic/Flying-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Lugia stands 17'1" (5.2m) tall and weighs 476lbs 3oz (216.0kg). Lugia’s wings pack devastating power—a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart regular houses. As a result, this Pokémon chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.

name: Ho-Oh
description: Ho-Oh is a Legendary Rainbow Pokémon, a Fire/Flying-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Ho-Oh stands 12'6" (3.8m) tall and weighs 438lbs 12oz (199.0kg). Ho-Oh’s feathers glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light. These feathers are said to bring happiness to the bearers. This Pokémon is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.

name: Celebi
description: Celebi is a Mythical Time Travel Pokémon, a Psychic/Grass-type species introduced in Generation II. It first appeared in Pokemon Gold. Celebi stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 11lbs (5.0kg). This Pokémon traveled through time to come from the future. It bolsters grass and trees with its own strength, and it can heal wounds, too.

name: Treecko
description: Treecko is the Wood Gecko Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Treecko stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 11lbs (5.0kg). Treecko is cool, calm, and collected—it never panics under any situation. If a bigger foe were to glare at this Pokémon, it would glare right back without conceding an inch of ground.

name: Grovyle
description: Grovyle is the Wood Gecko Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Grovyle stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 47lbs 10oz (21.6kg). This Pokémon adeptly flies from branch to branch in trees. In a forest, no Pokémon can ever hope to catch a fleeing Grovyle however fast they may be.

name: Sceptile
description: Sceptile is the Forest Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Sceptile stands 5'7" (1.7m) tall and weighs 115lbs 1oz (52.2kg). Sceptile has seeds growing on its back. They are said to be bursting with nutrients that revitalize trees. This Pokémon raises the trees in a forest with loving care.

name: Torchic
description: Torchic is the Chick Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Torchic stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 5lbs 8oz (2.5kg). Torchic has a place inside its body where it keeps its flame. Give it a hug—it will be glowing with warmth. This Pokémon is covered all over by a fluffy coat of down.

name: Combusken
description: Combusken is the Young Fowl Pokémon, a Fire/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Combusken stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 43lbs (19.5kg). Combusken battles with the intensely hot flames it spews from its beak and with outstandingly destructive kicks. This Pokémon’s cry is very loud and distracting.

name: Blaziken
description: Blaziken is the Blaze Pokémon, a Fire/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Blaziken stands 6'3" (1.9m) tall and weighs 114lbs 10oz (52.0kg). Blaziken has incredibly strong legs—it can easily clear a 30-story building in one leap. This Pokémon’s blazing punches leave its foes scorched and blackened.

name: Mudkip
description: Mudkip is the Mud Fish Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Mudkip stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 16lbs 12oz (7.6kg). In water, Mudkip breathes using the gills on its cheeks. If it is faced with a tight situation in battle, this Pokémon will unleash its amazing power—it can crush rocks bigger than itself.

name: Marshtomp
description: Marshtomp is the Mud Fish Pokémon, a Water/Ground-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Marshtomp stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 61lbs 12oz (28.0kg). Marshtomp is much faster at traveling through mud than it is at swimming. This Pokémon’s hindquarters exhibit obvious development, giving it the ability to walk on just its hind legs.

name: Swampert
description: Swampert is the Mud Fish Pokémon, a Water/Ground-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Swampert stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 180lbs 9oz (81.9kg). Swampert predicts storms by sensing subtle differences in the sounds of waves and tidal winds with its fins. If a storm is approaching, it piles up boulders to protect itself.

name: Poochyena
description: Poochyena is the Bite Pokémon, a Dark-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Poochyena stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 30lbs (13.6kg). Poochyena is an omnivore—it will eat anything. A distinguishing feature is how large its fangs are compared to its body. This Pokémon tries to intimidate its foes by making the hair on its tail bristle out.

name: Mightyena
description: Mightyena is the Bite Pokémon, a Dark-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Mightyena stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 81lbs 9oz (37.0kg). Mightyena travel and act as a pack in the wild. The memory of its life in the wild compels the Pokémon to obey only those Trainers that it recognizes to possess superior skill.

name: Zigzagoon
description: Zigzagoon is the Tiny Raccoon Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Zigzagoon stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 38lbs 9oz (17.5kg). Zigzagoon that adapted to regions outside Galar acquired this appearance. If you’ve lost something, this Pokémon can likely find it.

name: Linoone
description: Linoone is the Rushing Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Linoone stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 71lbs 10oz (32.5kg). It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.

name: Wurmple
description: Wurmple is the Worm Pokémon, a Bug-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Wurmple stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 7lbs 15oz (3.6kg). Likes sap and is abundant in the wild. Why it evolves into various different forms is unknown. One cannot tell from a Wurmple's appearance which form it will take when it evolves.

name: Silcoon
description: Silcoon is the Cocoon Pokémon, a Bug-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Silcoon stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 22lbs 1oz (10.0kg). Wraps itself in thin strings of silk while it stores energy for evolution. It can't extend its limbs and its movement is slow, but its eyes keep a sharp lookout—Silcoon is always on guard.

name: Beautifly
description: Beautifly is the Butterfly Pokémon, a Bug/Flying-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Beautifly stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 62lbs 10oz (28.4kg). A colorful and incredibly beautiful but also greedy Pokémon. In an effort to keep its favorite food all to itself, it will chase away Combee as they try to gather nectar.

name: Cascoon
description: Cascoon is the Cocoon Pokémon, a Bug-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Cascoon stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 25lbs 6oz (11.5kg). The silk coating its body is thin but sufficiently strong. Cascoon's silk has a luster and texture superior to that of Silcoon's, and clothes made using Cascoon silk are regarded as top-notch.

name: Dustox
description: Dustox is the Poison Moth Pokémon, a Bug/Poison-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Dustox stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 69lbs 11oz (31.6kg). Tends to be drawn to bonfires on dark nights. Difficult to chase away from settlements because of the way it scatters highly toxic scales.

name: Lotad
description: Lotad is the Water Weed Pokémon, a Water/Grass-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Lotad stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 5lbs 12oz (2.6kg). Its leaf grew too large for it to live on land. That is how it began to live floating in the water.

name: Lombre
description: Lombre is the Jolly Pokémon, a Water/Grass-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Lombre stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 71lbs 10oz (32.5kg). It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

name: Ludicolo
description: Ludicolo is the Carefree Pokémon, a Water/Grass-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Ludicolo stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 121lbs 4oz (55.0kg). If it hears festive music, it begins moving in rhythm in order to amplify its power.

name: Seedot
description: Seedot is the Acorn Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Seedot stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 8lbs 13oz (4.0kg). It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.

name: Nuzleaf
description: Nuzleaf is the Wily Pokémon, a Grass/Dark-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Nuzleaf stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 61lbs 12oz (28.0kg). They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of Nuzleaf’s grass flute fills listeners with dread.

name: Shiftry
description: Shiftry is the Wicked Pokémon, a Grass/Dark-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Shiftry stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 131lbs 6oz (59.6kg). It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.

name: Taillow
description: Taillow is the Tiny Swallow Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Taillow stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 5lbs 1oz (2.3kg). Taillow is young—it has only just left its nest. As a result, it sometimes becomes lonesome and cries at night. This Pokémon feeds on Wurmple that live in forests.

name: Swellow
description: Swellow is the Swallow Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Swellow stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 43lbs 10oz (19.8kg). Swellow is very conscientious about the upkeep of its glossy wings. Once two Swellow are gathered, they diligently take care of cleaning each other’s wings.

name: Wingull
description: Wingull is the Seagull Pokémon, a Water/Flying-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Wingull stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 20lbs 15oz (9.5kg). It soars on updrafts without flapping its wings. It makes a nest on sheer cliffs at the sea’s edge.

name: Pelipper
description: Pelipper is the Water Bird Pokémon, a Water/Flying-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Pelipper stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 61lbs 12oz (28.0kg). Skimming the water’s surface, it dips its large bill in the sea, scoops up food and water, and carries it.

name: Ralts
description: Ralts is the Feeling Pokémon, a Psychic/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Ralts stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 14lbs 9oz (6.6kg). Tends to prefer people with a chipper disposition to those who are gloomy, but it has shown no discrimination with regard to age or gender. Needs more research.

name: Kirlia
description: Kirlia is the Emotion Pokémon, a Psychic/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Kirlia stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 44lbs 9oz (20.2kg). It resembles a maiden in appearance, but it wields strange powers to project visions of paradise. I suspect the crimson ornaments on its head are the key to its abilities.

name: Gardevoir
description: Gardevoir is the Embrace Pokémon, a Psychic/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Gardevoir stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 106lbs 11oz (48.4kg). It will dedicate itself to defending a master it has come to adore. Its pure white dress, reminiscent of those worn by ladies of nobility, is the dress of one who is willing to risk their life.

name: Surskit
description: Surskit is the Pond Skater Pokémon, a Bug/Water-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Surskit stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 3lbs 12oz (1.7kg). It lives in ponds and marshes that feature lots of plant life. It often fights with Dewpider, whose habitat and diet are similar.

name: Masquerain
description: Masquerain is the Eyeball Pokémon, a Bug/Flying-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Masquerain stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 7lbs 15oz (3.6kg). Its thin, winglike antennae are highly absorbent. It waits out rainy days in tree hollows.

name: Shroomish
description: Shroomish is the Mushroom Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Shroomish stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 9lbs 15oz (4.5kg). If Shroomish senses danger, it shakes its body and scatters spores from the top of its head. This Pokémon’s spores are so toxic, they make trees and weeds wilt.

name: Breloom
description: Breloom is the Mushroom Pokémon, a Grass/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Breloom stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 86lbs 7oz (39.2kg). The seeds ringing Breloom’s tail are made of hardened toxic spores. It is horrible to eat the seeds. Just taking a bite of this Pokémon’s seed will cause your stomach to rumble.

name: Slakoth
description: Slakoth is the Slacker Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Slakoth stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 52lbs 15oz (24.0kg). Slakoth’s heart beats just once a minute. Whatever happens, it is content to loaf around motionless. It is rare to see this Pokémon in motion.

name: Vigoroth
description: Vigoroth is the Wild Monkey Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Vigoroth stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 102lbs 8oz (46.5kg). Vigoroth is simply incapable of remaining still. Even when it tries to sleep, the blood in its veins grows agitated, compelling this Pokémon to run wild throughout the jungle before it can settle down.

name: Slaking
description: Slaking is the Lazy Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Slaking stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 287lbs 11oz (130.5kg). Wherever Slaking live, rings of over a yard in diameter appear in grassy fields. They are made by the Pokémon as it eats all the grass within reach while lying prone on the ground.

name: Nincada
description: Nincada is the Trainee Pokémon, a Bug/Ground-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Nincada stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 12lbs 2oz (5.5kg). It can sometimes live underground for more than 10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees.

name: Ninjask
description: Ninjask is the Ninja Pokémon, a Bug/Flying-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Ninjask stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 26lbs 7oz (12.0kg). This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.

name: Shedinja
description: Shedinja is the Shed Pokémon, a Bug/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Shedinja stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 2lbs 10oz (1.2kg). A strange Pokémon—it flies without moving its wings, has a hollow shell for a body, and does not breathe.

name: Whismur
description: Whismur is the Whisper Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Whismur stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 35lbs 15oz (16.3kg). When Whismur cries, the sound of its own voice startles it, making the Pokémon cry even louder. It cries until it’s exhausted, then it falls asleep.

name: Loudred
description: Loudred is the Big Voice Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Loudred stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 89lbs 5oz (40.5kg). The force of this Pokémon’s loud voice isn’t just the sound—it’s also the wave of air pressure that blows opponents away and damages them.

name: Exploud
description: Exploud is the Loud Noise Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Exploud stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 185lbs 3oz (84.0kg). This Pokémon can do more than just shout. To communicate with others of its kind, it’ll emit all sorts of sounds from the holes in its body.

name: Makuhita
description: Makuhita is the Guts Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Makuhita stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 190lbs 8oz (86.4kg). There’s a rumor of a traditional recipe for stew that Trainers can use to raise strong Makuhita.

name: Hariyama
description: Hariyama is the Arm Thrust Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Hariyama stands 7'7" (2.3m) tall and weighs 559lbs 9oz (253.8kg). Hariyama that are big and fat aren’t necessarily strong. There are some small ones that move nimbly and use moves skillfully.

name: Azurill
description: Azurill is a Baby Polka Dot Pokémon, a Normal/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Azurill stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 4lbs 7oz (2.0kg). Although Azurill are normally docile, an angry one will swing around the big ball on its tail and try to smash its opponents.

name: Nosepass
description: Nosepass is the Compass Pokémon, a Rock-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Nosepass stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 213lbs 14oz (97.0kg). Once the people of Hisui discovered that its red nose always points north, they grew to rely on it greatly when traveling afar. The nose seems to work in a similar way to ancient compasses.

name: Skitty
description: Skitty is the Kitten Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Skitty stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 24lbs 4oz (11.0kg). Skitty is known to chase around playfully after its own tail. In the wild, this Pokémon lives in holes in the trees of forests. It is very popular as a pet because of its adorable looks.

name: Delcatty
description: Delcatty is the Prim Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Delcatty stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 71lbs 14oz (32.6kg). Delcatty sleeps anywhere it wants without keeping a permanent nest. If other Pokémon approach it as it sleeps, this Pokémon will never fight—it will just move away somewhere else.

name: Sableye
description: Sableye is the Darkness Pokémon, a Dark/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Sableye stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 24lbs 4oz (11.0kg). It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

name: Mawile
description: Mawile is the Deceiver Pokémon, a Steel/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Mawile stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 25lbs 6oz (11.5kg). It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

name: Aron
description: Aron is the Iron Armor Pokémon, a Steel/Rock-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Aron stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 132lbs 4oz (60.0kg). When Aron evolves, its steel armor peels off. In ancient times, people would collect Aron’s shed armor and make good use of it in their daily lives.

name: Lairon
description: Lairon is the Iron Armor Pokémon, a Steel/Rock-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Lairon stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 264lbs 9oz (120.0kg). During territorial disputes, Lairon fight by slamming into each other. Close inspection of their steel armor reveals scratches and dents.

name: Aggron
description: Aggron is the Iron Armor Pokémon, a Steel/Rock-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Aggron stands 6'11" (2.1m) tall and weighs 793lbs 11oz (360.0kg). Long ago, there was a king who wore a helmet meant to resemble the head of an Aggron. He was trying to channel the Pokémon’s strength.

name: Meditite
description: Meditite is the Meditate Pokémon, a Fighting/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Meditite stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 24lbs 11oz (11.2kg). Meditite heightens its inner energy through meditation. It survives on just one berry a day. Minimal eating is another aspect of this Pokémon’s training.

name: Medicham
description: Medicham is the Meditate Pokémon, a Fighting/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Medicham stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 69lbs 7oz (31.5kg). Through the power of meditation, Medicham developed its sixth sense. It gained the ability to use psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon is known to meditate for a whole month without eating.

name: Electrike
description: Electrike is the Lightning Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Electrike stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 33lbs 8oz (15.2kg). It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.

name: Manectric
description: Manectric is the Discharge Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Manectric stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 88lbs 10oz (40.2kg). It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.

name: Plusle
description: Plusle is the Cheering Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Plusle stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 9lbs 4oz (4.2kg). When Plusle is cheering on its partner, it flashes with electric sparks from all over its body. If its partner loses, this Pokémon cries loudly.

name: Minun
description: Minun is the Cheering Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Minun stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 9lbs 4oz (4.2kg). Minun loves to cheer on its partner in battle. It gives off sparks from its body while it is doing so. If its partner is in trouble, this Pokémon gives off increasing amounts of sparks.

name: Volbeat
description: Volbeat is the Firefly Pokémon, a Bug-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Volbeat stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 39lbs (17.7kg). Volbeat’s tail glows like a lightbulb. With other Volbeat, it uses its tail to draw geometric shapes in the night sky. This Pokémon loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

name: Illumise
description: Illumise is the Firefly Pokémon, a Bug-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Illumise stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 39lbs (17.7kg). Illumise leads a flight of illuminated Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. This Pokémon is said to earn greater respect from its peers by composing more complex designs in the sky.

name: Roselia
description: Roselia is the Thorn Pokémon, a Grass/Poison-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Roselia stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 4lbs 7oz (2.0kg). Though beautiful, it has highly poisonous thorns. There is an old tradition in my homeland wherein one would send these thorns to an opponent to challenge them to a duel.

name: Gulpin
description: Gulpin is the Stomach Pokémon, a Poison-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Gulpin stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 22lbs 11oz (10.3kg). Most of Gulpin’s body is made up of its stomach—its heart and brain are very small in comparison. This Pokémon’s stomach contains special enzymes that dissolve anything.

name: Swalot
description: Swalot is the Poison Bag Pokémon, a Poison-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Swalot stands 5'7" (1.7m) tall and weighs 176lbs 6oz (80.0kg). Swalot has no teeth, so what it eats, it swallows whole, no matter what. Its cavernous mouth yawns widely. An automobile tire could easily fit inside this Pokémon’s mouth.

name: Carvanha
description: Carvanha is the Savage Pokémon, a Water/Dark-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Carvanha stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 45lbs 14oz (20.8kg). These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

name: Sharpedo
description: Sharpedo is the Brutal Pokémon, a Water/Dark-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Sharpedo stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 195lbs 12oz (88.8kg). This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sea. Any ship entering the waters Sharpedo calls home will be attacked—no exceptions.

name: Wailmer
description: Wailmer is the Ball Whale Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Wailmer stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 286lbs 10oz (130.0kg). When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

name: Wailord
description: Wailord is the Float Whale Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Wailord stands 47'7" (14.5m) tall and weighs 877lbs 7oz (398.0kg). Its immense size is the reason for its popularity. Wailord watching is a favorite sightseeing activity in various parts of the world.

name: Numel
description: Numel is the Numb Pokémon, a Fire/Ground-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Numel stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 52lbs 15oz (24.0kg). Numel stores magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit within its body. If it gets wet, the magma cools and hardens. In that event, the Pokémon’s body grows heavy and its movements become sluggish.

name: Camerupt
description: Camerupt is the Eruption Pokémon, a Fire/Ground-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Camerupt stands 6'3" (1.9m) tall and weighs 485lbs (220.0kg). The humps on Camerupt’s back are formed by a transformation of its bones. They sometimes blast out molten magma. This Pokémon apparently erupts often when it is enraged.

name: Torkoal
description: Torkoal is the Coal Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Torkoal stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 177lbs 4oz (80.4kg). You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.

name: Spoink
description: Spoink is the Bounce Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Spoink stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 67lbs 7oz (30.6kg). Spoink keeps a pearl on top of its head. The pearl functions to amplify this Pokémon’s psychokinetic powers. It is therefore on a constant search for a bigger pearl.

name: Grumpig
description: Grumpig is the Manipulate Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Grumpig stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 157lbs 10oz (71.5kg). Grumpig uses the black pearls on its body to wield its fantastic powers. When it is doing so, it dances bizarrely. This Pokémon’s black pearls are valuable as works of art.

name: Spinda
description: Spinda is the Spot Panda Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Spinda stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 11lbs (5.0kg). Each Spinda’s spot pattern is different. With its stumbling movements, it evades opponents’ attacks brilliantly!

name: Trapinch
description: Trapinch is the Ant Pit Pokémon, a Ground-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Trapinch stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 33lbs 1oz (15.0kg). It makes an inescapable conical pit and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

name: Vibrava
description: Vibrava is the Vibration Pokémon, a Ground/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Vibrava stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 33lbs 12oz (15.3kg). To help make its wings grow, it dissolves quantities of prey in its digestive juices and guzzles them down every day.

name: Flygon
description: Flygon is the Mystic Pokémon, a Ground/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Flygon stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 180lbs 12oz (82.0kg). It is nicknamed the Desert Spirit because the flapping of its wings sounds like a woman singing.

name: Cacnea
description: Cacnea is the Cactus Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Cacnea stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 113lbs 2oz (51.3kg). The more arid and harsh the environment, the more pretty and fragrant a flower Cacnea grows. This Pokémon battles by wildly swinging its thorny arms.

name: Cacturne
description: Cacturne is the Scarecrow Pokémon, a Grass/Dark-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Cacturne stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 170lbs 10oz (77.4kg). If a traveler is going through a desert in the thick of night, Cacturne will follow in a ragtag group. The Pokémon are biding their time, waiting for the traveler to tire and become incapable of moving.

name: Swablu
description: Swablu is the Cotton Bird Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Swablu stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 2lbs 10oz (1.2kg). Since Swablu looks like a cumulus cloud, foes can have a hard time finding it. Apparently its wings turned white over many generations.

name: Altaria
description: Altaria is the Humming Pokémon, a Dragon/Flying-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Altaria stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 45lbs 7oz (20.6kg). This Pokémon has a kind disposition, but if it’s provoked, it will threaten opponents with shrill cries before attacking them without mercy.

name: Zangoose
description: Zangoose is the Cat Ferret Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Zangoose stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 88lbs 14oz (40.3kg). Zangoose usually stays on all fours, but when angered, it gets up on its hind legs and extends its claws. This Pokémon shares a bitter rivalry with Seviper that dates back over generations.

name: Seviper
description: Seviper is the Fang Snake Pokémon, a Poison-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Seviper stands 8'10" (2.7m) tall and weighs 115lbs 12oz (52.5kg). Seviper’s swordlike tail serves two purposes—it slashes foes and douses them with secreted poison. This Pokémon will not give up its long-running blood feud with Zangoose.

name: Lunatone
description: Lunatone is the Meteorite Pokémon, a Rock/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Lunatone stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 370lbs 6oz (168.0kg). It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

name: Solrock
description: Solrock is the Meteorite Pokémon, a Rock/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Solrock stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 339lbs 8oz (154.0kg). Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

name: Barboach
description: Barboach is the Whiskers Pokémon, a Water/Ground-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Barboach stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 4lbs 3oz (1.9kg). Makes its home in swamps with murky water. The poor visibility hides this Pokémon from predators, and the slime on its body makes grasping it difficult.

name: Whiscash
description: Whiscash is the Whiskers Pokémon, a Water/Ground-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Whiscash stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 52lbs (23.6kg). Strikes its caudal fin against the swamp bed to shake the ground and startle its prey. It will then swallow the fleeing prey whole. People mistook this behavior as the cause of earthquakes.

name: Corphish
description: Corphish is the Ruffian Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Corphish stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 25lbs 6oz (11.5kg). It was originally a Pokémon from afar that escaped to the wild. It can adapt to the dirtiest river.

name: Crawdaunt
description: Crawdaunt is the Rogue Pokémon, a Water/Dark-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Crawdaunt stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 72lbs 5oz (32.8kg). A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It will crash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.

name: Baltoy
description: Baltoy is the Clay Doll Pokémon, a Ground/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Baltoy stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 47lbs 6oz (21.5kg). It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

name: Claydol
description: Claydol is the Clay Doll Pokémon, a Ground/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Claydol stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 238lbs 2oz (108.0kg). It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

name: Lileep
description: Lileep is the Sea Lily Pokémon, a Rock/Grass-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Lileep stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 52lbs 8oz (23.8kg). Lileep clings to rocks on the seabed. When prey comes close, this Pokémon entangles it with petallike tentacles.

name: Cradily
description: Cradily is the Barnacle Pokémon, a Rock/Grass-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Cradily stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 133lbs 3oz (60.4kg). Once Cradily catches prey in its tentacles, it digests them whole and absorbs their nutrients.

name: Anorith
description: Anorith is the Old Shrimp Pokémon, a Rock/Bug-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Anorith stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 27lbs 9oz (12.5kg). Anorith can swim swiftly by pulling its eight wings through the water like oars on a boat. This Pokémon is an ancestor of modern bug Pokémon.

name: Armaldo
description: Armaldo is the Plate Pokémon, a Rock/Bug-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Armaldo stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 150lbs 6oz (68.2kg). Though it lives on land, it’s also a good swimmer. It dives into the ocean in search of prey, using its sharp claws to take down its quarry.

name: Feebas
description: Feebas is the Fish Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Feebas stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 16lbs 5oz (7.4kg). It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

name: Milotic
description: Milotic is the Tender Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Milotic stands 20'4" (6.2m) tall and weighs 357lbs 2oz (162.0kg). It’s said that a glimpse of a Milotic and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you’re feeling.

name: Castform
description: Castform is the Weather Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Castform stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 1lbs 12oz (0.8kg). Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform’s disposition!

name: Kecleon
description: Kecleon is the Color Swap Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Kecleon stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 48lbs 8oz (22.0kg). Its color changes for concealment and also when its mood or health changes. The darker the color, the healthier it is.

name: Shuppet
description: Shuppet is the Puppet Pokémon, a Ghost-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Shuppet stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 5lbs 1oz (2.3kg). There’s a proverb that says, “Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk.”

name: Banette
description: Banette is the Marionette Pokémon, a Ghost-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Banette stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 27lbs 9oz (12.5kg). Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

name: Duskull
description: Duskull is the Requiem Pokémon, a Ghost-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Duskull stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 33lbs 1oz (15.0kg). I've heard that the children of Hisui all begin to behave once they've been told the story of how this Pokémon roams about before the witching hour to spirit away misbehaving children.

name: Dusclops
description: Dusclops is the Beckon Pokémon, a Ghost-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Dusclops stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 67lbs 7oz (30.6kg). There are rumors that peeking inside its bandage-wrapped body will cause one to get pulled in through the gaps between the bandages, never to return. I've been too scared to verify.

name: Tropius
description: Tropius is the Fruit Pokémon, a Grass/Flying-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Tropius stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 220lbs 7oz (100.0kg). Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.

name: Chimecho
description: Chimecho is the Wind Chime Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Chimecho stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 2lbs 3oz (1.0kg). Can emit waves of air powerful enough to knock out prey taller than itself. I hypothesize that it amplifies the faint sound of wind within its body.

name: Absol
description: Absol is the Disaster Pokémon, a Dark-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Absol stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 103lbs 10oz (47.0kg). Because of this Pokémon’s ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

name: Wynaut
description: Wynaut is a Baby Bright Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Wynaut stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 30lbs 14oz (14.0kg). It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

name: Snorunt
description: Snorunt is the Snow Hat Pokémon, a Ice-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Snorunt stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 37lbs 1oz (16.8kg). Arrives alongside the first snow. It's thought that homes Snorunt visit will prosper for many generations. By tradition, one might offer a lump of ice made from pure water at one's front door.

name: Glalie
description: Glalie is the Face Pokémon, a Ice-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Glalie stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 565lbs 8oz (256.5kg). It covers its body with an armor of ice harder than steel. Uses its breath to freeze prey, which it then devours as if they were frozen desserts.

name: Spheal
description: Spheal is the Clap Pokémon, a Ice/Water-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Spheal stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 87lbs 1oz (39.5kg). During the season when drift ice approaches the shore, Spheal prefers living on the ice—where fewer predators lurk—rather than the land. Its fur retains heat superbly and resists harsh cold.

name: Sealeo
description: Sealeo is the Ball Roll Pokémon, a Ice/Water-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Sealeo stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 193lbs 2oz (87.6kg). Its white whiskers are very sensitive. Sealeo will balance Spheal on the tip of its nose, checking its scent and its feel to be sure the Spheal is healthy.

name: Walrein
description: Walrein is the Ice Break Pokémon, a Ice/Water-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Walrein stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 332lbs (150.6kg). Its thick tusks are strong enough to shatter drift ice. They have been known to break, but they will grow back by the next year. The Hisui region is well known for these broken tusks.

name: Clamperl
description: Clamperl is the Bivalve Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Clamperl stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 115lbs 12oz (52.5kg). Clamperl’s pearls are exceedingly precious. They can be more than 10 times as costly as Shellder’s pearls.

name: Huntail
description: Huntail is the Deep Sea Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Huntail stands 5'7" (1.7m) tall and weighs 59lbs 8oz (27.0kg). Deep seas are their habitat. According to tradition, when Huntail wash up onshore, something unfortunate will happen.

name: Gorebyss
description: Gorebyss is the South Sea Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Gorebyss stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 49lbs 13oz (22.6kg). It sucks bodily fluids out of its prey. The leftover meat sinks to the seafloor, where it becomes food for other Pokémon.

name: Relicanth
description: Relicanth is the Longevity Pokémon, a Water/Rock-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Relicanth stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 51lbs 9oz (23.4kg). This Pokémon was discovered during deep-sea exploration. Its appearance hasn’t changed in 100,000,000 years, so it’s called a living fossil.

name: Luvdisc
description: Luvdisc is the Rendezvous Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Luvdisc stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 19lbs 3oz (8.7kg). Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola’s branches.

name: Bagon
description: Bagon is the Rock Head Pokémon, a Dragon-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Bagon stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 92lbs 13oz (42.1kg). Bagon is a solitary Pokémon that doesn’t form groups with others of its kind. It also has a head hard enough to cleave a boulder in one strike.

name: Shelgon
description: Shelgon is the Endurance Pokémon, a Dragon-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Shelgon stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 243lbs 10oz (110.5kg). Shelgon ignores its hunger entirely, never eating any food. Apparently, Shelgon will evolve once all its energy stores are used up.

name: Salamence
description: Salamence is the Dragon Pokémon, a Dragon/Flying-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Salamence stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 226lbs 3oz (102.6kg). While basking in the joy of flight generally keeps this Pokémon in high spirits, Salamence turns into an uncontrollable menace if something angers it.

name: Beldum
description: Beldum is the Iron Ball Pokémon, a Steel/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Beldum stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 209lbs 14oz (95.2kg). The cells in this Pokémon’s body are composed of magnetic material. Instead of blood, magnetic forces flow through Beldum’s body.

name: Metang
description: Metang is the Iron Claw Pokémon, a Steel/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Metang stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 446lbs 7oz (202.5kg). Using magnetic forces to stay aloft, this Pokémon flies at high speeds, weaving through harsh mountain terrain in pursuit of prey.

name: Metagross
description: Metagross is the Iron Leg Pokémon, a Steel/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Metagross stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 1212lbs 9oz (550.0kg). Metagross is the result of the fusion of two Metang. This Pokémon defeats its opponents through use of its supercomputer-level brain.

name: Regirock
description: Regirock is a Legendary Rock Peak Pokémon, a Rock-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Regirock stands 5'7" (1.7m) tall and weighs 507lbs 1oz (230.0kg). Cutting-edge technology was used to study the internals of this Pokémon’s rock body, but nothing was found—not even a brain or a heart.

name: Regice
description: Regice is a Legendary Iceberg Pokémon, a Ice-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Regice stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 385lbs 13oz (175.0kg). This Pokémon’s body is made of solid ice. It’s said that Regice was born beneath thick ice in the ice age.

name: Registeel
description: Registeel is a Legendary Iron Pokémon, a Steel-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Registeel stands 6'3" (1.9m) tall and weighs 451lbs 15oz (205.0kg). It’s rumored that this Pokémon was born deep underground in the planet’s mantle and that it emerged onto the surface 10,000 years ago.

name: Latias
description: Latias is a Legendary Eon Pokémon, a Dragon/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Latias stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 88lbs 3oz (40.0kg). Latias is highly intelligent and capable of understanding human speech. It is covered with a glass-like down. The Pokémon enfolds its body with its down and refracts light to alter its appearance.

name: Latios
description: Latios is a Legendary Eon Pokémon, a Dragon/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Latios stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 132lbs 4oz (60.0kg). Latios will only open its heart to a Trainer with a compassionate spirit. This Pokémon can fly faster than a jet plane by folding its forelegs to minimize air resistance.

name: Kyogre
description: Kyogre is a Legendary Sea Basin Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Kyogre stands 14'9" (4.5m) tall and weighs 776lbs (352.0kg). Kyogre is said to be the personification of the sea itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Groudon, as each sought to gain the power of nature.

name: Groudon
description: Groudon is a Legendary Continent Pokémon, a Ground-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Groudon stands 11'6" (3.5m) tall and weighs 2094lbs 6oz (950.0kg). Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can cause magma to erupt and expand the landmass of the world.

name: Rayquaza
description: Rayquaza is a Legendary Sky High Pokémon, a Dragon/Flying-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Rayquaza stands 23' (7.0m) tall and weighs 455lbs 4oz (206.5kg). It flies forever through the ozone layer, consuming meteoroids for sustenance. The many meteoroids in its body provide the energy it needs to Mega Evolve.

name: Jirachi
description: Jirachi is a Mythical Wish Pokémon, a Steel/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Jirachi stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 2lbs 7oz (1.1kg). It’s believed that when this Pokémon wakes from its 1,000-year slumber, it will grant any wishes written on the notes attached to its head.

name: Deoxys
description: Deoxys is a Mythical DNA Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation III. It first appeared in Pokemon Ruby. Deoxys stands 5'7" (1.7m) tall and weighs 134lbs 1oz (60.8kg). Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and wields psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon shoots lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.

name: Turtwig
description: Turtwig is the Tiny Leaf Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Turtwig stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 22lbs 8oz (10.2kg). This Pokémon becomes more energetic the more sunlight there is. The part resembling a shell is similar to silt and is slightly damp and warm to the touch.

name: Grotle
description: Grotle is the Grove Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Grotle stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 213lbs 14oz (97.0kg). Appears where there is clean spring water. The fruit that grows on the shrubs on its shell is sweet, nutritious, and truly delicious.

name: Torterra
description: Torterra is the Continent Pokémon, a Grass/Ground-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Torterra stands 7'3" (2.2m) tall and weighs 683lbs 7oz (310.0kg). This remarkable, large-bodied Pokémon would serve beautifully as borrowed scenery for a garden, and its strength is peerless. Torterra roams the wilderness in search of clean water.

name: Chimchar
description: Chimchar is the Chimp Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Chimchar stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 13lbs 11oz (6.2kg). Full of vigor and always in high spirits. It was once known by the name ”Lantern-Tail” and feared as some kind of apparition.

name: Monferno
description: Monferno is the Playful Pokémon, a Fire/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Monferno stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 48lbs 8oz (22.0kg). The deeper the blue on its face, the more powerful it will grow to become. It leaps about every which way and lands powerful blows against its opponents with the flame on its tail.

name: Infernape
description: Infernape is the Flame Pokémon, a Fire/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Infernape stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 121lbs 4oz (55.0kg). A tall, hardy Pokémon with a dazzling appearance. It shrouds itself in flame and battles as if engaged in dance—truly a sight to behold.

name: Piplup
description: Piplup is the Penguin Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Piplup stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 11lbs 7oz (5.2kg). Prefers cold climes and appears along coasts. It's an adorable little thing—as cute as any child—but it's also prideful, unwilling to accept handouts from people.

name: Prinplup
description: Prinplup is the Penguin Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Prinplup stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 50lbs 11oz (23.0kg). It swims gracefully through the frigid sea and sings with a voice like the roaring tide. It has powerful, sturdy wings and dignity to match.

name: Empoleon
description: Empoleon is the Emperor Pokémon, a Water/Steel-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Empoleon stands 5'7" (1.7m) tall and weighs 186lbs 5oz (84.5kg). Since ancient times, it has been revered by the people of Hisui, who call it the Master of the Waves. Its wings are a match for even master-crafted blades.

name: Starly
description: Starly is the Starling Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Starly stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 4lbs 7oz (2.0kg). They live in the fields and mountains, gathering in large flocks. Their cries are quite obnoxious. Though small, their wings are strong—a strike from them leaves pain that persists for a week.

name: Staravia
description: Staravia is the Starling Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Staravia stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 34lbs 3oz (15.5kg). They form remarkably large flocks and are constantly fighting amongst themselves. I suspect that those with magnificent plumes on their heads are the strong ones.

name: Staraptor
description: Staraptor is the Predator Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Staraptor stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 54lbs 14oz (24.9kg). It has left the flock, having gained strength enough to survive on its own. The astounding force with which Staraptor flies through the air allows it to carry away large, burly targets.

name: Bidoof
description: Bidoof is the Plump Mouse Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Bidoof stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 44lbs 1oz (20.0kg). Bidoof has an unsophisticated face and is rarely flustered by anything. There have been incidents involving Bidoof sauntering into villages and gnawing on the houses without a single care.

name: Bibarel
description: Bibarel is the Beaver Pokémon, a Normal/Water-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Bibarel stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 69lbs 7oz (31.5kg). Bibarel fur repels water and is also a fantastic material for heat retention. These Pokémon create dams on rivers to live in.

name: Kricketot
description: Kricketot is the Cricket Pokémon, a Bug-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Kricketot stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 4lbs 14oz (2.2kg). When the trees take on new hues, more of these Pokémon appear. The tone they create by striking their antennae together resembles that of the marimba, an instrument of foreign lands.

name: Kricketune
description: Kricketune is the Cricket Pokémon, a Bug-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Kricketune stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 56lbs 3oz (25.5kg). It uses its cutlass-like arms to produce sound, the melody of which varies from individual to individual. It is a worthwhile endeavor to seek out one's favorite tunes.

name: Shinx
description: Shinx is the Flash Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Shinx stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 20lbs 15oz (9.5kg). Shakes its body to generate electricity. Its stature belies its aggression—one must be patient to tame this Pokémon.

name: Luxio
description: Luxio is the Spark Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Luxio stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 67lbs 4oz (30.5kg). Proudly uses its electrified claws as weapons. It seems to be a gracious Pokémon, evenly sharing the spoils of the hunt with others of its kind.

name: Luxray
description: Luxray is the Gleam Eyes Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Luxray stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 92lbs 10oz (42.0kg). They form packs, each having one male as leader. Legends say that when Luxray's two eyes shimmer with gold, the Pokémon can see through anything.

name: Budew
description: Budew is a Baby Bud Pokémon, a Grass/Poison-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Budew stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 2lbs 10oz (1.2kg). When the sun's light strengthens, the bud atop this Pokémon's head opens. This is a sign to the people that the harsh winter is over, and the season of budding has begun.

name: Roserade
description: Roserade is the Bouquet Pokémon, a Grass/Poison-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Roserade stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 31lbs 15oz (14.5kg). Hidden within the bouquet on each hand are thorned whips loaded with virulent poison. Roserade moves gracefully as it corners its prey and mercilessly lashes them with its whips.

name: Cranidos
description: Cranidos is the Head Butt Pokémon, a Rock-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Cranidos stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 69lbs 7oz (31.5kg). An incredibly rare sight. They duel each other by ramming their heads together, and the resulting sound echoes throughout the area like the pealing of a bell.

name: Rampardos
description: Rampardos is the Head Butt Pokémon, a Rock-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Rampardos stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 226lbs (102.5kg). Very little is known about its biology. Can knock down massive trees by smashing its beautiful, pearl-like crown against them.

name: Shieldon
description: Shieldon is the Shield Pokémon, a Rock/Steel-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Shieldon stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 125lbs 11oz (57.0kg). Much remains unknown about this Pokémon, as few have ever seen it. However, we know that it is calm and dislikes conflict, and it enjoys polishing its face against trees and rocks.

name: Bastiodon
description: Bastiodon is the Shield Pokémon, a Rock/Steel-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Bastiodon stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 329lbs 9oz (149.5kg). Its face is sturdy—as strong as diamond—and this hardness offers a very stable defense. Much about this species is still unknown, such as its natural habitat.

name: Burmy
description: Burmy is the Bagworm Pokémon, a Bug-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Burmy stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 7lbs 8oz (3.4kg). If its cloak is even slightly damaged, Burmy will immediately repair it with whatever is close at hand. The Pokémon within the cloak is scrawny and vulnerable to the cold.

name: Wormadam
description: Wormadam is the Bagworm Pokémon, a Bug/Grass-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Wormadam stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 14lbs 5oz (6.5kg). When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.

name: Mothim
description: Mothim is the Moth Pokémon, a Bug/Flying-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Mothim stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 51lbs 6oz (23.3kg). Scatters steel-colored scales as it flaps its wings. Despite being observed feeding primarily on the nectar of flowers, Mothim is not often seen around flower gardens.

name: Combee
description: Combee is the Tiny Bee Pokémon, a Bug/Flying-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Combee stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 12lbs 2oz (5.5kg). They swear fealty to a queen Pokémon and work diligently to gather nectar. Each swarm produces a different flavor of honey.

name: Vespiquen
description: Vespiquen is the Beehive Pokémon, a Bug/Flying-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Vespiquen stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 84lbs 14oz (38.5kg). Commands its subjects to build its hive. It will dispatch any interlopers who dare sneak into its nest and use them as nourishment for itself.

name: Pachirisu
description: Pachirisu is the EleSquirrel Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Pachirisu stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 8lbs 10oz (3.9kg). A species related to the Pikachu line. Though Pachirisu is a calm Pokémon, it still presents a danger should one touch its electrified tail or cheeks.

name: Buizel
description: Buizel is the Sea Weasel Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Buizel stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 65lbs 1oz (29.5kg). It moves freely in the water by spinning its forked tail for propulsion. The resemblance to the screw of a steamboat is coincidental.

name: Floatzel
description: Floatzel is the Sea Weasel Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Floatzel stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 73lbs 14oz (33.5kg). Has a long, rather splendid flotation sac, which prevents Floatzel from drowning even in stormy seas. One might glimpse this species around fishing hamlets from time to time.

name: Cherubi
description: Cherubi is the Cherry Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Cherubi stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 7lbs 4oz (3.3kg). Once the fruit growing alongside the main body is large and plump, Cherubi will use the nutrients within to evolve. The fruit then detaches, becoming nourishment for other creatures.

name: Cherrim
description: Cherrim is the Blossom Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Cherrim stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 20lbs 8oz (9.3kg). Motionless, save for the occasional quiver. A rich array of Pokémon can be found gathered around it, drawn by the scent exuded from Cherrim's folded petals.

name: Shellos
description: Shellos is the Sea Slug Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Shellos stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 13lbs 14oz (6.3kg). Found in abundance on seashores bordering warm waters. Shellos are unexpectedly friendly and will crawl toward any person they see. Take care not to get coated in mucus!

name: Gastrodon
description: Gastrodon is the Sea Slug Pokémon, a Water/Ground-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Gastrodon stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 65lbs 15oz (29.9kg). Eats beach sand for nourishment. Should one Gastrodon encounter another of a different color, a fierce battle will inevitably ensue.

name: Ambipom
description: Ambipom is the Long Tail Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Ambipom stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 44lbs 12oz (20.3kg). To affirm their kinship, members of this species will form a ring by linking their newly doubled tails together. On rare occasions, humans have been accepted into such rings.

name: Drifloon
description: Drifloon is the Balloon Pokémon, a Ghost/Flying-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Drifloon stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 2lbs 10oz (1.2kg). Said to lure away young children and carry them off to the afterlife. Some whisper that Drifloon are formed of reincarnated human souls, but these rumors are as yet unconfirmed.

name: Drifblim
description: Drifblim is the Blimp Pokémon, a Ghost/Flying-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Drifblim stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 33lbs 1oz (15.0kg). It drifts along at dusk, perfectly silent. Its transient, melancholy aspect touches some people deeply—every so often, one will come upon a song or poem devoted to Drifblim.

name: Buneary
description: Buneary is the Rabbit Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Buneary stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 12lbs 2oz (5.5kg). My hypothesis as to why Buneary rolls up its ears is that its hearing is far too keen. I surmise that the Pokémon protects its hearing by limiting the sound that may enter its ears.

name: Lopunny
description: Lopunny is the Rabbit Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Lopunny stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 73lbs 7oz (33.3kg). Its fur is warm and yet remarkably light. This Pokémon kicks as though it were a master of karate, driving back its opponents with ease.

name: Mismagius
description: Mismagius is the Magical Pokémon, a Ghost-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Mismagius stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 9lbs 11oz (4.4kg). The incantations Mismagius chants can ward against misfortune, so a custom exists of inviting it into one's home. Incur the Pokémon's displeasure, however, and disaster will surely ensue.

name: Honchkrow
description: Honchkrow is the Big Boss Pokémon, a Dark/Flying-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Honchkrow stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 60lbs 3oz (27.3kg). One cry from this Pokémon, and a murder of Murkrow come flying. At such times, one would think the curtain of night had fallen, plunging the world into jet-black darkness.

name: Glameow
description: Glameow is the Catty Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Glameow stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 8lbs 10oz (3.9kg). Bewitches humans with its helical tail and piercing gaze. Its hidden claws are quite sharp as well, making this Pokémon an exceedingly tricky opponent if antagonized.

name: Purugly
description: Purugly is the Tiger Cat Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Purugly stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 96lbs 9oz (43.8kg). Though impudent and difficult to tame, Purugly enjoys great popularity due to its fur, the beauty of which surpasses even velveteen.

name: Chingling
description: Chingling is a Baby Bell Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Chingling stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 1lbs 5oz (0.6kg). This Pokémon gave me an excruciating headache when it seemingly cried out without making a sound. Perhaps there are some sounds that the human ear is simply incapable of hearing.

name: Stunky
description: Stunky is the Skunk Pokémon, a Poison/Dark-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Stunky stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 42lbs 5oz (19.2kg). The poison that gushes from its aft end is accompanied by an utterly evil-smelling odor with such potency that one whiff can induce memory loss.

name: Skuntank
description: Skuntank is the Skunk Pokémon, a Poison/Dark-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Skuntank stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 83lbs 12oz (38.0kg). Sprays a poisonous fluid to take down prey. Sometimes, unable to stomach the stench of its own fluid, it leaves the bested prey uneaten.

name: Bronzor
description: Bronzor is the Bronze Pokémon, a Steel/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Bronzor stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 133lbs 6oz (60.5kg). Floats using a mysterious energy. The pattern engraved upon its back is held as sacred and can sometimes be found in imagery from ancient cemeteries and other such timeworn places.

name: Bronzong
description: Bronzong is the Bronze Bell Pokémon, a Steel/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Bronzong stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 412lbs 4oz (187.0kg). Some believe that its bell-like cry opens holes to another world. It has been revered as a deity since ancient times.

name: Bonsly
description: Bonsly is a Baby Bonsai Pokémon, a Rock-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Bonsly stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 33lbs 1oz (15.0kg). Its tears elicit sympathy from those who see them, but do not be deceived! This expulsion of body water is merely a physiological mechanism for keeping itself in good health.

name: Mime Jr.
description: Mime Jr. is a Baby Mime Pokémon, a Psychic/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Mime Jr. stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 28lbs 11oz (13.0kg). Known to turn up in bustling marketplaces now and again. It mimics people much as a child would, then watches how they react, eyes sparkling.

name: Happiny
description: Happiny is a Baby Playhouse Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Happiny stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 53lbs 13oz (24.4kg). In imitation of Chansey, it keeps a round stone tucked into its belly pouch and cherishes it dearly. It gets along well with children and will sometimes play house with them for fun.

name: Chatot
description: Chatot is the Music Note Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Chatot stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 4lbs 3oz (1.9kg). A versatile performer skilled in the imitation of human speech. It is said that older, more experienced Chatot can even understand the meaning of the words they mimic.

name: Spiritomb
description: Spiritomb is the Forbidden Pokémon, a Ghost/Dark-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Spiritomb stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 238lbs 2oz (108.0kg). It lays curses by thinking wicked thoughts. Writings tell that this Pokémon was born out of the assembly of five score and eight malevolent spirits.

name: Gible
description: Gible is the Land Shark Pokémon, a Dragon/Ground-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Gible stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 45lbs 3oz (20.5kg). It nests in caves untouched by sunlight. Its sharp teeth may fall out when worn away or after an impact, but they regrow within a few days.

name: Gabite
description: Gabite is the Cave Pokémon, a Dragon/Ground-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Gabite stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 123lbs 7oz (56.0kg). Though Gabite are usually of a violent disposition, when I gave one a glass bead it had been eyeing covetously, it suddenly became quite docile.

name: Garchomp
description: Garchomp is the Mach Pokémon, a Dragon/Ground-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Garchomp stands 6'3" (1.9m) tall and weighs 209lbs 7oz (95.0kg). Soars across the heavens at blinding speed—a magnificent sight! It has a feral disposition. Utmost caution is required if one meets a Garchomp out in the wilds.

name: Munchlax
description: Munchlax is a Baby Big Eater Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Munchlax stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 231lbs 8oz (105.0kg). Its robust stomach allows it to nonchalantly devour even rotted matter. It pays frequent visits to villages, seeking out food scraps intended for compost.

name: Riolu
description: Riolu is a Baby Emanation Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Riolu stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 44lbs 9oz (20.2kg). Though infantile in appearance, it has the mysterious ability to read the minds of humans. The pure of heart are met with Riolu's approval, while those of ill nature earn only its loathing.

name: Lucario
description: Lucario is the Aura Pokémon, a Fighting/Steel-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Lucario stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 119lbs 1oz (54.0kg). A most gallant-looking creature. It emits energy waves and controls them with precision, using them to sense even faraway beings. I have given the name ”aura” to this power.

name: Hippopotas
description: Hippopotas is the Hippo Pokémon, a Ground-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Hippopotas stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 109lbs 2oz (49.5kg). Though large and languid, Hippopotas is difficult to detect due to its tendency to burrow into and lurk beneath the soil. When agitated or excited, it expels sand from its nostrils.

name: Hippowdon
description: Hippowdon is the Heavyweight Pokémon, a Ground-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Hippowdon stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 661lbs 6oz (300.0kg). Short-tempered and easily moved to violence. It whips up whirlwinds of sand to crush its foes' spirits, then goes in for the attack.

name: Skorupi
description: Skorupi is the Scorpion Pokémon, a Poison/Bug-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Skorupi stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 26lbs 7oz (12.0kg). Its claws are not only razor-sharp but poisonous, making Skorupi a highly dangerous Pokémon. It seems to be weakened by cold temperatures, however.

name: Drapion
