description: Drapion is the Ogre Scorpion Pokémon, a Poison/Dark-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Drapion stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 135lbs 9oz (61.5kg). Has a brutish, ferocious temperament. With immense strength and a sturdy shell off which swords will bounce, it rampages about and wreaks havoc.

name: Croagunk
description: Croagunk is the Toxic Mouth Pokémon, a Poison/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Croagunk stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 50lbs 11oz (23.0kg). A poison wielder with a dastardly personality. Despite such qualities, this species is afforded a measure of popularity due to its peculiar cry and comical features.

name: Toxicroak
description: Toxicroak is the Toxic Mouth Pokémon, a Poison/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Toxicroak stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 97lbs 14oz (44.4kg). Its crimson claws contain a virulent toxin. This toxin can be made into a tonic by diluting it, mixing it with several types of wild grass, and boiling it down over two days.

name: Carnivine
description: Carnivine is the Bug Catcher Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Carnivine stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 59lbs 8oz (27.0kg). Though this is a plant Pokémon, it has a gluttonous and unruly temperament. Carnivine attacks its prey with its cavernous maw wide open.

name: Finneon
description: Finneon is the Wing Fish Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Finneon stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 15lbs 7oz (7.0kg). What a gorgeous sight this Pokémon is as it swims with its long, pink-painted caudal fins fluttering behind it. Finneon's beautiful appearance has led to its nickname: ”finery fish.”

name: Lumineon
description: Lumineon is the Neon Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Lumineon stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 52lbs 15oz (24.0kg). Uses its gleaming fins to hunt its prey. The view of Lumineon schooling near the surface of the sea at night is breathtaking— it's as though there were shining stars right there.

name: Mantyke
description: Mantyke is a Baby Kite Pokémon, a Water/Flying-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Mantyke stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 143lbs 5oz (65.0kg). Though ball-like in shape, this Pokémon is a proficient swimmer. I have discovered that if a Mantyke spends much time with schools of Remoraid, it will eventually achieve evolution.

name: Snover
description: Snover is the Frost Tree Pokémon, a Grass/Ice-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Snover stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 111lbs 5oz (50.5kg). One is likely to encounter this Pokémon while out in the snow. There are stories of Snover appearing in human settlements but doing no harm—rather, they bond with the children.

name: Abomasnow
description: Abomasnow is the Frost Tree Pokémon, a Grass/Ice-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Abomasnow stands 7'3" (2.2m) tall and weighs 298lbs 12oz (135.5kg). A powerful Pokémon that can split huge boulders with ease. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep within the mountains, playing with the snow.

name: Weavile
description: Weavile is the Sharp Claw Pokémon, a Dark/Ice-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Weavile stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 74lbs 15oz (34.0kg). This species corners prey as a pack, under the guidance of a leader. Weavile displays increased cunning, leading me to speculate that its evolution caused further brain development.

name: Magnezone
description: Magnezone is the Magnet Area Pokémon, a Electric/Steel-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Magnezone stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 396lbs 13oz (180.0kg). I theorize that a special magnetic field influenced this Pokémon, changing its molecular structure and causing it to evolve. It emits strange radio waves toward space from its antenna.

name: Lickilicky
description: Lickilicky is the Licking Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Lickilicky stands 5'7" (1.7m) tall and weighs 308lbs 10oz (140.0kg). Its tongue can extend and contract freely, and it is capable of reaching lengths over 10 times Lickilicky's height. Beware of the saliva, as it contains corrosive elements.

name: Rhyperior
description: Rhyperior is the Drill Pokémon, a Ground/Rock-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Rhyperior stands 7'10" (2.4m) tall and weighs 623lbs 7oz (282.8kg). This Pokémon evolved through use of a curious item. Its rocklike hide is composed of a mysterious substance and can withstand a blow from a masterwork sword with nary a scratch.

name: Tangrowth
description: Tangrowth is the Vine Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Tangrowth stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 283lbs 8oz (128.6kg). Draped with long vines, it resembles a shrub in appearance. It swings bundles of vines as though they were arms, wrapping them around prey to ensnare them.

name: Electivire
description: Electivire is the Thunderbolt Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Electivire stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 305lbs 9oz (138.6kg). Its evolution was induced by an unusual item, and its electrical output rises along with its heart rate. From its tails, it can unleash an electric current measuring 20,000 volts.

name: Magmortar
description: Magmortar is the Blast Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Magmortar stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 149lbs 15oz (68.0kg). Use of a strange item caused this Pokémon to evolve. Fireballs launched from the ends of its tubelike arms are hot enough to melt an iron pot in an instant.

name: Togekiss
description: Togekiss is the Jubilee Pokémon, a Fairy/Flying-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Togekiss stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 83lbs 12oz (38.0kg). Scant few have ever sighted this Pokémon. After studying what literature remains, I am certain Togekiss will reveal itself when peace reigns in the land.

name: Yanmega
description: Yanmega is the Ogre Darner Pokémon, a Bug/Flying-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Yanmega stands 6'3" (1.9m) tall and weighs 113lbs 9oz (51.5kg). Extremely violent. When hunting, it wastes none of its energy, aiming only for prey's most vulnerable spots. Any who manage to tame this Pokémon must be of incredible bravery.

name: Leafeon
description: Leafeon is the Verdant Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Leafeon stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 56lbs 3oz (25.5kg). Cells similar to those of plants have been found in its fur. Its hard tail can fell a large tree with one stroke, and the tail's sharpness exceeds even that of a sword crafted by a master.

name: Glaceon
description: Glaceon is the Fresh Snow Pokémon, a Ice-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Glaceon stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 57lbs 2oz (25.9kg). Glaceon is able to lower its body temperature very quickly. It freezes the atmosphere, creating diamond dust that glitters like gems while it flutters and dances around.

name: Gliscor
description: Gliscor is the Fang Scorpion Pokémon, a Ground/Flying-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Gliscor stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 93lbs 11oz (42.5kg). It glides soundlessly on pitch-black wings and sinks sharp fangs into the throat of its prey. It takes on a look of satisfaction once it has entirely drained its prey of blood.

name: Mamoswine
description: Mamoswine is the Twin Tusk Pokémon, a Ice/Ground-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Mamoswine stands 8'2" (2.5m) tall and weighs 641lbs 9oz (291.0kg). This species reached its zenith during the period known as the ice age. I suspect that Hisui's frigid climate is in harmony with Mamoswine's constitution, thus awakening hidden potential.

name: Porygon-Z
description: Porygon-Z is the Virtual Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Porygon-Z stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 74lbs 15oz (34.0kg). A curious item induced this evolution. The Pokémon's offensive capabilities have greatly increased, but the strangeness of its behavior has magnified in equal measure. This worries me.

name: Gallade
description: Gallade is the Blade Pokémon, a Psychic/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Gallade stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 114lbs 10oz (52.0kg). The blades extending from its elbows are sharper than the finest swords. Its swordsmanship, albeit self-taught, is astonishingly impressive.

name: Probopass
description: Probopass is the Compass Pokémon, a Rock/Steel-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Probopass stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 749lbs 9oz (340.0kg). It is able to emit powerful magnetism, allowing it control over the iron sand that forms its luscious mustache. Using this iron sand, Probopass forms hard stones with which it smites its prey.

name: Dusknoir
description: Dusknoir is the Gripper Pokémon, a Ghost-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Dusknoir stands 7'3" (2.2m) tall and weighs 235lbs (106.6kg). Comes to those whose lives have come to an end and escorts their souls to the afterlife. Known to mistakenly take the souls of those who yet have life left in them, albeit rarely.

name: Froslass
description: Froslass is the Snow Land Pokémon, a Ice/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Froslass stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 58lbs 10oz (26.6kg). A Pokémon inhabited by the soul of a woman who died bearing a grudge in the snowy mountains. Legends of Froslass placing deathly curses on misbehaving men send shivers down my spine.

name: Rotom
description: Rotom is the Plasma Pokémon, a Electric/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Rotom stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 11oz (0.3kg). This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.

name: Uxie
description: Uxie is a Legendary Knowledge Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Uxie stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 11oz (0.3kg). A Pokémon feared but also respected for stealing away the memories of evildoers. I have found records that suggest Uxie holds dominion over knowledge.

name: Mesprit
description: Mesprit is a Legendary Emotion Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Mesprit stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 11oz (0.3kg). Known as the Being of Emotion. In legend, this Pokémon was feared, as any who showed disrespect would have their emotions thrown into disarray.

name: Azelf
description: Azelf is a Legendary Willpower Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Azelf stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 11oz (0.3kg). The dreaded Being of Willpower. Legends tell of this Pokémon manipulating the will of its adversaries and turning them into puppets of its own.

name: Dialga
description: Dialga is a Legendary Temporal Pokémon, a Steel/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Dialga stands 17'9" (5.4m) tall and weighs 1505lbs 12oz (683.0kg). This Pokémon is revered as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Dialga was what caused the vast river of time to begin flowing in our world.

name: Palkia
description: Palkia is a Legendary Spatial Pokémon, a Water/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Palkia stands 13'9" (4.2m) tall and weighs 740lbs 12oz (336.0kg). This Pokémon is feared as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity.

name: Heatran
description: Heatran is a Legendary Lava Dome Pokémon, a Fire/Steel-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Heatran stands 5'7" (1.7m) tall and weighs 948lbs (430.0kg). Stories tell of this Pokémon being birthed from the boiling magma within Mount Coronet. Its molten-steel body holds many mysteries.

name: Regigigas
description: Regigigas is a Legendary Colossal Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Regigigas stands 12'2" (3.7m) tall and weighs 925lbs 15oz (420.0kg). According to legend, Regigigas pulled landmasses together and bound them with rope to create the continent of Hisui. Though I have my doubts, the story could well contain a shred of truth.

name: Giratina
description: Giratina is a Legendary Renegade Pokémon, a Ghost/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Giratina stands 14'9" (4.5m) tall and weighs 1653lbs 7oz (750.0kg). There is one Hisuian verse that tells of a powerful light creating a deep shadow. I imagine that this deep shadow is Giratina.

name: Cresselia
description: Cresselia is a Legendary Lunar Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Cresselia stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 188lbs 11oz (85.6kg). Cresselia is reminiscent of the crescent moon. It leaves a brilliant line of light in its wake as it flies across the night sky. I daresay it resembles the heavenly maiden who created the Milky Way.

name: Phione
description: Phione is a Mythical Sea Drifter Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Phione stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 6lbs 13oz (3.1kg). Can be seen floating offshore during seasons when the seas are warm. Its azure body blends in with the ocean waters—logic suggests this is a defense mechanism against natural predators.

name: Manaphy
description: Manaphy is a Mythical Seafaring Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Manaphy stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 3lbs 1oz (1.4kg). Rumored to migrate across the oceans and visit Hisui's coastal waters only rarely. Although Manaphy resembles Phione, it is also quite different. The relation between the two is unclear.

name: Darkrai
description: Darkrai is a Mythical Pitch-Black Pokémon, a Dark-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Darkrai stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 111lbs 5oz (50.5kg). On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village's inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.

name: Shaymin
description: Shaymin is a Mythical Gratitude Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Shaymin stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 4lbs 10oz (2.1kg). When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.

name: Arceus
description: Arceus is a Mythical Alpha Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation IV. It first appeared in Pokemon Diamond. Arceus stands 10'6" (3.2m) tall and weighs 705lbs 8oz (320.0kg). It is the heavenly fount from which pours the light that shines across Hisui. Its luminance guides and protects all Pokémon. Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things.

name: Victini
description: Victini is a Mythical Victory Pokémon, a Psychic/Fire-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Victini stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 8lbs 13oz (4.0kg). When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being’s entire body will be overflowing with power.

name: Snivy
description: Snivy is the Grass Snake Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Snivy stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 17lbs 14oz (8.1kg). They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

name: Servine
description: Servine is the Grass Snake Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Servine stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 35lbs 4oz (16.0kg). When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.

name: Serperior
description: Serperior is the Regal Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Serperior stands 10'10" (3.3m) tall and weighs 138lbs 14oz (63.0kg). It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

name: Tepig
description: Tepig is the Fire Pig Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Tepig stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 21lbs 13oz (9.9kg). It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

name: Pignite
description: Pignite is the Fire Pig Pokémon, a Fire/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Pignite stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 122lbs 6oz (55.5kg). When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

name: Emboar
description: Emboar is the Mega Fire Pig Pokémon, a Fire/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Emboar stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 330lbs 11oz (150.0kg). It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

name: Oshawott
description: Oshawott is the Sea Otter Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Oshawott stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 13lbs (5.9kg). This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.

name: Dewott
description: Dewott is the Discipline Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Dewott stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 54lbs (24.5kg). Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

name: Samurott
description: Samurott is the Formidable Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Samurott stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 208lbs 9oz (94.6kg). Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

name: Patrat
description: Patrat is the Scout Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Patrat stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 25lbs 9oz (11.6kg). Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won’t notice a foe coming from behind.

name: Watchog
description: Watchog is the Lookout Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Watchog stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 59lbs 8oz (27.0kg). When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

name: Lillipup
description: Lillipup is the Puppy Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Lillipup stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 9lbs 1oz (4.1kg). This Pokémon is far brighter than the average child, and Lillipup won’t forget the love it receives or any abuse it suffers.

name: Herdier
description: Herdier is the Loyal Dog Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Herdier stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 32lbs 7oz (14.7kg). The black fur that covers this Pokémon’s body is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce right off.

name: Stoutland
description: Stoutland is the Big-Hearted Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Stoutland stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 134lbs 8oz (61.0kg). Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive moustache. It’s said that moustache length is what determines social standing among this species.

name: Purrloin
description: Purrloin is the Devious Pokémon, a Dark-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Purrloin stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 22lbs 4oz (10.1kg). Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

name: Liepard
description: Liepard is the Cruel Pokémon, a Dark-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Liepard stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 82lbs 11oz (37.5kg). This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind prey without making any sound at all. It competes with Thievul for territory.

name: Pansage
description: Pansage is the Grass Monkey Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Pansage stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 23lbs 2oz (10.5kg). It’s good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It’s kind enough to share them with friends.

name: Simisage
description: Simisage is the Thorn Monkey Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Simisage stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 67lbs 4oz (30.5kg). Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

name: Pansear
description: Pansear is the High Temp Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Pansear stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 24lbs 4oz (11.0kg). This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Simisear
description: Simisear is the Ember Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Simisear stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 61lbs 12oz (28.0kg). When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

name: Panpour
description: Panpour is the Spray Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Panpour stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 29lbs 12oz (13.5kg). The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

name: Simipour
description: Simipour is the Geyser Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Simipour stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 63lbs 15oz (29.0kg). It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

name: Munna
description: Munna is the Dream Eater Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Munna stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 51lbs 6oz (23.3kg). It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it’s eating a good dream, and black when it’s eating a nightmare.

name: Musharna
description: Musharna is the Drowsing Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Musharna stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 133lbs 6oz (60.5kg). It drowses and dreams all the time. It’s best to leave it be if it’s just woken up, as it’s a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.

name: Pidove
description: Pidove is the Tiny Pigeon Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Pidove stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 4lbs 10oz (2.1kg). It’s forgetful and not very bright, but many Trainers love it anyway for its friendliness and sincerity.

name: Tranquill
description: Tranquill is the Wild Pigeon Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Tranquill stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 33lbs 1oz (15.0kg). These bright Pokémon have acute memories. Apparently delivery workers often choose them as their partners.

name: Unfezant
description: Unfezant is the Proud Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Unfezant stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 63lbs 15oz (29.0kg). This Pokémon is intelligent and intensely proud. People will sit up and take notice if you become the Trainer of one.

name: Blitzle
description: Blitzle is the Electrified Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Blitzle stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 65lbs 11oz (29.8kg). Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

name: Zebstrika
description: Zebstrika is the Thunderbolt Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Zebstrika stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 175lbs 4oz (79.5kg). They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

name: Roggenrola
description: Roggenrola is the Mantle Pokémon, a Rock-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Roggenrola stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 39lbs 11oz (18.0kg). When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.

name: Boldore
description: Boldore is the Ore Pokémon, a Rock-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Boldore stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 224lbs 14oz (102.0kg). It relies on sound in order to monitor what’s in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it’s facing.

name: Gigalith
description: Gigalith is the Compressed Pokémon, a Rock-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Gigalith stands 5'7" (1.7m) tall and weighs 573lbs 3oz (260.0kg). Although its energy blasts can blow away a dump truck, they have a limitation— they can only be fired when the sun is out.

name: Woobat
description: Woobat is the Bat Pokémon, a Psychic/Flying-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Woobat stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 4lbs 10oz (2.1kg). It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

name: Swoobat
description: Swoobat is the Courting Pokémon, a Psychic/Flying-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Swoobat stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 23lbs 2oz (10.5kg). The auspicious shape of this Pokémon’s nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

name: Drilbur
description: Drilbur is the Mole Pokémon, a Ground-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Drilbur stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 18lbs 12oz (8.5kg). It’s a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.

name: Excadrill
description: Excadrill is the Subterrene Pokémon, a Ground/Steel-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Excadrill stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 89lbs 1oz (40.4kg). Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.

name: Audino
description: Audino is the Hearing Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Audino stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 68lbs 5oz (31.0kg). This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures’ feelings and physical conditions.

name: Timburr
description: Timburr is the Muscular Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Timburr stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 27lbs 9oz (12.5kg). Timburr that have started carrying logs that are about three times their size are nearly ready to evolve.

name: Gurdurr
description: Gurdurr is the Muscular Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Gurdurr stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 88lbs 3oz (40.0kg). Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is not its forte. In any case, there’s skill in the way this Pokémon wields its metal beam.

name: Conkeldurr
description: Conkeldurr is the Muscular Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Conkeldurr stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 191lbs 13oz (87.0kg). When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to pummel them with its fists.

name: Tympole
description: Tympole is the Tadpole Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Tympole stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 9lbs 15oz (4.5kg). It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can’t hear its cries of warning.

name: Palpitoad
description: Palpitoad is the Vibration Pokémon, a Water/Ground-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Palpitoad stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 37lbs 8oz (17.0kg). On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

name: Seismitoad
description: Seismitoad is the Vibration Pokémon, a Water/Ground-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Seismitoad stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 136lbs 11oz (62.0kg). This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

name: Throh
description: Throh is the Judo Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Throh stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 122lbs 6oz (55.5kg). They train in groups of five. Any member that can’t keep up will discard its belt and leave the group.

name: Sawk
description: Sawk is the Karate Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Sawk stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 112lbs 7oz (51.0kg). The karate chops of a Sawk that’s trained itself to the limit can cleave the ocean itself.

name: Sewaddle
description: Sewaddle is the Sewing Pokémon, a Bug/Grass-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Sewaddle stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 5lbs 8oz (2.5kg). Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

name: Swadloon
description: Swadloon is the Leaf-Wrapped Pokémon, a Bug/Grass-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Swadloon stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 16lbs 1oz (7.3kg). It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

name: Leavanny
description: Leavanny is the Nurturing Pokémon, a Bug/Grass-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Leavanny stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 45lbs 3oz (20.5kg). It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

name: Venipede
description: Venipede is the Centipede Pokémon, a Bug/Poison-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Venipede stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 11lbs 11oz (5.3kg). Its fangs are highly venomous. If this Pokémon finds prey it thinks it can eat, it leaps for them without any thought of how things might turn out.

name: Whirlipede
description: Whirlipede is the Curlipede Pokémon, a Bug/Poison-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Whirlipede stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 129lbs (58.5kg). Whirlipede protects itself with a sturdy shell and poisonous spikes while it stores up the energy it’ll need for evolution.

name: Scolipede
description: Scolipede is the Megapede Pokémon, a Bug/Poison-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Scolipede stands 8'2" (2.5m) tall and weighs 442lbs (200.5kg). Scolipede engage in fierce territorial battles with Centiskorch. At the end of one of these battles, the victor makes a meal of the loser.

name: Cottonee
description: Cottonee is the Cotton Puff Pokémon, a Grass/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Cottonee stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 1lbs 5oz (0.6kg). Weaving together the cotton of both Cottonee and Eldegoss produces exquisite cloth that’s highly prized by many luxury brands.

name: Whimsicott
description: Whimsicott is the Windveiled Pokémon, a Grass/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Whimsicott stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 14lbs 9oz (6.6kg). As long as this Pokémon bathes in sunlight, its cotton keeps growing. If too much cotton fluff builds up, Whimsicott tears it off and scatters it.

name: Petilil
description: Petilil is the Bulb Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Petilil stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 14lbs 9oz (6.6kg). The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

name: Lilligant
description: Lilligant is the Flowering Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Lilligant stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 35lbs 15oz (16.3kg). I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

name: Basculin
description: Basculin is the Hostile Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Basculin stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 39lbs 11oz (18.0kg). Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

name: Sandile
description: Sandile is the Desert Croc Pokémon, a Ground/Dark-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Sandile stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 33lbs 8oz (15.2kg). Sandile is small, but its legs and lower body are powerful. Pushing sand aside as it goes, Sandile moves through the desert as if it’s swimming.

name: Krokorok
description: Krokorok is the Desert Croc Pokémon, a Ground/Dark-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Krokorok stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 73lbs 10oz (33.4kg). Although this Pokémon has specialized eyes that allow it to see in the dark, Krokorok won’t move much at night—the desert gets cold after sunset.

name: Krookodile
description: Krookodile is the Intimidation Pokémon, a Ground/Dark-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Krookodile stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 212lbs 5oz (96.3kg). While terribly aggressive, Krookodile also has the patience to stay hidden under sand for days, lying in wait for prey.

name: Darumaka
description: Darumaka is the Zen Charm Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Darumaka stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 82lbs 11oz (37.5kg). This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it’s pushed or pulled.

name: Darmanitan
description: Darmanitan is the Blazing Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Darmanitan stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 204lbs 13oz (92.9kg). This Pokémon’s power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Maractus
description: Maractus is the Cactus Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Maractus stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 61lbs 12oz (28.0kg). Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They’re jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.

name: Dwebble
description: Dwebble is the Rock Inn Pokémon, a Bug/Rock-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Dwebble stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 31lbs 15oz (14.5kg). It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.

name: Crustle
description: Crustle is the Stone Home Pokémon, a Bug/Rock-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Crustle stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 440lbs 15oz (200.0kg). Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They’re mighty enough to crack Rhyperior’s carapace.

name: Scraggy
description: Scraggy is the Shedding Pokémon, a Dark/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Scraggy stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 26lbs (11.8kg). It protects itself with its durable skin. It’s thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.

name: Scrafty
description: Scrafty is the Hoodlum Pokémon, a Dark/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Scrafty stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 66lbs 2oz (30.0kg). While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.

name: Sigilyph
description: Sigilyph is the Avianoid Pokémon, a Psychic/Flying-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Sigilyph stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 30lbs 14oz (14.0kg). A discovery was made in the desert where Sigilyph fly. The ruins of what may have been an ancient city were found beneath the sands.

name: Yamask
description: Yamask is the Spirit Pokémon, a Ghost-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Yamask stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 3lbs 5oz (1.5kg). The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.

name: Cofagrigus
description: Cofagrigus is the Coffin Pokémon, a Ghost-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Cofagrigus stands 5'7" (1.7m) tall and weighs 168lbs 10oz (76.5kg). There are many depictions of Cofagrigus decorating ancient tombs. They’re symbols of the wealth that kings of bygone eras had.

name: Tirtouga
description: Tirtouga is the Prototurtle Pokémon, a Water/Rock-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Tirtouga stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 36lbs 6oz (16.5kg). Tirtouga is considered to be the ancestor of many turtle Pokémon. It was restored to life from a fossil.

name: Carracosta
description: Carracosta is the Prototurtle Pokémon, a Water/Rock-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Carracosta stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 178lbs 9oz (81.0kg). This Pokémon emerges from the water in search of prey despite the fact that it moves more slowly on land.

name: Archen
description: Archen is the First Bird Pokémon, a Rock/Flying-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Archen stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 20lbs 15oz (9.5kg). Archen is said to be the ancestor of bird Pokémon. It lived in treetops, eating berries and bug Pokémon.

name: Archeops
description: Archeops is the First Bird Pokémon, a Rock/Flying-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Archeops stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 70lbs 9oz (32.0kg). Though capable of flight, Archeops was apparently better at hunting on the ground.

name: Trubbish
description: Trubbish is the Trash Bag Pokémon, a Poison-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Trubbish stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 68lbs 5oz (31.0kg). This Pokémon was born from a bag stuffed with trash. Galarian Weezing relish the fumes belched by Trubbish.

name: Garbodor
description: Garbodor is the Trash Heap Pokémon, a Poison-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Garbodor stands 6'3" (1.9m) tall and weighs 236lbs 9oz (107.3kg). The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

name: Zorua
description: Zorua is the Tricky Fox Pokémon, a Dark-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Zorua stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 27lbs 9oz (12.5kg). A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

name: Zoroark
description: Zoroark is the Illusion Fox Pokémon, a Dark-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Zoroark stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 178lbs 13oz (81.1kg). With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

name: Minccino
description: Minccino is the Chinchilla Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Minccino stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 12lbs 13oz (5.8kg). They pet each other with their tails as a form of greeting. Of the two, the one whose tail is fluffier is a bit more boastful.

name: Cinccino
description: Cinccino is the Scarf Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Cinccino stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 16lbs 9oz (7.5kg). A special oil that seeps through their fur helps them avoid attacks. The oil fetches a high price at market.

name: Gothita
description: Gothita is the Fixation Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Gothita stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 12lbs 13oz (5.8kg). Even when nobody seems to be around, Gothita can still be heard making a muted cry. Many believe it’s speaking to something only it can see.

name: Gothorita
description: Gothorita is the Manipulate Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Gothorita stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 39lbs 11oz (18.0kg). On nights when the stars shine, this Pokémon’s psychic power is at its strongest. It’s unknown just what link Gothorita has to the greater universe.

name: Gothitelle
description: Gothitelle is the Astral Body Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Gothitelle stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 97lbs (44.0kg). A criminal who was shown his fate by a Gothitelle went missing that same day and was never seen again.

name: Solosis
description: Solosis is the Cell Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Solosis stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 2lbs 3oz (1.0kg). Many say that the special liquid covering this Pokémon’s body would allow it to survive in the vacuum of space.

name: Duosion
description: Duosion is the Mitosis Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Duosion stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 17lbs 10oz (8.0kg). Its brain has split into two, and the two halves rarely think alike. Its actions are utterly unpredictable.

name: Reuniclus
description: Reuniclus is the Multiplying Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Reuniclus stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 44lbs 5oz (20.1kg). It’s said that drinking the liquid surrounding Reuniclus grants wisdom. Problem is, the liquid is highly toxic to anything besides Reuniclus itself.

name: Ducklett
description: Ducklett is the Water Bird Pokémon, a Water/Flying-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Ducklett stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 12lbs 2oz (5.5kg). They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

name: Swanna
description: Swanna is the White Bird Pokémon, a Water/Flying-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Swanna stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 53lbs 6oz (24.2kg). Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

name: Vanillite
description: Vanillite is the Fresh Snow Pokémon, a Ice-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Vanillite stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 12lbs 9oz (5.7kg). Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from an icicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degrees Fahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.

name: Vanillish
description: Vanillish is the Icy Snow Pokémon, a Ice-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Vanillish stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 90lbs 6oz (41.0kg). It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But it spares their lives afterward—it’s a kind Pokémon.

name: Vanilluxe
description: Vanilluxe is the Snowstorm Pokémon, a Ice-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Vanilluxe stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 126lbs 12oz (57.5kg). People believe this Pokémon formed when two Vanillish stuck together. Its body temperature is roughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Deerling
description: Deerling is the Season Pokémon, a Normal/Grass-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Deerling stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 43lbs (19.5kg). The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon’s fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

name: Sawsbuck
description: Sawsbuck is the Season Pokémon, a Normal/Grass-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Sawsbuck stands 6'3" (1.9m) tall and weighs 203lbs 15oz (92.5kg). They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.

name: Emolga
description: Emolga is the Sky Squirrel Pokémon, a Electric/Flying-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Emolga stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 11lbs (5.0kg). This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can’t fly properly.

name: Karrablast
description: Karrablast is the Clamping Pokémon, a Bug-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Karrablast stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 13lbs (5.9kg). It spits a liquid from its mouth to melt through Shelmet’s shell. Karrablast doesn’t eat the shell— it eats only the contents.

name: Escavalier
description: Escavalier is the Cavalry Pokémon, a Bug/Steel-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Escavalier stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 72lbs 12oz (33.0kg). It charges its enemies, lances at the ready. An image of one of its duels is captured in a famous painting of Escavalier clashing with Sirfetch’d.

name: Foongus
description: Foongus is the Mushroom Pokémon, a Grass/Poison-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Foongus stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 2lbs 3oz (1.0kg). The spores released from this Pokémon’s hands are highly poisonous, but when thoroughly dried, the spores can be used as stomach medicine.

name: Amoonguss
description: Amoonguss is the Mushroom Pokémon, a Grass/Poison-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Amoonguss stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 23lbs 2oz (10.5kg). Amoonguss generally doesn’t move much. It tends to stand still near Poké Balls that have been dropped on the ground.

name: Frillish
description: Frillish is the Floating Pokémon, a Water/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Frillish stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 72lbs 12oz (33.0kg). Legend has it that the residents of a sunken ancient city changed into these Pokémon.

name: Jellicent
description: Jellicent is the Floating Pokémon, a Water/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Jellicent stands 7'3" (2.2m) tall and weighs 297lbs 10oz (135.0kg). Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.

name: Alomomola
description: Alomomola is the Caring Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Alomomola stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 69lbs 11oz (31.6kg). The reason it helps Pokémon in a weakened condition is that any Pokémon coming after them may also attack Alomomola.

name: Joltik
description: Joltik is the Attaching Pokémon, a Bug/Electric-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Joltik stands 4" (0.1m) tall and weighs 1lbs 5oz (0.6kg). Joltik latch on to other Pokémon and suck out static electricity. They’re often found sticking to Yamper’s hindquarters.

name: Galvantula
description: Galvantula is the EleSpider Pokémon, a Bug/Electric-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Galvantula stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 31lbs 8oz (14.3kg). It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that are not yet good at flying.

name: Ferroseed
description: Ferroseed is the Thorn Seed Pokémon, a Grass/Steel-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Ferroseed stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 41lbs 7oz (18.8kg). Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings. Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed’s spikes grow big and strong.

name: Ferrothorn
description: Ferrothorn is the Thorn Pod Pokémon, a Grass/Steel-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Ferrothorn stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 242lbs 8oz (110.0kg). Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes on its feelers into the stone.

name: Klink
description: Klink is the Gear Pokémon, a Steel-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Klink stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 46lbs 5oz (21.0kg). It’s suspected that Klink were the inspiration behind ancient people’s invention of the first gears.

name: Klang
description: Klang is the Gear Pokémon, a Steel-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Klang stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 112lbs 7oz (51.0kg). Many companies in the Galar region choose Klang as their logo. This Pokémon is considered the symbol of industrial technology.

name: Klinklang
description: Klinklang is the Gear Pokémon, a Steel-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Klinklang stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 178lbs 9oz (81.0kg). The three gears that compose this Pokémon spin at high speed. Its new spiked gear isn’t a living creature.

name: Tynamo
description: Tynamo is the EleFish Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Tynamo stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 11oz (0.3kg). One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

name: Eelektrik
description: Eelektrik is the EleFish Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Eelektrik stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 48lbs 8oz (22.0kg). These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

name: Eelektross
description: Eelektross is the EleFish Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Eelektross stands 6'11" (2.1m) tall and weighs 177lbs 8oz (80.5kg). They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

name: Elgyem
description: Elgyem is the Cerebral Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Elgyem stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 19lbs 13oz (9.0kg). This Pokémon was discovered about 50 years ago. Its highly developed brain enables it to exert its psychic powers.

name: Beheeyem
description: Beheeyem is the Cerebral Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Beheeyem stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 76lbs 1oz (34.5kg). Sometimes found drifting above wheat fields, this Pokémon can control the memories of its opponents.

name: Litwick
description: Litwick is the Candle Pokémon, a Ghost/Fire-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Litwick stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 6lbs 13oz (3.1kg). The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.

name: Lampent
description: Lampent is the Lamp Pokémon, a Ghost/Fire-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Lampent stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 28lbs 11oz (13.0kg). It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.

name: Chandelure
description: Chandelure is the Luring Pokémon, a Ghost/Fire-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Chandelure stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 75lbs 10oz (34.3kg). In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence— or so it’s said.

name: Axew
description: Axew is the Tusk Pokémon, a Dragon-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Axew stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 39lbs 11oz (18.0kg). They play with each other by knocking their large tusks together. Their tusks break sometimes, but they grow back so quickly that it isn’t a concern.

name: Fraxure
description: Fraxure is the Axe Jaw Pokémon, a Dragon-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Fraxure stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 79lbs 6oz (36.0kg). Its skin is as hard as a suit of armor. Fraxure’s favorite strategy is to tackle its opponents, stabbing them with its tusks at the same time.

name: Haxorus
description: Haxorus is the Axe Jaw Pokémon, a Dragon-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Haxorus stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 232lbs 9oz (105.5kg). While usually kindhearted, it can be terrifying if angered. Tusks that can slice through steel beams are how Haxorus deals with its adversaries.

name: Cubchoo
description: Cubchoo is the Chill Pokémon, a Ice-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Cubchoo stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 18lbs 12oz (8.5kg). It sniffles before performing a move, using its frosty snot to provide an icy element to any move that needs it.

name: Beartic
description: Beartic is the Freezing Pokémon, a Ice-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Beartic stands 8'6" (2.6m) tall and weighs 573lbs 3oz (260.0kg). It swims energetically through frigid seas. When it gets tired, it freezes the seawater with its breath so it can rest on the ice.

name: Cryogonal
description: Cryogonal is the Crystallizing Pokémon, a Ice-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Cryogonal stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 326lbs 5oz (148.0kg). When the weather gets hot, these Pokémon turn into water vapor. Cryogonal are almost never seen during summer.

name: Shelmet
description: Shelmet is the Snail Pokémon, a Bug-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Shelmet stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 17lbs (7.7kg). It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.

name: Accelgor
description: Accelgor is the Shell Out Pokémon, a Bug-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Accelgor stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 55lbs 12oz (25.3kg). Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.

name: Stunfisk
description: Stunfisk is the Trap Pokémon, a Ground/Electric-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Stunfisk stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 24lbs 4oz (11.0kg). For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightly when it emits a strong electric current from the yellow markings on its body.

name: Mienfoo
description: Mienfoo is the Martial Arts Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Mienfoo stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 44lbs 1oz (20.0kg). Though small, Mienfoo’s temperament is fierce. Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly will be greeted with a flurry of graceful attacks.

name: Mienshao
description: Mienshao is the Martial Arts Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Mienshao stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 78lbs 4oz (35.5kg). Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.

name: Druddigon
description: Druddigon is the Cave Pokémon, a Dragon-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Druddigon stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 306lbs 7oz (139.0kg). Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

name: Golett
description: Golett is the Automaton Pokémon, a Ground/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Golett stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 202lbs 13oz (92.0kg). This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.

name: Golurk
description: Golurk is the Automaton Pokémon, a Ground/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Golurk stands 9'2" (2.8m) tall and weighs 727lbs 8oz (330.0kg). There’s a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn’t been proven.

name: Pawniard
description: Pawniard is the Sharp Blade Pokémon, a Dark/Steel-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Pawniard stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 22lbs 8oz (10.2kg). A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.

name: Bisharp
description: Bisharp is the Sword Blade Pokémon, a Dark/Steel-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Bisharp stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 154lbs 5oz (70.0kg). Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.

name: Bouffalant
description: Bouffalant is the Bash Buffalo Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Bouffalant stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 208lbs 9oz (94.6kg). These Pokémon live in herds of about 20 individuals. Bouffalant that betray the herd will lose the hair on their heads for some reason.

name: Rufflet
description: Rufflet is the Eaglet Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Rufflet stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 23lbs 2oz (10.5kg). Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

name: Braviary
description: Braviary is the Valiant Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Braviary stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 90lbs 6oz (41.0kg). Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

name: Vullaby
description: Vullaby is the Diapered Pokémon, a Dark/Flying-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Vullaby stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 19lbs 13oz (9.0kg). Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten too small for older Vullaby to wear often get passed down to younger ones in the nest.

name: Mandibuzz
description: Mandibuzz is the Bone Vulture Pokémon, a Dark/Flying-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Mandibuzz stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 87lbs 1oz (39.5kg). They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.

name: Heatmor
description: Heatmor is the Anteater Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Heatmor stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 127lbs 14oz (58.0kg). A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

name: Durant
description: Durant is the Iron Ant Pokémon, a Bug/Steel-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Durant stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 72lbs 12oz (33.0kg). With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

name: Deino
description: Deino is the Irate Pokémon, a Dark/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Deino stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 38lbs 2oz (17.3kg). Because it can’t see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.

name: Zweilous
description: Zweilous is the Hostile Pokémon, a Dark/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Zweilous stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 110lbs 4oz (50.0kg). Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.

name: Hydreigon
description: Hydreigon is the Brutal Pokémon, a Dark/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Hydreigon stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 352lbs 12oz (160.0kg). The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won’t slow until their target goes down.

name: Larvesta
description: Larvesta is the Torch Pokémon, a Bug/Fire-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Larvesta stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 63lbs 8oz (28.8kg). Larvesta’s body is warm all over. It spouts fire from the tips of its horns to intimidate predators and scare prey.

name: Volcarona
description: Volcarona is the Sun Pokémon, a Bug/Fire-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Volcarona stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 101lbs 7oz (46.0kg). This Pokémon emerges from a cocoon formed of raging flames. Ancient murals depict Volcarona as a deity of fire.

name: Cobalion
description: Cobalion is a Legendary Iron Will Pokémon, a Steel/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Cobalion stands 6'11" (2.1m) tall and weighs 551lbs 2oz (250.0kg). From the moment it’s born, this Pokémon radiates the air of a leader. Its presence will calm even vicious foes.

name: Terrakion
description: Terrakion is a Legendary Cavern Pokémon, a Rock/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Terrakion stands 6'3" (1.9m) tall and weighs 573lbs 3oz (260.0kg). In Unovan legend, Terrakion battled against humans in an effort to protect other Pokémon.

name: Virizion
description: Virizion is a Legendary Grassland Pokémon, a Grass/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Virizion stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 440lbs 15oz (200.0kg). It darts around opponents with a flurry of quick movements, slicing them up with its horns.

name: Thundurus
description: Thundurus is a Legendary Bolt Strike Pokémon, a Electric/Flying-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Thundurus stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 134lbs 8oz (61.0kg). They say this wielder of electricity has waged war with its nemesis, Tornadus, since time immemorial. The lightning bolts it hurls pierce the very earth and enrich the soil.

name: Reshiram
description: Reshiram is a Legendary Vast White Pokémon, a Dragon/Fire-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Reshiram stands 10'6" (3.2m) tall and weighs 727lbs 8oz (330.0kg). According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

name: Zekrom
description: Zekrom is a Legendary Deep Black Pokémon, a Dragon/Electric-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Zekrom stands 9'6" (2.9m) tall and weighs 760lbs 10oz (345.0kg). Mythology tells us that if people lose the righteousness in their hearts, their kingdoms will be razed by Zekrom’s lightning.

name: Landorus
description: Landorus is a Legendary Abundance Pokémon, a Ground/Flying-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Landorus stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 149lbs 15oz (68.0kg). When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.

name: Kyurem
description: Kyurem is a Legendary Boundary Pokémon, a Dragon/Ice-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Kyurem stands 9'10" (3.0m) tall and weighs 716lbs 8oz (325.0kg). It appears that this Pokémon uses its powers over ice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize its cellular structure.

name: Keldeo
description: Keldeo is a Mythical Colt Pokémon, a Water/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Keldeo stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 106lbs 15oz (48.5kg). They say that Keldeo must survive harsh battles and fully develop the horn on its forehead before this Pokémon’s true power will awaken.

name: Meloetta
description: Meloetta is a Mythical Melody Pokémon, a Normal/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Meloetta stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 14lbs 5oz (6.5kg). Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

name: Genesect
description: Genesect is a Mythical Paleozoic Pokémon, a Bug/Steel-type species introduced in Generation V. It first appeared in Pokemon Black. Genesect stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 181lbs 14oz (82.5kg). This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Chespin
description: Chespin is the Spiny Nut Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Chespin stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 19lbs 13oz (9.0kg). Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn’t faze it.

name: Quilladin
description: Quilladin is the Spiny Armor Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Quilladin stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 63lbs 15oz (29.0kg). They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won’t start fights.

name: Chesnaught
description: Chesnaught is the Spiny Armor Pokémon, a Grass/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Chesnaught stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 198lbs 7oz (90.0kg). When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.

name: Fennekin
description: Fennekin is the Fox Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Fennekin stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 20lbs 12oz (9.4kg). As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

name: Braixen
description: Braixen is the Fox Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Braixen stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 31lbs 15oz (14.5kg). When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

name: Delphox
description: Delphox is the Fox Pokémon, a Fire/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Delphox stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 86lbs (39.0kg). Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

name: Froakie
description: Froakie is the Bubble Frog Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Froakie stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 15lbs 7oz (7.0kg). It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Frogadier
description: Frogadier is the Bubble Frog Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Frogadier stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 24lbs (10.9kg). Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute’s time.

name: Greninja
description: Greninja is the Ninja Pokémon, a Water/Dark-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Greninja stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 88lbs 3oz (40.0kg). It appears and vanishes with a ninja’s grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

name: Bunnelby
description: Bunnelby is the Digging Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Bunnelby stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 11lbs (5.0kg). It’s very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight’s flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.

name: Diggersby
description: Diggersby is the Digging Pokémon, a Normal/Ground-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Diggersby stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 93lbs 8oz (42.4kg). The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

name: Fletchling
description: Fletchling is the Tiny Robin Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Fletchling stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 3lbs 12oz (1.7kg). When this Pokémon gets excited, its body temperature increases sharply. If you touch a Fletchling with bare hands, you might get burned.

name: Fletchinder
description: Fletchinder is the Ember Pokémon, a Fire/Flying-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Fletchinder stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 35lbs 4oz (16.0kg). Fletchinder are exceedingly territorial and aggressive. These Pokémon fight among themselves over feeding grounds.

name: Talonflame
description: Talonflame is the Scorching Pokémon, a Fire/Flying-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Talonflame stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 54lbs (24.5kg). Talonflame dives toward prey at speeds of up to 310 mph and assaults them with powerful kicks, giving the prey no chance to escape.

name: Scatterbug
description: Scatterbug is the Scatterdust Pokémon, a Bug-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Scatterbug stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 5lbs 8oz (2.5kg). The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

name: Spewpa
description: Spewpa is the Scatterdust Pokémon, a Bug-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Spewpa stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 18lbs 8oz (8.4kg). The beaks of bird Pokémon can’t begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

name: Vivillon
description: Vivillon is the Scale Pokémon, a Bug/Flying-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Vivillon stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 37lbs 8oz (17.0kg). The patterns on this Pokémon’s wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

name: Litleo
description: Litleo is the Lion Cub Pokémon, a Fire/Normal-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Litleo stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 29lbs 12oz (13.5kg). This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

name: Pyroar
description: Pyroar is the Royal Pokémon, a Fire/Normal-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Pyroar stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 179lbs 11oz (81.5kg). The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn’t use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

name: Floette
description: Floette is the Single Bloom Pokémon, a Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Floette stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 2lbs (0.9kg). It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

name: Florges
description: Florges is the Garden Pokémon, a Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Florges stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 22lbs 1oz (10.0kg). Its life can span several hundred years. It’s said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.

name: Skiddo
description: Skiddo is the Mount Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Skiddo stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 68lbs 5oz (31.0kg). If it has sunshine and water, it doesn’t need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

name: Gogoat
description: Gogoat is the Mount Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Gogoat stands 5'7" (1.7m) tall and weighs 200lbs 10oz (91.0kg). They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

name: Pancham
description: Pancham is the Playful Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Pancham stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 17lbs 10oz (8.0kg). Wanting to make sure it’s taken seriously, Pancham’s always giving others a glare. But if it’s not focusing, it ends up smiling.

name: Pangoro
description: Pangoro is the Daunting Pokémon, a Fighting/Dark-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Pangoro stands 6'11" (2.1m) tall and weighs 299lbs 13oz (136.0kg). Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

name: Furfrou
description: Furfrou is the Poodle Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Furfrou stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 61lbs 12oz (28.0kg). Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

name: Espurr
description: Espurr is the Restraint Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Espurr stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 7lbs 11oz (3.5kg). There’s enough psychic power in Espurr to send a wrestler flying, but because this power can’t be controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.

name: Meowstic
description: Meowstic is the Constraint Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Meowstic stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 18lbs 12oz (8.5kg). The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It’s when they’re protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

name: Honedge
description: Honedge is the Sword Pokémon, a Steel/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Honedge stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 4lbs 7oz (2.0kg). The blue eye on the sword’s handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people’s lives away.

name: Doublade
description: Doublade is the Sword Pokémon, a Steel/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Doublade stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 9lbs 15oz (4.5kg). The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

name: Aegislash
description: Aegislash is the Royal Sword Pokémon, a Steel/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Aegislash stands 5'7" (1.7m) tall and weighs 116lbs 14oz (53.0kg). Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

name: Spritzee
description: Spritzee is the Perfume Pokémon, a Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Spritzee stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 1lbs 2oz (0.5kg). The scent its body gives off enraptures those who smell it. Noble ladies had no shortage of love for Spritzee.

name: Aromatisse
description: Aromatisse is the Fragrance Pokémon, a Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Aromatisse stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 34lbs 3oz (15.5kg). The scents Aromatisse can produce range from sweet smells that bolster allies to foul smells that sap an opponent’s will to fight.

name: Swirlix
description: Swirlix is the Cotton Candy Pokémon, a Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Swirlix stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 7lbs 11oz (3.5kg).
