The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumes Swirlix’s fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits out sticky string to tangle up its enemies.

name: Slurpuff
description: Slurpuff is the Meringue Pokémon, a Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Slurpuff stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 11lbs (5.0kg). Slurpuff’s fur contains a lot of air, making it soft to the touch and lighter than it looks.

name: Inkay
description: Inkay is the Revolving Pokémon, a Dark/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Inkay stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 7lbs 11oz (3.5kg). By exposing foes to the blinking of its luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them, and then it seizes the chance to flee.

name: Malamar
description: Malamar is the Overturning Pokémon, a Dark/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Malamar stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 103lbs 10oz (47.0kg). It’s said that Malamar’s hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.

name: Binacle
description: Binacle is the Two-Handed Pokémon, a Rock/Water-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Binacle stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 68lbs 5oz (31.0kg). If the two don’t work well together, both their offense and defense fall apart. Without good teamwork, they won’t survive.

name: Barbaracle
description: Barbaracle is the Collective Pokémon, a Rock/Water-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Barbaracle stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 211lbs 10oz (96.0kg). Having an eye on each palm allows it to keep watch in all directions. In a pinch, its limbs start to act on their own to ensure the enemy’s defeat.

name: Skrelp
description: Skrelp is the Mock Kelp Pokémon, a Poison/Water-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Skrelp stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 16lbs 1oz (7.3kg). Skrelp looks like a piece of rotten seaweed, so it can blend in with seaweed drifting on the ocean and avoid being detected by enemies.

name: Dragalge
description: Dragalge is the Mock Kelp Pokémon, a Poison/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Dragalge stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 179lbs 11oz (81.5kg). Dragalge generates dragon energy by sticking the plume on its head out above the ocean’s surface and bathing it in sunlight.

name: Clauncher
description: Clauncher is the Water Gun Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Clauncher stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 18lbs 5oz (8.3kg). By detonating gas that accumulates in its right claw, this Pokémon launches water like a bullet. This is how Clauncher defeats its enemies.

name: Clawitzer
description: Clawitzer is the Howitzer Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Clawitzer stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 77lbs 13oz (35.3kg). Clawitzer’s right arm is a cannon that launches projectiles made of seawater. Shots from a Clawitzer’s cannon arm can sink a tanker.

name: Helioptile
description: Helioptile is the Generator Pokémon, a Electric/Normal-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Helioptile stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 13lbs 4oz (6.0kg). The sun powers this Pokémon’s electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.

name: Heliolisk
description: Heliolisk is the Generator Pokémon, a Electric/Normal-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Heliolisk stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 46lbs 5oz (21.0kg). One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

name: Tyrunt
description: Tyrunt is the Royal Heir Pokémon, a Rock/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Tyrunt stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 57lbs 5oz (26.0kg). This Pokémon is selfish and likes to be pampered. It can also inflict grievous wounds on its Trainer just by playing around.

name: Tyrantrum
description: Tyrantrum is the Despot Pokémon, a Rock/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Tyrantrum stands 8'2" (2.5m) tall and weighs 595lbs 4oz (270.0kg). A single bite of Tyrantrum’s massive jaws will demolish a car. This Pokémon was the king of the ancient world.

name: Amaura
description: Amaura is the Tundra Pokémon, a Rock/Ice-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Amaura stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 55lbs 9oz (25.2kg). Amaura is an ancient Pokémon that has gone extinct. Specimens of this species can sometimes be found frozen in ice.

name: Aurorus
description: Aurorus is the Tundra Pokémon, a Rock/Ice-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Aurorus stands 8'10" (2.7m) tall and weighs 496lbs 1oz (225.0kg). When gripped by rage, Aurorus will emanate freezing air, covering everything around it in ice.

name: Sylveon
description: Sylveon is the Intertwining Pokémon, a Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Sylveon stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 51lbs 13oz (23.5kg). It emits a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped organs. It wraps these appendages around quarrelers to instantly restore calm to the situation.

name: Hawlucha
description: Hawlucha is the Wrestling Pokémon, a Fighting/Flying-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Hawlucha stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 47lbs 6oz (21.5kg). It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.

name: Dedenne
description: Dedenne is the Antenna Pokémon, a Electric/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Dedenne stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 4lbs 14oz (2.2kg). Since Dedenne can’t generate much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.

name: Carbink
description: Carbink is the Jewel Pokémon, a Rock/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Carbink stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 12lbs 9oz (5.7kg). It’s said that somewhere in the world, there’s a mineral vein housing a large pack of slumbering Carbink. It’s also said that this pack has a queen.

name: Goomy
description: Goomy is the Soft Tissue Pokémon, a Dragon-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Goomy stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 6lbs 3oz (2.8kg). Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.

name: Sliggoo
description: Sliggoo is the Soft Tissue Pokémon, a Dragon-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Sliggoo stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 38lbs 9oz (17.5kg). A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

name: Goodra
description: Goodra is the Dragon Pokémon, a Dragon-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Goodra stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 331lbs 13oz (150.5kg). Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

name: Klefki
description: Klefki is the Key Ring Pokémon, a Steel/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Klefki stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 6lbs 10oz (3.0kg). Klefki sucks in metal ions with the horn topping its head. It seems this Pokémon loves keys so much that its head needed to look like one, too.

name: Phantump
description: Phantump is the Stump Pokémon, a Ghost/Grass-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Phantump stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 15lbs 7oz (7.0kg). With a voice like a human child’s, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

name: Trevenant
description: Trevenant is the Elder Tree Pokémon, a Ghost/Grass-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Trevenant stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 156lbs 8oz (71.0kg). Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon’s feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.

name: Pumpkaboo
description: Pumpkaboo is the Pumpkin Pokémon, a Ghost/Grass-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Pumpkaboo stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 11lbs (5.0kg). The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

name: Gourgeist
description: Gourgeist is the Pumpkin Pokémon, a Ghost/Grass-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Gourgeist stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 27lbs 9oz (12.5kg). In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

name: Bergmite
description: Bergmite is the Ice Chunk Pokémon, a Ice-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Bergmite stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 219lbs 6oz (99.5kg). Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.

name: Avalugg
description: Avalugg is the Iceberg Pokémon, a Ice-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Avalugg stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 1113lbs 5oz (505.0kg). The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

name: Noibat
description: Noibat is the Sound Wave Pokémon, a Flying/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Noibat stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 17lbs 10oz (8.0kg). No wavelength of sound is beyond Noibat’s ability to produce. The ultrasonic waves it generates can overcome much larger Pokémon.

name: Noivern
description: Noivern is the Sound Wave Pokémon, a Flying/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Noivern stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 187lbs 6oz (85.0kg). Flying through the darkness, it weakens enemies with ultrasonic waves that could crush stone. Its fangs finish the fight.

name: Xerneas
description: Xerneas is a Legendary Life Pokémon, a Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Xerneas stands 9'10" (3.0m) tall and weighs 474lbs (215.0kg). When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

name: Yveltal
description: Yveltal is a Legendary Destruction Pokémon, a Dark/Flying-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Yveltal stands 19' (5.8m) tall and weighs 447lbs 9oz (203.0kg). When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Zygarde
description: Zygarde is a Legendary Order Pokémon, a Dragon/Ground-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Zygarde stands 16'5" (5.0m) tall and weighs 672lbs 7oz (305.0kg). Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

name: Diancie
description: Diancie is a Mythical Jewel Pokémon, a Rock/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Diancie stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 19lbs 6oz (8.8kg). It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

name: Hoopa
description: Hoopa is a Mythical Mischief Pokémon, a Psychic/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Hoopa stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 19lbs 13oz (9.0kg). It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.

name: Volcanion
description: Volcanion is a Mythical Steam Pokémon, a Fire/Water-type species introduced in Generation VI. It first appeared in Pokemon X. Volcanion stands 5'7" (1.7m) tall and weighs 429lbs 14oz (195.0kg). It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

name: Rowlet
description: Rowlet is the Grass Quill Pokémon, a Grass/Flying-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Rowlet stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 3lbs 5oz (1.5kg). Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.

name: Dartrix
description: Dartrix is the Blade Quill Pokémon, a Grass/Flying-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Dartrix stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 35lbs 4oz (16.0kg). Regularly basks in sunlight to gather power—presumably due to the frigid climate. Nonetheless, the edges of the blade quills set into its wings are keen as ever.

name: Decidueye
description: Decidueye is the Arrow Quill Pokémon, a Grass/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Decidueye stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 80lbs 11oz (36.6kg). The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.

name: Litten
description: Litten is the Fire Cat Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Litten stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 9lbs 8oz (4.3kg). Trying to pet Litten before it trusts you will result in a nasty scratch from its sharp claws. Be careful.

name: Torracat
description: Torracat is the Fire Cat Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Torracat stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 55lbs 2oz (25.0kg). When facing a powerful enemy, Torracat’s fighting spirit gets pumped up, and its fire bell blazes hotter.

name: Incineroar
description: Incineroar is the Heel Pokémon, a Fire/Dark-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Incineroar stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 183lbs (83.0kg). Incineroar’s rough and aggressive behavior is its most notable trait, but the way it helps out small Pokémon shows that it has a kind side as well.

name: Popplio
description: Popplio is the Sea Lion Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Popplio stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 16lbs 9oz (7.5kg). If Popplio want to create big, powerful balloons, they must be persistent. It takes daily practice for these Pokémon to develop their skills.

name: Brionne
description: Brionne is the Pop Star Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Brionne stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 38lbs 9oz (17.5kg). On nights when the sea is calm, Brionne dance with one another to the singing of the Primarina that’s leading them.

name: Primarina
description: Primarina is the Soloist Pokémon, a Water/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Primarina stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 97lbs (44.0kg). For Primarina, every battle’s a stage. Its singing and the dancing of its balloons will mesmerize the audience.

name: Pikipek
description: Pikipek is the Woodpecker Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Pikipek stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 2lbs 10oz (1.2kg). It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!

name: Trumbeak
description: Trumbeak is the Bugle Beak Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Trumbeak stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 32lbs 10oz (14.8kg). From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.

name: Toucannon
description: Toucannon is the Cannon Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Toucannon stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 57lbs 5oz (26.0kg). Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.

name: Yungoos
description: Yungoos is the Loitering Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Yungoos stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 13lbs 4oz (6.0kg). Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.

name: Gumshoos
description: Gumshoos is the Stakeout Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Gumshoos stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 31lbs 5oz (14.2kg). Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!

name: Grubbin
description: Grubbin is the Larva Pokémon, a Bug-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Grubbin stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 9lbs 11oz (4.4kg). It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.

name: Charjabug
description: Charjabug is the Battery Pokémon, a Bug/Electric-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Charjabug stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 23lbs 2oz (10.5kg). Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores the electricity for later use.

name: Vikavolt
description: Vikavolt is the Stag Beetle Pokémon, a Bug/Electric-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Vikavolt stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 99lbs 3oz (45.0kg). If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.

name: Crabrawler
description: Crabrawler is the Boxing Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Crabrawler stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 15lbs 7oz (7.0kg). Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.

name: Crabominable
description: Crabominable is the Woolly Crab Pokémon, a Fighting/Ice-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Crabominable stands 5'7" (1.7m) tall and weighs 396lbs 13oz (180.0kg). Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.

name: Oricorio
description: Oricorio is the Dancing Pokémon, a Fire/Flying-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Oricorio stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 7lbs 8oz (3.4kg). This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

name: Cutiefly
description: Cutiefly is the Bee Fly Pokémon, a Bug/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Cutiefly stands 4" (0.1m) tall and weighs 7oz (0.2kg). An opponent’s aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent’s next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

name: Ribombee
description: Ribombee is the Bee Fly Pokémon, a Bug/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Ribombee stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 1lbs 2oz (0.5kg). Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.

name: Rockruff
description: Rockruff is the Puppy Pokémon, a Rock-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Rockruff stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 20lbs 5oz (9.2kg). This Pokémon intimidates opponents by striking the ground with the rocks on its neck. The moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.

name: Lycanroc
description: Lycanroc is the Wolf Pokémon, a Rock-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Lycanroc stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 55lbs 2oz (25.0kg). With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.

name: Wishiwashi
description: Wishiwashi is the Small Fry Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Wishiwashi stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 11oz (0.3kg). When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.

name: Mareanie
description: Mareanie is the Brutal Star Pokémon, a Poison/Water-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Mareanie stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 17lbs 10oz (8.0kg). Unlike their Alolan counterparts, the Mareanie of the Galar region have not yet figured out that the branches of Corsola are delicious.

name: Toxapex
description: Toxapex is the Brutal Star Pokémon, a Poison/Water-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Toxapex stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 31lbs 15oz (14.5kg). Within the poison sac in its body is a poison so toxic that Pokémon as large as Wailord will still be suffering three days after it first takes effect.

name: Mudbray
description: Mudbray is the Donkey Pokémon, a Ground-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Mudbray stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 242lbs 8oz (110.0kg). It eats dirt to create mud and smears this mud all over its feet, giving them the grip needed to walk on rough terrain without slipping.

name: Mudsdale
description: Mudsdale is the Draft Horse Pokémon, a Ground-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Mudsdale stands 8'2" (2.5m) tall and weighs 2028lbs 4oz (920.0kg). Mudsdale has so much stamina that it could carry over 10 tons across the Galar region without rest or sleep.

name: Dewpider
description: Dewpider is the Water Bubble Pokémon, a Water/Bug-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Dewpider stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 8lbs 13oz (4.0kg). Dewpider normally lives underwater. When it comes onto land in search of food, it takes water with it in the form of a bubble on its head.

name: Araquanid
description: Araquanid is the Water Bubble Pokémon, a Water/Bug-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Araquanid stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 180lbs 12oz (82.0kg). It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.

name: Fomantis
description: Fomantis is the Sickle Grass Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Fomantis stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 3lbs 5oz (1.5kg). During the day, Fomantis basks in sunlight and sleeps peacefully. It wakes and moves around at night.

name: Lurantis
description: Lurantis is the Bloom Sickle Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Lurantis stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 40lbs 13oz (18.5kg). The petals on this Pokémon’s arms are thin and super sharp, and they can fire laser beams if Lurantis gathers light first.

name: Morelull
description: Morelull is the Illuminating Pokémon, a Grass/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Morelull stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 3lbs 5oz (1.5kg). Morelull live in forests that stay dark even during the day. They scatter flickering spores that put enemies to sleep.

name: Shiinotic
description: Shiinotic is the Illuminating Pokémon, a Grass/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Shiinotic stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 25lbs 6oz (11.5kg). If you see a light deep in a forest at night, don’t go near. Shiinotic will make you fall fast asleep.

name: Salandit
description: Salandit is the Toxic Lizard Pokémon, a Poison/Fire-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Salandit stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 10lbs 9oz (4.8kg). This sneaky Pokémon will slink behind its prey and immobilize it with poisonous gas before the prey even realizes Salandit is there.

name: Salazzle
description: Salazzle is the Toxic Lizard Pokémon, a Poison/Fire-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Salazzle stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 48lbs 15oz (22.2kg). The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.

name: Stufful
description: Stufful is the Flailing Pokémon, a Normal/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Stufful stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 15lbs (6.8kg). The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.

name: Bewear
description: Bewear is the Strong Arm Pokémon, a Normal/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Bewear stands 6'11" (2.1m) tall and weighs 297lbs 10oz (135.0kg). The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

name: Bounsweet
description: Bounsweet is the Fruit Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Bounsweet stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 7lbs 1oz (3.2kg). When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.

name: Steenee
description: Steenee is the Fruit Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Steenee stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 18lbs 1oz (8.2kg). Any Corvisquire that pecks at this Pokémon will be greeted with a smack from its sepals followed by a sharp kick.

name: Tsareena
description: Tsareena is the Fruit Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Tsareena stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 47lbs 3oz (21.4kg). A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon’s legs leaves a wound in the opponent’s body and soul that will never heal.

name: Comfey
description: Comfey is the Posy Picker Pokémon, a Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Comfey stands 4" (0.1m) tall and weighs 11oz (0.3kg). These Pokémon smell very nice. All Comfey wear different flowers, so each of these Pokémon has its own individual scent.

name: Oranguru
description: Oranguru is the Sage Pokémon, a Normal/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Oranguru stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 167lbs 9oz (76.0kg). It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

name: Passimian
description: Passimian is the Teamwork Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Passimian stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 182lbs 9oz (82.8kg). Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.

name: Wimpod
description: Wimpod is the Turn Tail Pokémon, a Bug/Water-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Wimpod stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 26lbs 7oz (12.0kg). Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger. They scatter the moment they detect an enemy’s presence.

name: Golisopod
description: Golisopod is the Hard Scale Pokémon, a Bug/Water-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Golisopod stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 238lbs 2oz (108.0kg). They live in sunken ships or in holes in the seabed. When Golisopod and Grapploct battle, the loser becomes the winner’s meal.

name: Sandygast
description: Sandygast is the Sand Heap Pokémon, a Ghost/Ground-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Sandygast stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 154lbs 5oz (70.0kg). Sandygast mainly inhabits beaches. It takes control of anyone who puts their hand into its mouth, forcing them to make its body bigger.

name: Palossand
description: Palossand is the Sand Castle Pokémon, a Ghost/Ground-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Palossand stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 551lbs 2oz (250.0kg). This Pokémon lives on beaches, but it hates water. Palossand can’t maintain its castle-like shape if it gets drenched by a heavy rain.

name: Pyukumuku
description: Pyukumuku is the Sea Cucumber Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Pyukumuku stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 2lbs 10oz (1.2kg). It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it encounters a foe, it will spit out its internal organs as a means to punch them.

name: Silvally
description: Silvally is a Legendary Synthetic Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Silvally stands 7'7" (2.3m) tall and weighs 221lbs 9oz (100.5kg). The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Minior
description: Minior is the Meteor Pokémon, a Rock/Flying-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Minior stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 88lbs 3oz (40.0kg). Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.

name: Komala
description: Komala is the Drowsing Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Komala stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 43lbs 14oz (19.9kg). It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.

name: Turtonator
description: Turtonator is the Blast Turtle Pokémon, a Fire/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Turtonator stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 467lbs 6oz (212.0kg). Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.

name: Togedemaru
description: Togedemaru is the Roly-Poly Pokémon, a Electric/Steel-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Togedemaru stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 7lbs 4oz (3.3kg). When it’s in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

name: Mimikyu
description: Mimikyu is the Disguise Pokémon, a Ghost/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Mimikyu stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 1lbs 9oz (0.7kg). There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

name: Bruxish
description: Bruxish is the Gnash Teeth Pokémon, a Water/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Bruxish stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 41lbs 14oz (19.0kg). Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie’s spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.

name: Drampa
description: Drampa is the Placid Pokémon, a Normal/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Drampa stands 9'10" (3.0m) tall and weighs 407lbs 14oz (185.0kg). Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it’s angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

name: Dhelmise
description: Dhelmise is the Sea Creeper Pokémon, a Ghost/Grass-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Dhelmise stands 12'10" (3.9m) tall and weighs 463lbs (210.0kg). After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It catches large Wailord and drains their life-force.

name: Jangmo-o
description: Jangmo-o is the Scaly Pokémon, a Dragon-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Jangmo-o stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 65lbs 8oz (29.7kg). Jangmo-o strikes its scales to communicate with others of its kind. Its scales are actually fur that’s become as hard as metal.

name: Hakamo-o
description: Hakamo-o is the Scaly Pokémon, a Dragon/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Hakamo-o stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 103lbs 10oz (47.0kg). Before attacking its enemies, it clashes its scales together and roars. Its sharp claws shred the opposition.

name: Kommo-o
description: Kommo-o is the Scaly Pokémon, a Dragon/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Kommo-o stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 172lbs 6oz (78.2kg). Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriors wearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.

name: Tapu Koko
description: Tapu Koko is a Legendary Land Spirit Pokémon, a Electric/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Tapu Koko stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 45lbs 3oz (20.5kg). The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.

name: Tapu Lele
description: Tapu Lele is a Legendary Land Spirit Pokémon, a Psychic/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Tapu Lele stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 41lbs (18.6kg). Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.

name: Tapu Bulu
description: Tapu Bulu is a Legendary Land Spirit Pokémon, a Grass/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Tapu Bulu stands 6'3" (1.9m) tall and weighs 100lbs 5oz (45.5kg). It makes ringing sounds with its tail to let others know where it is, avoiding unneeded conflicts. This guardian deity of Ula’ula controls plants.

name: Tapu Fini
description: Tapu Fini is a Legendary Land Spirit Pokémon, a Water/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Tapu Fini stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 46lbs 12oz (21.2kg). Although it’s called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.

name: Cosmog
description: Cosmog is a Legendary Nebula Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Cosmog stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 4oz (0.1kg). Cosmog is very curious but not very cautious, often placing itself in danger. If things start to look dicey, it teleports away.

name: Cosmoem
description: Cosmoem is a Legendary Protostar Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Cosmoem stands 4" (0.1m) tall and weighs 2204lbs 6oz (999.9kg). It sucks in dust from the air at an astounding rate, frantically building up energy within its core as preparation for evolution.

name: Solgaleo
description: Solgaleo is a Legendary Sunne Pokémon, a Psychic/Steel-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Solgaleo stands 11'2" (3.4m) tall and weighs 507lbs 1oz (230.0kg). Solgaleo was once known as the Beast That Devours the Sun. Energy in the form of light radiates boundlessly from it.

name: Lunala
description: Lunala is a Legendary Moone Pokémon, a Psychic/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Lunala stands 13'1" (4.0m) tall and weighs 264lbs 9oz (120.0kg). It steals the light from its surroundings and then becomes the full moon, showering its own light across the night sky.

name: Nihilego
description: Nihilego is the Parasite Pokémon, a Rock/Poison-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Nihilego stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 122lbs 6oz (55.5kg). It appeared in this world from an Ultra Wormhole. Nihilego appears to be a parasite that lives by feeding on people and Pokémon.

name: Buzzwole
description: Buzzwole is the Swollen Pokémon, a Bug/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Buzzwole stands 7'10" (2.4m) tall and weighs 735lbs 7oz (333.6kg). Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Pheromosa
description: Pheromosa is the Lissome Pokémon, a Bug/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Pheromosa stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 55lbs 2oz (25.0kg). Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Xurkitree
description: Xurkitree is the Glowing Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Xurkitree stands 12'6" (3.8m) tall and weighs 220lbs 7oz (100.0kg). They’ve been dubbed Ultra Beasts. Some of them stand unmoving, like trees, with their arms and legs stuck into the ground.

name: Celesteela
description: Celesteela is the Launch Pokémon, a Steel/Flying-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Celesteela stands 30'2" (9.2m) tall and weighs 2204lbs 6oz (999.9kg). Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Kartana
description: Kartana is the Drawn Sword Pokémon, a Grass/Steel-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Kartana stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 4oz (0.1kg). Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Guzzlord
description: Guzzlord is the Junkivore Pokémon, a Dark/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Guzzlord stands 18'1" (5.5m) tall and weighs 1957lbs 11oz (888.0kg). An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.

name: Necrozma
description: Necrozma is a Legendary Prism Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Necrozma stands 7'10" (2.4m) tall and weighs 507lbs 1oz (230.0kg). It needs light to survive, and it goes on a rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will cut anything to pieces.

name: Magearna
description: Magearna is a Mythical Artificial Pokémon, a Steel/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Magearna stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 177lbs 8oz (80.5kg). Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

name: Marshadow
description: Marshadow is a Mythical Gloomdweller Pokémon, a Fighting/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sun. Marshadow stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 48lbs 15oz (22.2kg). This Pokémon can conceal itself in any shadow, so it went undiscovered for a long time.

name: Poipole
description: Poipole is the Poison Pin Pokémon, a Poison-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Ultra Sun. Poipole stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 3lbs 15oz (1.8kg). An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.

name: Naganadel
description: Naganadel is the Poison Pin Pokémon, a Poison/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Ultra Sun. Naganadel stands 11'10" (3.6m) tall and weighs 330lbs 11oz (150.0kg). One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.

name: Stakataka
description: Stakataka is the Rampart Pokémon, a Rock/Steel-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Ultra Sun. Stakataka stands 18'1" (5.5m) tall and weighs 1807lbs 13oz (820.0kg). When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute’s true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.

name: Blacephalon
description: Blacephalon is the Fireworks Pokémon, a Fire/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Ultra Sun. Blacephalon stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 28lbs 11oz (13.0kg). A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents’ surprise to rob them of their vitality.

name: Zeraora
description: Zeraora is a Mythical Thunderclap Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Ultra Sun. Zeraora stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 98lbs 2oz (44.5kg). Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs. Wherever Zeraora runs, lightning flashes and thunder echoes.

name: Meltan
description: Meltan is a Mythical Hex Nut Pokémon, a Steel-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Let's Go, Pikachu!. Meltan stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 17lbs 10oz (8.0kg). They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.

name: Melmetal
description: Melmetal is a Mythical Hex Nut Pokémon, a Steel-type species introduced in Generation VII. It first appeared in Pokemon Let's Go, Pikachu!. Melmetal stands 8'2" (2.5m) tall and weighs 1763lbs 11oz (800.0kg). Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal’s heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokémon.

name: Grookey
description: Grookey is the Chimp Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Grookey stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 11lbs (5.0kg). It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.

name: Thwackey
description: Thwackey is the Beat Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Thwackey stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 30lbs 14oz (14.0kg). When it’s drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won’t even notice that it’s already knocked out its opponent.

name: Rillaboom
description: Rillaboom is the Drummer Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Rillaboom stands 6'11" (2.1m) tall and weighs 198lbs 7oz (90.0kg). The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.

name: Scorbunny
description: Scorbunny is the Rabbit Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Scorbunny stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 9lbs 15oz (4.5kg). It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it’s raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

name: Raboot
description: Raboot is the Rabbit Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Raboot stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 19lbs 13oz (9.0kg). It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

name: Cinderace
description: Cinderace is the Striker Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Cinderace stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 72lbs 12oz (33.0kg). It’s skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

name: Sobble
description: Sobble is the Water Lizard Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Sobble stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 8lbs 13oz (4.0kg). When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.

name: Drizzile
description: Drizzile is the Water Lizard Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Drizzile stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 25lbs 6oz (11.5kg). Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.

name: Inteleon
description: Inteleon is the Secret Agent Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Inteleon stands 6'3" (1.9m) tall and weighs 99lbs 10oz (45.2kg). Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes’ weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

name: Skwovet
description: Skwovet is the Cheeky Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Skwovet stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 5lbs 8oz (2.5kg). It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It’ll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.

name: Greedent
description: Greedent is the Greedy Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Greedent stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 13lbs 4oz (6.0kg). Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.

name: Rookidee
description: Rookidee is the Tiny Bird Pokémon, a Flying-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Rookidee stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 3lbs 15oz (1.8kg). Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.

name: Corvisquire
description: Corvisquire is the Raven Pokémon, a Flying-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Corvisquire stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 35lbs 4oz (16.0kg). The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent’s strength.

name: Corviknight
description: Corviknight is the Raven Pokémon, a Flying/Steel-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Corviknight stands 7'3" (2.2m) tall and weighs 165lbs 6oz (75.0kg). With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region’s airborne taxi service.

name: Blipbug
description: Blipbug is the Larva Pokémon, a Bug-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Blipbug stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 17lbs 10oz (8.0kg). Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

name: Dottler
description: Dottler is the Radome Pokémon, a Bug/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Dottler stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 43lbs (19.5kg). As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

name: Orbeetle
description: Orbeetle is the Seven Spot Pokémon, a Bug/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Orbeetle stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 89lbs 15oz (40.8kg). It emits psychic energy to observe and study what’s around it—and what’s around it can include things over six miles away.

name: Nickit
description: Nickit is the Fox Pokémon, a Dark-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Nickit stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 19lbs 10oz (8.9kg). Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

name: Thievul
description: Thievul is the Fox Pokémon, a Dark-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Thievul stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 43lbs 14oz (19.9kg). With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.

name: Gossifleur
description: Gossifleur is the Flowering Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Gossifleur stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 4lbs 14oz (2.2kg). It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

name: Eldegoss
description: Eldegoss is the Cotton Bloom Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Eldegoss stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 5lbs 8oz (2.5kg). The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

name: Wooloo
description: Wooloo is the Sheep Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Wooloo stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 13lbs 4oz (6.0kg). If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won’t be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

name: Dubwool
description: Dubwool is the Sheep Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Dubwool stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 94lbs 13oz (43.0kg). Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

name: Chewtle
description: Chewtle is the Snapping Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Chewtle stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 18lbs 12oz (8.5kg). It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

name: Drednaw
description: Drednaw is the Bite Pokémon, a Water/Rock-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Drednaw stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 254lbs 10oz (115.5kg). This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

name: Yamper
description: Yamper is the Puppy Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Yamper stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 29lbs 12oz (13.5kg). This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

name: Boltund
description: Boltund is the Dog Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Boltund stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 74lbs 15oz (34.0kg). It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

name: Rolycoly
description: Rolycoly is the Coal Pokémon, a Rock-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Rolycoly stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 26lbs 7oz (12.0kg). It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.

name: Carkol
description: Carkol is the Coal Pokémon, a Rock/Fire-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Carkol stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 171lbs 15oz (78.0kg). By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Coalossal
description: Coalossal is the Coal Pokémon, a Rock/Fire-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Coalossal stands 9'2" (2.8m) tall and weighs 684lbs 9oz (310.5kg). While it’s engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

name: Applin
description: Applin is the Apple Core Pokémon, a Grass/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Applin stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 1lbs 2oz (0.5kg). As soon as it’s born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.

name: Flapple
description: Flapple is the Apple Wing Pokémon, a Grass/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Flapple stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 2lbs 3oz (1.0kg). It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

name: Appletun
description: Appletun is the Apple Nectar Pokémon, a Grass/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Appletun stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 28lbs 11oz (13.0kg). Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

name: Silicobra
description: Silicobra is the Sand Snake Pokémon, a Ground-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Silicobra stands 7'3" (2.2m) tall and weighs 16lbs 12oz (7.6kg). It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

name: Sandaconda
description: Sandaconda is the Sand Snake Pokémon, a Ground-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Sandaconda stands 12'6" (3.8m) tall and weighs 144lbs 6oz (65.5kg). Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

name: Cramorant
description: Cramorant is the Gulp Pokémon, a Flying/Water-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Cramorant stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 39lbs 11oz (18.0kg). This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.

name: Arrokuda
description: Arrokuda is the Rush Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Arrokuda stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 2lbs 3oz (1.0kg). After it’s eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That’s when Cramorant swallows it up.

name: Barraskewda
description: Barraskewda is the Skewer Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Barraskewda stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 66lbs 2oz (30.0kg). It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.

name: Toxel
description: Toxel is a Baby Baby Pokémon, a Electric/Poison-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Toxel stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 24lbs 4oz (11.0kg). It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.

name: Toxtricity
description: Toxtricity is the Punk Pokémon, a Electric/Poison-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Toxtricity stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 88lbs 3oz (40.0kg). This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

name: Sizzlipede
description: Sizzlipede is the Radiator Pokémon, a Fire/Bug-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Sizzlipede stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 2lbs 3oz (1.0kg). It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they’re well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

name: Centiskorch
description: Centiskorch is the Radiator Pokémon, a Fire/Bug-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Centiskorch stands 9'10" (3.0m) tall and weighs 264lbs 9oz (120.0kg). While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

name: Clobbopus
description: Clobbopus is the Tantrum Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Clobbopus stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 8lbs 13oz (4.0kg). Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn’t alarmed when that happens—it knows they’ll grow back. It’s about as smart as a three-year-old.

name: Grapploct
description: Grapploct is the Jujitsu Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Grapploct stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 86lbs (39.0kg). Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

name: Sinistea
description: Sinistea is the Black Tea Pokémon, a Ghost-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Sinistea stands 4" (0.1m) tall and weighs 7oz (0.2kg). The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.

name: Polteageist
description: Polteageist is the Black Tea Pokémon, a Ghost-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Polteageist stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 14oz (0.4kg). Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.

name: Hatenna
description: Hatenna is the Calm Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Hatenna stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 7lbs 8oz (3.4kg). If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.

name: Hattrem
description: Hattrem is the Serene Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Hattrem stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 10lbs 9oz (4.8kg). Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.

name: Hatterene
description: Hatterene is the Silent Pokémon, a Psychic/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Hatterene stands 6'11" (2.1m) tall and weighs 11lbs 4oz (5.1kg). If you’re too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.

name: Impidimp
description: Impidimp is the Wily Pokémon, a Dark/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Impidimp stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 12lbs 2oz (5.5kg). It sneaks into people’s homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.

name: Morgrem
description: Morgrem is the Devious Pokémon, a Dark/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Morgrem stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 27lbs 9oz (12.5kg). With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.

name: Grimmsnarl
description: Grimmsnarl is the Bulk Up Pokémon, a Dark/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Grimmsnarl stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 134lbs 8oz (61.0kg). Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.

name: Obstagoon
description: Obstagoon is the Blocking Pokémon, a Dark/Normal-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Obstagoon stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 101lbs 7oz (46.0kg). It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

name: Perrserker
description: Perrserker is the Viking Pokémon, a Steel-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Perrserker stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 61lbs 12oz (28.0kg). After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

name: Cursola
description: Cursola is the Coral Pokémon, a Ghost-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Cursola stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 14oz (0.4kg). Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You’ll become stiff as stone if you touch it.

name: Sirfetch'd
description: Sirfetch'd is the Wild Duck Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Sirfetch'd stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 257lbs 15oz (117.0kg). After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.

name: Mr. Rime
description: Mr. Rime is the Comedian Pokémon, a Ice/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Mr. Rime stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 128lbs 5oz (58.2kg). Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

name: Runerigus
description: Runerigus is the Grudge Pokémon, a Ground/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Runerigus stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 146lbs 13oz (66.6kg). Never touch its shadowlike body, or you’ll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.

name: Milcery
description: Milcery is the Cream Pokémon, a Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Milcery stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 11oz (0.3kg). They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.

name: Alcremie
description: Alcremie is the Cream Pokémon, a Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Alcremie stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 1lbs 2oz (0.5kg). When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

name: Falinks
description: Falinks is the Formation Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Falinks stands 9'10" (3.0m) tall and weighs 136lbs 11oz (62.0kg). The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

name: Pincurchin
description: Pincurchin is the Sea Urchin Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Pincurchin stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 2lbs 3oz (1.0kg). It stores electricity in each spine. Even if one gets broken off, it still continues to emit electricity for at least three hours.

name: Snom
description: Snom is the Worm Pokémon, a Ice/Bug-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Snom stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 8lbs 6oz (3.8kg). It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.

name: Frosmoth
description: Frosmoth is the Frost Moth Pokémon, a Ice/Bug-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Frosmoth stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 92lbs 10oz (42.0kg). It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

name: Stonjourner
description: Stonjourner is the Big Rock Pokémon, a Rock-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Stonjourner stands 8'2" (2.5m) tall and weighs 1146lbs 6oz (520.0kg). Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.

name: Eiscue
description: Eiscue is the Penguin Pokémon, a Ice-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Eiscue stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 196lbs 3oz (89.0kg). This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.

name: Indeedee
description: Indeedee is the Emotion Pokémon, a Psychic/Normal-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Indeedee stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 61lbs 12oz (28.0kg). Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.

name: Morpeko
description: Morpeko is the Two-Sided Pokémon, a Electric/Dark-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Morpeko stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 6lbs 10oz (3.0kg). It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they’re precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.

name: Cufant
description: Cufant is the Copperderm Pokémon, a Steel-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Cufant stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 220lbs 7oz (100.0kg). If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.

name: Copperajah
description: Copperajah is the Copperderm Pokémon, a Steel-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Copperajah stands 9'10" (3.0m) tall and weighs 1433lbs (650.0kg). These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

name: Dracozolt
description: Dracozolt is the Fossil Pokémon, a Electric/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Dracozolt stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 418lbs 14oz (190.0kg). The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity. Compared to its lower body, its upper half is entirely too small.

name: Arctozolt
description: Arctozolt is the Fossil Pokémon, a Electric/Ice-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Arctozolt stands 7'7" (2.3m) tall and weighs 330lbs 11oz (150.0kg). This Pokémon lived on prehistoric seashores and was able to preserve food with the ice on its body. It went extinct because it moved so slowly.

name: Dracovish
description: Dracovish is the Fossil Pokémon, a Water/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Dracovish stands 7'7" (2.3m) tall and weighs 474lbs (215.0kg). Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokémon can’t breathe unless it’s underwater.

name: Arctovish
description: Arctovish is the Fossil Pokémon, a Water/Ice-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Arctovish stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 385lbs 13oz (175.0kg). The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made this Pokémon go extinct anyway.

name: Duraludon
description: Duraludon is the Alloy Pokémon, a Steel/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Duraludon stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 88lbs 3oz (40.0kg). The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility. It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.

name: Dreepy
description: Dreepy is the Lingering Pokémon, a Dragon/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Dreepy stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 4lbs 7oz (2.0kg). If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.

name: Drakloak
description: Drakloak is the Caretaker Pokémon, a Dragon/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Drakloak stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 24lbs 4oz (11.0kg). Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it’ll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.

name: Dragapult
description: Dragapult is the Stealth Pokémon, a Dragon/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Dragapult stands 9'10" (3.0m) tall and weighs 110lbs 4oz (50.0kg). Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult’s horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.

name: Zacian
description: Zacian is a Legendary Warrior Pokémon, a Fairy-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Zacian stands 9'2" (2.8m) tall and weighs 242lbs 8oz (110.0kg). This Pokémon has slumbered for many years. Some say it’s Zamazenta’s elder sister—others say the two Pokémon are rivals.

name: Zamazenta
description: Zamazenta is a Legendary Warrior Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Zamazenta stands 9'6" (2.9m) tall and weighs 463lbs (210.0kg). This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.

name: Eternatus
description: Eternatus is a Legendary Gigantic Pokémon, a Poison/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Eternatus stands 65'7" (20.0m) tall and weighs 2094lbs 6oz (950.0kg). It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.

name: Kubfu
description: Kubfu is a Legendary Wushu Pokémon, a Fighting-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Kubfu stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 26lbs 7oz (12.0kg). If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.

name: Urshifu
description: Urshifu is a Legendary Wushu Pokémon, a Fighting/Dark-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Urshifu stands 6'3" (1.9m) tall and weighs 231lbs 8oz (105.0kg). Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.

name: Zarude
description: Zarude is a Mythical Rogue Monkey Pokémon, a Dark/Grass-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Zarude stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 154lbs 5oz (70.0kg). Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

name: Regieleki
description: Regieleki is a Legendary Electron Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Regieleki stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 319lbs 11oz (145.0kg). Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all Galar’s electricity.

name: Regidrago
description: Regidrago is a Legendary Dragon Orb Pokémon, a Dragon-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Regidrago stands 6'11" (2.1m) tall and weighs 440lbs 15oz (200.0kg). Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.

name: Glastrier
description: Glastrier is a Legendary Wild Horse Pokémon, a Ice-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Glastrier stands 7'3" (2.2m) tall and weighs 1763lbs 11oz (800.0kg). Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times harder than diamond.

name: Spectrier
description: Spectrier is a Legendary Swift Horse Pokémon, a Ghost-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Spectrier stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 98lbs 2oz (44.5kg). As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs the life-force of sleeping creatures. It craves silence and solitude.

name: Calyrex
description: Calyrex is a Legendary King Pokémon, a Psychic/Grass-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Sword. Calyrex stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 17lbs (7.7kg). Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.

name: Wyrdeer
description: Wyrdeer is the Big Horn Pokémon, a Normal/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Legends: Arceus. Wyrdeer stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 209lbs 11oz (95.1kg). The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

name: Kleavor
description: Kleavor is the Axe Pokémon, a Bug/Rock-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Legends: Arceus. Kleavor stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 196lbs 3oz (89.0kg). A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

name: Ursaluna
description: Ursaluna is the Peat Pokémon, a Ground/Normal-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Legends: Arceus. Ursaluna stands 7'10" (2.4m) tall and weighs 639lbs 5oz (290.0kg). I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

name: Basculegion
description: Basculegion is the Big Fish Pokémon, a Water/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Legends: Arceus. Basculegion stands 9'10" (3.0m) tall and weighs 242lbs 8oz (110.0kg). Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

name: Sneasler
description: Sneasler is the Free Climb Pokémon, a Fighting/Poison-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Legends: Arceus. Sneasler stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 94lbs 13oz (43.0kg). Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

name: Overqwil
description: Overqwil is the Pin Cluster Pokémon, a Dark/Poison-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Legends: Arceus. Overqwil stands 8'2" (2.5m) tall and weighs 133lbs 6oz (60.5kg). Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

name: Enamorus
description: Enamorus is a Legendary Love-Hate Pokémon, a Fairy/Flying-type species introduced in Generation VIII. It first appeared in Pokemon Legends: Arceus. Enamorus stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 105lbs 13oz (48.0kg). When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

name: Sprigatito
description: Sprigatito is the Grass Cat Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Sprigatito stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 9lbs 1oz (4.1kg). The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

name: Floragato
description: Floragato is the Grass Cat Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Floragato stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 26lbs 14oz (12.2kg). The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

name: Meowscarada
description: Meowscarada is the Magician Pokémon, a Grass/Dark-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Meowscarada stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 68lbs 13oz (31.2kg). With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen-packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the bombs before its foes realize what’s going on.

name: Fuecoco
description: Fuecoco is the Fire Croc Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Fuecoco stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 21lbs 10oz (9.8kg). Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco’s head and flickers to and fro.

name: Crocalor
description: Crocalor is the Fire Croc Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Crocalor stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 67lbs 11oz (30.7kg). The valve in Crocalor’s flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

name: Skeledirge
description: Skeledirge is the Singer Pokémon, a Fire/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Skeledirge stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 719lbs 13oz (326.5kg). Skeledirge’s gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Quaxly
description: Quaxly is the Duckling Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Quaxly stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 13lbs 7oz (6.1kg). Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

name: Quaxwell
description: Quaxwell is the Practicing Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Quaxwell stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 47lbs 6oz (21.5kg). The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

name: Quaquaval
description: Quaquaval is the Dancer Pokémon, a Water/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Quaquaval stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 136lbs 7oz (61.9kg). Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.

name: Lechonk
description: Lechonk is the Hog Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Lechonk stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 22lbs 8oz (10.2kg). This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.

name: Oinkologne
description: Oinkologne is the Hog Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Oinkologne stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 264lbs 9oz (120.0kg). It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.

name: Tarountula
description: Tarountula is the String Ball Pokémon, a Bug-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Tarountula stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 8lbs 13oz (4.0kg). The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread’s strength is the topic of ongoing research.

name: Spidops
