description: Spidops is the Trap Pokémon, a Bug-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Spidops stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 36lbs 6oz (16.5kg). Spidops covers its territory in tough, sticky threads to set up traps for intruders.

name: Nymble
description: Nymble is the Grasshopper Pokémon, a Bug-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Nymble stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 2lbs 3oz (1.0kg). It’s highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.

name: Lokix
description: Lokix is the Grasshopper Pokémon, a Bug/Dark-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Lokix stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 38lbs 9oz (17.5kg). It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden on its body, so it can’t stay in this mode for long.

name: Pawmi
description: Pawmi is the Mouse Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Pawmi stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 5lbs 8oz (2.5kg). The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

name: Pawmo
description: Pawmo is the Mouse Pokémon, a Electric/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Pawmo stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 14lbs 5oz (6.5kg). Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

name: Pawmot
description: Pawmot is the Hands-On Pokémon, a Electric/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Pawmot stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 90lbs 6oz (41.0kg). Pawmot’s fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

name: Tandemaus
description: Tandemaus is the Couple Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Tandemaus stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 3lbs 15oz (1.8kg). The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

name: Maushold
description: Maushold is the Family Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Maushold stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 5lbs 1oz (2.3kg). The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

name: Fidough
description: Fidough is the Puppy Pokémon, a Fairy-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Fidough stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 24lbs (10.9kg). The yeast in Fidough’s breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.

name: Dachsbun
description: Dachsbun is the Dog Pokémon, a Fairy-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Dachsbun stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 32lbs 14oz (14.9kg). The surface of this Pokémon’s skin hardens when exposed to intense heat, and its body has an appetizing aroma.

name: Smoliv
description: Smoliv is the Olive Pokémon, a Grass/Normal-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Smoliv stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 14lbs 5oz (6.5kg). This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.

name: Dolliv
description: Dolliv is the Olive Pokémon, a Grass/Normal-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Dolliv stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 26lbs 4oz (11.9kg). It basks in the sun to its heart’s content until the fruits on its head ripen. After that, Dolliv departs from human settlements and goes on a journey.

name: Arboliva
description: Arboliva is the Olive Pokémon, a Grass/Normal-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Arboliva stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 106lbs 4oz (48.2kg). This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.

name: Squawkabilly
description: Squawkabilly is the Parrot Pokémon, a Normal/Flying-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Squawkabilly stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 5lbs 5oz (2.4kg). Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they’re out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

name: Nacli
description: Nacli is the Rock Salt Pokémon, a Rock-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Nacli stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 35lbs 4oz (16.0kg). The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli’s body.

name: Naclstack
description: Naclstack is the Rock Salt Pokémon, a Rock-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Naclstack stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 231lbs 8oz (105.0kg). It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

name: Garganacl
description: Garganacl is the Rock Salt Pokémon, a Rock-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Garganacl stands 7'7" (2.3m) tall and weighs 529lbs 2oz (240.0kg). Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping to lick at its mineral-rich salt.

name: Charcadet
description: Charcadet is the Fire Child Pokémon, a Fire-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Charcadet stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 23lbs 2oz (10.5kg). Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

name: Armarouge
description: Armarouge is the Fire Warrior Pokémon, a Fire/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Armarouge stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 187lbs 6oz (85.0kg). This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.

name: Ceruledge
description: Ceruledge is the Fire Blades Pokémon, a Fire/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Ceruledge stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 136lbs 11oz (62.0kg). An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon’s evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.

name: Tadbulb
description: Tadbulb is the EleTadpole Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Tadbulb stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 14oz (0.4kg). It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.

name: Bellibolt
description: Bellibolt is the EleFrog Pokémon, a Electric-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Bellibolt stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 249lbs 2oz (113.0kg). What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt’s belly-button dynamo.

name: Wattrel
description: Wattrel is the Storm Petrel Pokémon, a Electric/Flying-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Wattrel stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 7lbs 15oz (3.6kg). These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.

name: Kilowattrel
description: Kilowattrel is the Frigatebird Pokémon, a Electric/Flying-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Kilowattrel stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 85lbs 2oz (38.6kg). It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

name: Maschiff
description: Maschiff is the Rascal Pokémon, a Dark-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Maschiff stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 35lbs 4oz (16.0kg). Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

name: Mabosstiff
description: Mabosstiff is the Boss Pokémon, a Dark-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Mabosstiff stands 3'7" (1.1m) tall and weighs 134lbs 8oz (61.0kg). Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

name: Shroodle
description: Shroodle is the Toxic Mouse Pokémon, a Poison/Normal-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Shroodle stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 1lbs 9oz (0.7kg). To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

name: Grafaiai
description: Grafaiai is the Toxic Monkey Pokémon, a Poison/Normal-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Grafaiai stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 59lbs 15oz (27.2kg). Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.

name: Bramblin
description: Bramblin is the Tumbleweed Pokémon, a Grass/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Bramblin stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 1lbs 5oz (0.6kg). Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.

name: Brambleghast
description: Brambleghast is the Tumbleweed Pokémon, a Grass/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Brambleghast stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 13lbs 4oz (6.0kg). Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.

name: Toedscool
description: Toedscool is the Woodear Pokémon, a Ground/Grass-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Toedscool stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 72lbs 12oz (33.0kg). Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

name: Toedscruel
description: Toedscruel is the Woodear Pokémon, a Ground/Grass-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Toedscruel stands 6'3" (1.9m) tall and weighs 127lbs 14oz (58.0kg). It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

name: Klawf
description: Klawf is the Ambush Pokémon, a Rock-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Klawf stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 174lbs 3oz (79.0kg). This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.

name: Capsakid
description: Capsakid is the Spicy Pepper Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Capsakid stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 6lbs 10oz (3.0kg). Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

name: Scovillain
description: Scovillain is the Spicy Pepper Pokémon, a Grass/Fire-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Scovillain stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 33lbs 1oz (15.0kg). The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

name: Rellor
description: Rellor is the Rolling Pokémon, a Bug-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Rellor stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 2lbs 3oz (1.0kg). It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.

name: Rabsca
description: Rabsca is the Rolling Pokémon, a Bug/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Rabsca stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 7lbs 11oz (3.5kg). An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.

name: Flittle
description: Flittle is the Frill Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Flittle stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 3lbs 5oz (1.5kg). It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

name: Espathra
description: Espathra is the Ostrich Pokémon, a Psychic-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Espathra stands 6'3" (1.9m) tall and weighs 198lbs 7oz (90.0kg). It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

name: Tinkatink
description: Tinkatink is the Metalsmith Pokémon, a Fairy/Steel-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Tinkatink stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 19lbs 10oz (8.9kg). This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.

name: Tinkatuff
description: Tinkatuff is the Hammer Pokémon, a Fairy/Steel-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Tinkatuff stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 130lbs 5oz (59.1kg). These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.

name: Tinkaton
description: Tinkaton is the Hammer Pokémon, a Fairy/Steel-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Tinkaton stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 248lbs 11oz (112.8kg). The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

name: Wiglett
description: Wiglett is the Garden Eel Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Wiglett stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 3lbs 15oz (1.8kg). Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely different species. The resemblance seems to be a coincidental result of environmental adaptation.

name: Wugtrio
description: Wugtrio is the Garden Eel Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Wugtrio stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 11lbs 14oz (5.4kg). A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.

name: Bombirdier
description: Bombirdier is the Item Drop Pokémon, a Flying/Dark-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Bombirdier stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 94lbs 9oz (42.9kg). Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

name: Finizen
description: Finizen is the Dolphin Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Finizen stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 132lbs 11oz (60.2kg). Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

name: Palafin
description: Palafin is the Dolphin Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Palafin stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 132lbs 11oz (60.2kg). Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen’s, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.

name: Varoom
description: Varoom is the Single-Cyl Pokémon, a Steel/Poison-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Varoom stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 77lbs 3oz (35.0kg). The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

name: Revavroom
description: Revavroom is the Multi-Cyl Pokémon, a Steel/Poison-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Revavroom stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 264lbs 9oz (120.0kg). Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.

name: Cyclizar
description: Cyclizar is the Mount Pokémon, a Dragon/Normal-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Cyclizar stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 138lbs 14oz (63.0kg). It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.

name: Orthworm
description: Orthworm is the Earthworm Pokémon, a Steel-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Orthworm stands 8'2" (2.5m) tall and weighs 683lbs 7oz (310.0kg). This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.

name: Glimmet
description: Glimmet is the Ore Pokémon, a Rock/Poison-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Glimmet stands 2'4" (0.7m) tall and weighs 17lbs 10oz (8.0kg). Glimmet’s toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.

name: Glimmora
description: Glimmora is the Ore Pokémon, a Rock/Poison-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Glimmora stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 99lbs 3oz (45.0kg). Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

name: Greavard
description: Greavard is the Ghost Dog Pokémon, a Ghost-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Greavard stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 77lbs 3oz (35.0kg). This friendly Pokémon doesn’t like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

name: Houndstone
description: Houndstone is the Ghost Dog Pokémon, a Ghost-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Houndstone stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 33lbs 1oz (15.0kg). A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn’t like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

name: Flamigo
description: Flamigo is the Synchronize Pokémon, a Flying/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Flamigo stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 81lbs 9oz (37.0kg). Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.

name: Cetoddle
description: Cetoddle is the Terra Whale Pokémon, a Ice-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Cetoddle stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 99lbs 3oz (45.0kg). It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

name: Cetitan
description: Cetitan is the Terra Whale Pokémon, a Ice-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Cetitan stands 14'9" (4.5m) tall and weighs 1543lbs 4oz (700.0kg). Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

name: Veluza
description: Veluza is the Jettison Pokémon, a Water/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Veluza stands 8'2" (2.5m) tall and weighs 198lbs 7oz (90.0kg). Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.

name: Dondozo
description: Dondozo is the Big Catfish Pokémon, a Water-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Dondozo stands 39'4" (12.0m) tall and weighs 485lbs (220.0kg). It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.

name: Tatsugiri
description: Tatsugiri is the Mimicry Pokémon, a Dragon/Water-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Tatsugiri stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 17lbs 10oz (8.0kg). Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

name: Annihilape
description: Annihilape is the Rage Monkey Pokémon, a Fighting/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Annihilape stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 123lbs 7oz (56.0kg). It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

name: Clodsire
description: Clodsire is the Spiny Fish Pokémon, a Poison/Ground-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Clodsire stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 491lbs 10oz (223.0kg). It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them across water from one shore to the other.

name: Farigiraf
description: Farigiraf is the Long Neck Pokémon, a Normal/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Farigiraf stands 10'6" (3.2m) tall and weighs 352lbs 12oz (160.0kg). The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.

name: Dudunsparce
description: Dudunsparce is the Land Snake Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Dudunsparce stands 11'10" (3.6m) tall and weighs 86lbs 7oz (39.2kg). It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.

name: Kingambit
description: Kingambit is the Big Blade Pokémon, a Dark/Steel-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Kingambit stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 264lbs 9oz (120.0kg). Though it commands a massive army in battle, it’s not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

name: Great Tusk
description: Great Tusk is the Paradox Pokémon, a Ground/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Great Tusk stands 7'3" (2.2m) tall and weighs 705lbs 8oz (320.0kg). This creature resembles a mysterious Pokémon that, according to a paranormal magazine, has lived since ancient times.

name: Scream Tail
description: Scream Tail is the Paradox Pokémon, a Fairy/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Scream Tail stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 17lbs 10oz (8.0kg). It resembles a mysterious Pokémon described in a paranormal magazine as a Jigglypuff from one billion years ago.

name: Brute Bonnet
description: Brute Bonnet is the Paradox Pokémon, a Grass/Dark-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Brute Bonnet stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 46lbs 5oz (21.0kg). It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.

name: Flutter Mane
description: Flutter Mane is the Paradox Pokémon, a Ghost/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Flutter Mane stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 8lbs 13oz (4.0kg). It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.

name: Slither Wing
description: Slither Wing is the Paradox Pokémon, a Bug/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Slither Wing stands 10'6" (3.2m) tall and weighs 202lbs 13oz (92.0kg). This Pokémon somewhat resembles an ancient form of Volcarona that was introduced in a dubious magazine.

name: Sandy Shocks
description: Sandy Shocks is the Paradox Pokémon, a Electric/Ground-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Sandy Shocks stands 7'7" (2.3m) tall and weighs 132lbs 4oz (60.0kg). It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine.

name: Iron Treads
description: Iron Treads is the Paradox Pokémon, a Ground/Steel-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Iron Treads stands 2'11" (0.9m) tall and weighs 529lbs 2oz (240.0kg). Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.

name: Iron Bundle
description: Iron Bundle is the Paradox Pokémon, a Ice/Water-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Iron Bundle stands 2' (0.6m) tall and weighs 24lbs 4oz (11.0kg). It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.

name: Iron Hands
description: Iron Hands is the Paradox Pokémon, a Fighting/Electric-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Iron Hands stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 839lbs 5oz (380.7kg). This Pokémon shares many similarities with Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain expedition journal.

name: Iron Jugulis
description: Iron Jugulis is the Paradox Pokémon, a Dark/Flying-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Iron Jugulis stands 4'3" (1.3m) tall and weighs 244lbs 11oz (111.0kg). It’s possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.

name: Iron Moth
description: Iron Moth is the Paradox Pokémon, a Fire/Poison-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Iron Moth stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 79lbs 6oz (36.0kg). No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with an object described in an old book.

name: Iron Thorns
description: Iron Thorns is the Paradox Pokémon, a Rock/Electric-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Iron Thorns stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 668lbs (303.0kg). Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.

name: Frigibax
description: Frigibax is the Ice Fin Pokémon, a Dragon/Ice-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Frigibax stands 1'8" (0.5m) tall and weighs 37lbs 8oz (17.0kg). This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

name: Arctibax
description: Arctibax is the Ice Fin Pokémon, a Dragon/Ice-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Arctibax stands 2'7" (0.8m) tall and weighs 66lbs 2oz (30.0kg). It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin by doing a front flip in the air. Arctibax’s strong back and legs allow it to pull off this technique.

name: Baxcalibur
description: Baxcalibur is the Ice Dragon Pokémon, a Dragon/Ice-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Baxcalibur stands 6'11" (2.1m) tall and weighs 463lbs (210.0kg). It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

name: Gimmighoul
description: Gimmighoul is the Coin Chest Pokémon, a Ghost-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Gimmighoul stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 11lbs (5.0kg). It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.

name: Gholdengo
description: Gholdengo is the Coin Entity Pokémon, a Steel/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Gholdengo stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 66lbs 2oz (30.0kg). It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.

name: Wo-Chien
description: Wo Chien is a Legendary Ruinous Pokémon, a Dark/Grass-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Wo Chien stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 163lbs 9oz (74.2kg). It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.

name: Chien-Pao
description: Chien Pao is a Legendary Ruinous Pokémon, a Dark/Ice-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Chien Pao stands 6'3" (1.9m) tall and weighs 335lbs 9oz (152.2kg). The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.

name: Ting-Lu
description: Ting Lu is a Legendary Ruinous Pokémon, a Dark/Ground-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Ting Lu stands 8'10" (2.7m) tall and weighs 1542lbs 9oz (699.7kg). It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.

name: Chi-Yu
description: Chi Yu is a Legendary Ruinous Pokémon, a Dark/Fire-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Chi Yu stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 10lbs 13oz (4.9kg). The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.

name: Roaring Moon
description: Roaring Moon is the Paradox Pokémon, a Dragon/Dark-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Roaring Moon stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 837lbs 12oz (380.0kg). According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to a phenomenon that occurs in a certain region.

name: Iron Valiant
description: Iron Valiant is the Paradox Pokémon, a Fairy/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Iron Valiant stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 77lbs 3oz (35.0kg). It’s possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.

name: Koraidon
description: Koraidon is a Legendary Paradox Pokémon, a Fighting/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Koraidon stands 8'2" (2.5m) tall and weighs 668lbs (303.0kg). This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.

name: Miraidon
description: Miraidon is a Legendary Paradox Pokémon, a Electric/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Miraidon stands 11'6" (3.5m) tall and weighs 529lbs 2oz (240.0kg). This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

name: Walking Wake
description: Walking Wake is the Paradox Pokémon, a Water/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Walking Wake stands 11'6" (3.5m) tall and weighs 617lbs 5oz (280.0kg). It resembles an illustration published in a paranormal magazine, said to be a depiction of a super-ancient Suicune.

name: Iron Leaves
description: Iron Leaves is the Paradox Pokémon, a Grass/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Iron Leaves stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 275lbs 9oz (125.0kg). According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.

name: Dipplin
description: Dipplin is the Candy Apple Pokémon, a Grass/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Dipplin stands 1'4" (0.4m) tall and weighs 21lbs 6oz (9.7kg). The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

name: Poltchageist
description: Poltchageist is the Matcha Pokémon, a Grass/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Poltchageist stands 4" (0.1m) tall and weighs 2lbs 7oz (1.1kg). Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

name: Sinistcha
description: Sinistcha is the Matcha Pokémon, a Grass/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Sinistcha stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 4lbs 14oz (2.2kg). It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

name: Okidogi
description: Okidogi is a Legendary Retainer Pokémon, a Poison/Fighting-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Okidogi stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 203lbs 4oz (92.2kg). Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

name: Munkidori
description: Munkidori is a Legendary Retainer Pokémon, a Poison/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Munkidori stands 3'3" (1.0m) tall and weighs 26lbs 14oz (12.2kg). Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

name: Fezandipiti
description: Fezandipiti is a Legendary Retainer Pokémon, a Poison/Fairy-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Fezandipiti stands 4'7" (1.4m) tall and weighs 66lbs 6oz (30.1kg). Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.

name: Ogerpon
description: Ogerpon is a Legendary Mask Pokémon, a Grass-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Ogerpon stands 3'11" (1.2m) tall and weighs 87lbs 12oz (39.8kg). This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

name: Archaludon
description: Archaludon is the Alloy Pokémon, a Steel/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Archaludon stands 6'7" (2.0m) tall and weighs 132lbs 4oz (60.0kg). It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.

name: Hydrapple
description: Hydrapple is the Apple Hydra Pokémon, a Grass/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Hydrapple stands 5'11" (1.8m) tall and weighs 205lbs (93.0kg). These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.

name: Gouging Fire
description: Gouging Fire is the Paradox Pokémon, a Fire/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Gouging Fire stands 11'6" (3.5m) tall and weighs 1300lbs 12oz (590.0kg). It resembles an eerie Pokémon once shown in a paranormal magazine. That Pokémon was said to be an Entei regenerated from a fossil.

name: Raging Bolt
description: Raging Bolt is the Paradox Pokémon, a Electric/Dragon-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Raging Bolt stands 17'1" (5.2m) tall and weighs 1058lbs 4oz (480.0kg). It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranormal magazine touted it as Raikou's ancestor.

name: Iron Boulder
description: Iron Boulder is the Paradox Pokémon, a Rock/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Iron Boulder stands 4'11" (1.5m) tall and weighs 358lbs 4oz (162.5kg). It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.

name: Iron Crown
description: Iron Crown is the Paradox Pokémon, a Steel/Psychic-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Iron Crown stands 5'3" (1.6m) tall and weighs 343lbs 15oz (156.0kg). There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.

name: Terapagos
description: Terapagos is a Legendary Tera Pokémon, a Normal-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Terapagos stands 8" (0.2m) tall and weighs 14lbs 5oz (6.5kg). It’s thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.

name: Pecharunt
description: Pecharunt is a Mythical Subjugation Pokémon, a Poison/Ghost-type species introduced in Generation IX. It first appeared in Pokemon Scarlet. Pecharunt stands 1' (0.3m) tall and weighs 11oz (0.3kg). Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.
